chapters.captionEn: Apply exponent 23 to the ciphertext. Skip power 8 and recover message 42.

chapters.title: 零和不互素的数，也要回来
chapters.titleEn: Zero and shared factors must work too
chapters.caption: 逐个检查边界与不互素消息；两边素数的余数都必须恢复。
chapters.captionEn: Check boundaries and shared factors. Both prime remainders must return correctly.

chapters.title: 算得回来，不代表守得住
chapters.titleEn: A round-trip is not a security guarantee
chapters.caption: 不填充的 RSA 是确定性的；小消息可以逐个公开猜测。
chapters.captionEn: Unpadded RSA is deterministic. Small messages can be guessed using the public key.

chapters.title: 真实系统，多做了什么
chapters.caption: 现代 RSA 加密需要安全填充；混合方案用随机密钥保护内容。
chapters.captionEn: Modern RSA encryption needs secure padding. Hybrid schemes protect content with a random key.

chapters.title: 低输入接通上拉路径
chapters.titleEn: A low input opens the pull-up path
chapters.caption: A 为 0，上拉给电容充电；输出电压逐渐升高。
chapters.captionEn: With A at 0, the pull-up charges the capacitor and the output rises.

chapters.title: 高输入接通下拉路径
chapters.titleEn: A high input opens the pull-down path
chapters.caption: A 为 1，上拉断开，下拉让电容连续放电。
chapters.captionEn: With A at 1, the pull-up opens and the capacitor discharges through the pull-down.

chapters.title: 与非门：下拉必须串通
chapters.caption: 两个下拉串联；任一个没有接通，输出就不能沿它们放电。
chapters.captionEn: The pull-down devices are in series; either open switch breaks the discharge path.

chapters.title: 或非门：一条下拉就够
chapters.titleEn: NOR needs only one pull-down path
chapters.caption: 下拉改成并联，任一高输入都能拉低输出。
chapters.captionEn: Parallel pull-down paths let either high input pull the output low.

chapters.title: 电压要穿过中间区域
chapters.caption: X 表示不能保证的逻辑读数；电容电压仍有确定数值。
chapters.captionEn: X marks an unguaranteed logic reading; the capacitor voltage remains definite.

chapters.title: 更大的负载需要更久
chapters.caption: 10 fF 换成 40 fF，电阻不变，半电压时间增加到四倍。
chapters.captionEn: Changing 10 fF to 40 fF quadruples half-voltage time at the same resistance.

chapters.title: 变化沿两级电路传播
chapters.titleEn: A transition travels through two stages
chapters.caption: Y₁ 穿过模型界线后，第二级才开始改变 Y₂。
chapters.captionEn: Only after Y₁ crosses the model boundary does the second stage begin changing Y₂.

chapters.title: 一次翻转，能量去了哪里
chapters.caption: 充电把能量分给电容与热，随后放电把储能也变成热。
chapters.captionEn: Charging divides energy between storage and heat; discharging turns the stored part into heat.

chapters.title: 两种宿主，一层隔膜
chapters.caption: 锂储存在宿主里，隔膜保持两极分开。
chapters.captionEn: Lithium sits in hosts; the separator keeps the electrodes apart.

chapters.title: 两条路，同一次放电
chapters.caption: 锂离子向内穿行，电子经过外部负载。
chapters.captionEn: Ions travel internally; electrons pass through the external load.

chapters.title: 让离子过，不让电子过
chapters.caption: 同一组身份保持不变，路径不会跨错材料。
chapters.captionEn: Tracer identities stay fixed, and their paths respect the materials.

chapters.title: 电量对应锂的搬移
chapters.caption: 两极含锂比例一减一增，总量保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: One host loses lithium as the other gains it; total inventory stays fixed.

chapters.title: 电流变大，压降出现
chapters.caption: 内阻立刻降压，极化随后变化，内部持续发热。
chapters.captionEn: Resistance acts immediately; polarization follows, with internal heat loss.

chapters.title: 电压回升，不是电量回生
chapters.caption: 断流后 SOC 不变，极化储能释放为热。
chapters.captionEn: At zero current, SOC stays fixed while polarization energy becomes heat.

chapters.title: 提供能量，沿原路返回
chapters.titleEn: Supply energy and reverse the paths
chapters.caption: 充电源做功，锂回到石墨，电子方向也反转。
chapters.captionEn: The charger does work as lithium returns to graphite and electrons reverse.

chapters.title: 到边界，停止继续充入
chapters.caption: 容量端点触发断流，能量账目始终闭合。
chapters.captionEn: The usable capacity limit stops current, while energy accounting stays balanced.

chapters.title: 轮子想转，摆在把关
chapters.titleEn: The wheel wants to turn; the pendulum gates it
chapters.caption: 重锤拉动卷筒；擒纵轮被两块擒纵瓦交替拦住。
chapters.captionEn: The weight pulls the drum; two pallets alternately hold the escape wheel.

chapters.title: 锁住轮子，摆仍在走
chapters.titleEn: The wheel rests while the pendulum moves
chapters.caption: 锁面是以锚轴为圆心的圆弧：摆动时，齿尖停在原处。
chapters.captionEn: The locking arc is centred on the anchor arbor, so the tooth stays put as the anchor swings.

chapters.title: 齿尖滑过冲量面
chapters.titleEn: The tooth crosses the impulse face
chapters.caption: 齿尖越过锁角，沿平面冲量面推进；随后进入短暂跌落。
chapters.captionEn: The tooth passes the locking corner, drives along the impulse plane, then briefly drops free.

chapters.title: 出口瓦接住下一步
chapters.titleEn: The exit pallet catches the next step
chapters.caption: 出口瓦先锁住轮子，待摆返回，再从另一方向传递冲量。
chapters.captionEn: The exit pallet locks first, then delivers an impulse on the returning swing.

chapters.title: 一次往返，恰好一个齿距
chapters.titleEn: One full swing, one tooth pitch
chapters.caption: 每半次往返放行一次；完整往返后，30 齿轮前进 12°。
chapters.captionEn: There is one release per half-swing; a full swing advances this 30-tooth wheel by 12°.

chapters.title: 补回损失，摆幅才留得住
chapters.caption: 同一起点与阻尼：自由摆衰减；理想中点补能维持能量范围。
chapters.captionEn: Same start and damping: the free swing decays; ideal centre impulses sustain its energy range.

chapters.title: 摆变长，放行的节拍变慢
chapters.titleEn: A longer pendulum releases more slowly
chapters.caption: 相同计时窗口里，较长的摆周期更长，累计放行更少。
chapters.captionEn: Over the same time window, a longer pendulum has a longer period and fewer releases.

chapters.title: 重锤供能，钟摆定拍
chapters.titleEn: The weight supplies energy; the pendulum sets the beat
chapters.caption: 锁定限制轮的推进；冲量补偿损失；摆长决定近似周期。
chapters.captionEn: Lock limits the wheel, impulse replaces losses, and length sets the approximate period.

chapters.title: 先逐页翻完这张表
chapters.titleEn: Read the table page by page
chapters.caption: 查找键 63：完整扫描要检查全部 24 行。
chapters.captionEn: Finding key 63 requires scanning all 24 rows.

chapters.title: 分隔键，是通往下一页的路标
chapters.titleEn: Separators point to the next page
chapters.caption: 分隔键决定下一页；键相同，再比较行号。
chapters.captionEn: Separators choose the next page; row IDs break ties.

chapters.title: 沿着页号，找到同一条记录
chapters.titleEn: Follow page IDs to the same record
chapters.caption: 沿子页指针下降，再用行号取回完整记录。
chapters.captionEn: Follow child pointers, then fetch the record by row ID.

chapters.title: 少翻了几页，账要算完整
chapters.titleEn: Count every page on both routes
chapters.caption: 同一结果：全扫 6 页，索引 4 页加堆页 1 页。
chapters.captionEn: Same result: scan 6 pages, or read 4 index pages plus 1 heap page.

chapters.title: 范围查询，顺着叶页接着走
chapters.titleEn: Continue a range along the leaves
chapters.caption: 沿叶页查找 38–47；三个 42 各有独立行号。
chapters.captionEn: Follow leaves for 38–47; all three 42s retain their row IDs.

chapters.title: 叶页满了，把新邻居接进来
chapters.titleEn: A full leaf gains a new neighbor
chapters.caption: 第 4 项撑满叶页：分裂，并把右页最小项复制到父页。
chapters.captionEn: A fourth entry splits the leaf; copy the right minimum to its parent.

chapters.title: 分裂向上传，直到长出新根
chapters.titleEn: Splits climb until a new root grows
chapters.caption: 分裂传到根时，所有叶子统一加深一层。
chapters.captionEn: A root split adds one level to every leaf.

chapters.title: 读得越多，索引越不占便宜
chapters.titleEn: Reading more can erase the advantage
chapters.caption: 读全部 37 行：索引触及 27 页，全扫只需 10 页。
chapters.captionEn: Read all 37 rows: the index touches 27 pages; a scan needs 10.

chapters.title: 只盯住这一颗
chapters.caption: 没有整体水流，微球仍留下不规则轨迹。
chapters.captionEn: Even without mean flow, the sphere wanders.

chapters.title: 把时间放到纳秒
chapters.caption: 热浴与阻力的冲量，共同改变微球动量。
chapters.captionEn: Bath and drag impulses change the sphere’s momentum.

chapters.title: 惯性会被忘记
chapters.caption: 关闭热噪声，已有速度按时间常数 τ 衰减。
chapters.captionEn: With thermal noise off, velocity decays on the timescale τ.

chapters.title: 拉回秒尺度
chapters.caption: 远大于 τ 时，同一热浴的两种轨迹几乎重合。
chapters.captionEn: Far beyond τ, both descriptions nearly coincide for the same bath.

chapters.title: 只改变热浴温度
chapters.caption: 固定黏度与半径：升温使扩散系数 D 增大。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed viscosity and radius, higher temperature increases D.

chapters.title: 阻力改变游走尺度
chapters.caption: 黏度乘三，D 除三；半径乘二，D 减半。
chapters.captionEn: Triple viscosity: D divides by three. Double radius: D halves.

chapters.title: 把重复实验叠起来
chapters.caption: 单次位移平方会起落；多次平均接近理论均方位移。
chapters.captionEn: One squared displacement fluctuates; trial averages approach the MSD.

chapters.title: 平均位置不是一条命运
chapters.titleEn: The mean is not a particle
chapters.caption: 平均位置接近起点，典型离开距离却持续增大。
chapters.captionEn: The mean stays near the start while typical displacement grows.

chapters.title: 从浓到淡
chapters.titleEn: From a peak to a spread
chapters.caption: 峰变矮、两侧变宽；封闭带中的总量不变。
chapters.captionEn: The peak spreads; the sealed strip’s total stays constant.

chapters.title: 坡度决定净通量
chapters.caption: 同一截面：浓度坡度越缓，净通量越小。
chapters.captionEn: At a fixed section, a gentler slope means less net flux.

chapters.title: 一小段的收支
chapters.caption: 局部先积累、再流出；封闭带的总量始终守恒。
chapters.captionEn: A region gains, then loses material; the sealed total is conserved.

chapters.title: 边界让宽度停下
chapters.caption: 方差起初近似线性增长，随后受封闭边界限制。
chapters.captionEn: Variance first grows almost linearly, then meets the boundary limit.

chapters.title: 改变扩散系数
chapters.caption: 相同初态：D 加倍，等效于基准组的两倍模型时间。
chapters.captionEn: Same initial state: double D equals twice the baseline model time.

chapters.title: 长度的平方
chapters.caption: 初态同比放大：长度加倍，同等相对平滑需四倍时间。
chapters.captionEn: Scale the initial shape: double length takes four times as long to smooth.

chapters.title: 混合而不消失
chapters.caption: A、B 逐渐重叠；各自总量与总浓度都不变。
chapters.captionEn: A and B overlap; each amount and their total concentration stay fixed.

chapters.title: 有通量的稳态
chapters.caption: 储库维持浓度差：曲线逐渐稳定，净通量仍存在。
chapters.captionEn: Reservoirs maintain the gradient: the profile approaches steady state while flux continues.

chapters.title: 分组只选择下一跳
chapters.titleEn: Each router chooses a next hop
chapters.caption: 目的地始终是 R；每台路由器只选择下一跳。
chapters.captionEn: Destination R stays fixed; each router chooses only the next hop.

chapters.title: 最短的是路由代价
chapters.caption: 仅改变 B–R 代价，收敛后的最短路径随之改变。
chapters.captionEn: Change only B–R cost: the converged least-cost path changes.

chapters.title: 先排队，再逐位发送
chapters.caption: 一个出口依次发送分组，后来者先排队。
chapters.captionEn: An output sends one packet at a time; later arrivals queue.

chapters.title: TTL 限制转发次数
chapters.caption: 转发前 TTL 减一；减到零，分组就被丢弃。
chapters.captionEn: TTL drops before forwarding; at zero, the packet is discarded.

chapters.title: 故障先被邻居发现
chapters.titleEn: A neighbor notices the failure first
chapters.caption: B–R 中断，P1 丢失；远处路由器还不知道。
chapters.captionEn: B–R fails and P1 is lost; remote routers do not know yet.

chapters.title: 更新传播后，路由才收敛
chapters.caption: B 已改道，C 仍用旧表；更新传完前可能绕圈。
chapters.captionEn: B updates before C; a temporary loop lasts until convergence.

chapters.title: 队列满了，分组会被丢弃
chapters.titleEn: A full queue drops arriving packets
chapters.caption: 同样十个分组：加等待位可减少丢弃，出口速率不变。
chapters.captionEn: Same ten packets: more queue slots reduce drops but do not speed up output.

chapters.title: 先到达，不一定先交付
chapters.titleEn: Arrival order is not delivery order
chapters.caption: 后发的 P4 先到；顺序交付仍要等待缺失分组。
chapters.captionEn: P4 arrives ahead of earlier packets; ordered delivery waits for the gap.

chapters.title: 拉头经过，齿留在身后
chapters.titleEn: A moving slider, a lasting join
chapters.caption: 拉头改变相遇路径，齿留在连续织带上。
chapters.captionEn: The slider changes the meeting path; the teeth stay attached to their tapes.

chapters.title: 宽齿头里藏着一道齿窝
chapters.titleEn: A recess inside the broad head
chapters.caption: 剖去 L7 的上唇，看对侧薄翼进入齿窝。
chapters.captionEn: Cut away L7’s upper lip to see the opposite wing inside its recess.

chapters.title: Y 形通道让两条带转弯
chapters.titleEn: The Y guide turns the tapes
chapters.caption: 外导边与中心楔限定两条连续的弯曲路径。
chapters.captionEn: Outer flanges and a central diamond bound two continuous curved paths.

chapters.title: 跟着 L7 走进咬合
chapters.caption: 半齿距错位与转弯配合，让宽头进入邻齿之间。
chapters.captionEn: Half-pitch staggering and rotation let the broad head enter between its neighbours.

chapters.title: 横着拉，为什么分不开
chapters.titleEn: Why a sideways pull is resisted
chapters.caption: 在对称刚体假设下，两处肩面各承担 F/2。
chapters.captionEn: Under the symmetric rigid-body assumption, each shoulder carries F/2.

chapters.title: 倒着走，同一颗齿退出
chapters.titleEn: The same tooth follows the reverse route
chapters.caption: 拉头改变退出方向，让相互阻挡的肩面逐步分离。
chapters.captionEn: The slider changes the exit direction so the retaining shoulders can separate.

chapters.title: 上下止限定这段旅程
chapters.caption: 上止挡住拉头；下止连接两条带并限制下行。
chapters.captionEn: Top stops block the slider; the bottom stop joins the tapes and limits downward travel.

chapters.title: 去掉宽肩，结果就变了
chapters.titleEn: Remove the shoulder, change the result
chapters.caption: 相同横移尝试下，宽肩保留阻挡；削肩假想齿可退出。
chapters.captionEn: With the same attempted shift, broad shoulders retain; hypothetical narrow heads can withdraw.

chapters.title: 都在落向月球
chapters.caption: 近侧、地心、远侧都向月球加速，但加速度不一样。
chapters.captionEn: Near side, center and far side all accelerate toward the Moon, by different amounts.

chapters.title: 跟地心一起下落
chapters.caption: 减去地心加速度后，近侧相对向月，远侧相对背月；两边都远离地心。
chapters.captionEn: Subtract the center acceleration: the near and far sides both stretch away from the center.

chapters.title: 海面跟随同一个势
chapters.caption: 形变逐渐放大：同一潮汐势让理想海面在近、远两端隆起。
chapters.captionEn: Magnify the deformation: one tidal potential raises the ideal surface on both sides.

chapters.title: 距离的三次方
chapters.caption: 潮汐的主导项随距离的三次方衰减，比整体引力更敏感。
chapters.captionEn: The leading tidal term falls with distance cubed, more steeply than bulk attraction.

chapters.title: 把太阳项加进来
chapters.caption: 太阳也贡献潮汐项；日月同向时，两者的形变增强。
chapters.captionEn: The Sun also contributes. Aligned lunar and solar tides reinforce the deformation.

chapters.title: 大潮与小潮
chapters.caption: 日月成直线时，赤道平衡潮差较大；成直角时较小。
chapters.captionEn: Alignment gives a larger equatorial equilibrium range; a right angle gives a smaller one.

chapters.title: 让观测点转过一圈
chapters.caption: 在固定月球方向的平衡模型里，赤道观测点转过一圈，经过两个高度峰值。
chapters.captionEn: With the Moon fixed, an equatorial site crosses two ideal height peaks per relative turn.

chapters.title: 峰值没有统一答案
chapters.caption: 纬度可以让理想峰值不等高，甚至只剩一个；真实海岸还取决于海盆动力学。
chapters.captionEn: Latitude can make the ideal peaks unequal or remove one. Real coasts also depend on basin dynamics.

chapters.title: 一斗土，三支油缸
chapters.caption: 钢臂没有变长，变长的是油缸。
chapters.captionEn: The steel arms never change length; the cylinders do.

chapters.title: 切开动臂缸
chapters.caption: 油进入无杆腔，推动活塞，活塞杆顶起动臂。
chapters.captionEn: Oil fills the cap end, pushes the piston, and the rod lifts the boom.

chapters.title: 一条闭合的油路
chapters.caption: 发动机带动泵送出流量，阀芯决定油去哪个腔。
chapters.captionEn: The engine drives the pump; the spool decides where the oil goes.

chapters.title: 压力由载荷决定
chapters.caption: 连通的油液压力处处相等；面积大三十六倍，推力大三十六倍。
chapters.captionEn: One pressure everywhere; 36 times the area, 36 times the force.

chapters.title: 推杆多少，走多快
chapters.caption: 手柄推阀芯，阀口开多少，进多少油。
chapters.captionEn: The lever moves the spool; the opening meters the flow.

chapters.title: 同一斗土，不同的姿态
chapters.caption: 同样的载荷，力矩和力臂都随姿态改变。
chapters.captionEn: The same load, but moment and lever arm change with pose.

chapters.title: 铲斗的四连杆
chapters.caption: 直线推力经摇臂和连杆，变成铲斗的收拢。
chapters.captionEn: A straight push becomes bucket curl through the rocker and link.

chapters.title: 撬不动的石头
chapters.caption: 压力到达限压，油从溢流阀回油箱，动臂不再上升。
chapters.captionEn: At the relief setting, oil returns to tank and the boom stops rising.

chapters.title: 多一道缝，反而更暗
chapters.caption: 多开一道缝，有些地方却更暗。
chapters.captionEn: Two open slits can make a dark fringe.

chapters.title: 跟住屏幕上的一点
chapters.caption: 光程差增加一个波长，相位再次重合。
chapters.captionEn: One wavelength of path difference restores phase.

chapters.title: 先加电场，再算亮度
chapters.caption: 先叠加电场，再计算光强。
chapters.captionEn: Add the fields before finding intensity.

chapters.title: 两缝拉开，条纹变密
chapters.caption: 两缝拉开，条纹变密。
chapters.captionEn: Farther slits make closer fringes.

chapters.title: 波长变长，条纹变疏
chapters.caption: 波长变长，条纹变疏。
chapters.captionEn: Longer wavelengths spread the fringes.

chapters.title: 缝变宽，包络变窄
chapters.caption: 缝变宽，外层包络变窄。
chapters.captionEn: Wider slits narrow the outer envelope.

chapters.title: 一个点，一个点地积累
chapters.caption: 一次次探测，积累出条纹。
chapters.captionEn: Individual detections build up the fringes.

chapters.title: 没有电池，也能回应
chapters.caption: 先从场里取得能量，再借同一个场回答。
chapters.captionEn: The reader's field carries both power and a reply.

chapters.title: 变化的磁通，感应出电压
chapters.caption: 穿过标签线圈的磁通在变，交流电压随之产生。
chapters.captionEn: Changing flux through the tag coil induces an alternating voltage.

chapters.title: 把交流变成芯片的电源
chapters.titleEn: Turn the induced voltage into a supply
chapters.caption: 整流统一极性，储能电容缓冲供电波动。
chapters.captionEn: Rectification and stored energy provide the chip's supply.

chapters.title: 读卡器把问题放进包络
chapters.titleEn: The reader asks through the envelope
chapters.caption: 读卡器短暂改变载波幅度，标签识别编码。
chapters.captionEn: Brief carrier-amplitude changes encode the reader's question.

chapters.title: 切换负载，就是回答
chapters.caption: 标签改变负载，读卡线圈也能察觉变化。
chapters.captionEn: A load change at the tag also changes the reader's current.

chapters.title: 跟住同一串比特
chapters.caption: 开关节奏变成电流变化，再还原成同一串比特。
chapters.captionEn: Switching becomes current changes, then the same bits again.

chapters.title: 为什么要靠近、对准
chapters.caption: 供电和回传都依赖耦合；靠近后，还要对准。
chapters.captionEn: Both power and the reply depend on useful coil coupling.

chapters.title: 一个中子，一滴核
chapters.caption: 吸收一个中子后，核像液滴一样裂开。
chapters.captionEn: After absorbing a neutron, the nucleus splits like a drop.

chapters.title: 能量从结合能来
chapters.caption: 碎片结合得更紧，多出的结合能变成动能。
chapters.captionEn: Fragments are bound more tightly; the surplus becomes motion.

chapters.title: 一代接一代
chapters.caption: 每一代都比上一代多，几十代后就是天文数字。
chapters.captionEn: Each generation outnumbers the last; eighty generations later, astronomical.

chapters.title: 小球：中子漏掉了
chapters.caption: 球太小，中子还没碰上核就飞出去了。
chapters.captionEn: Too small a sphere: neutrons escape before they collide.

chapters.title: 大球：过了临界
chapters.caption: 体积长得比表面快；过了临界半径，链自己延续。
chapters.captionEn: Volume outgrows surface; past the critical radius the chain sustains itself.

chapters.title: 反应堆与炸弹
chapters.caption: 平均代时间示意：缓发中子延缓增长，实际瞬态需另求解。
chapters.captionEn: Mean-time illustration: delayed neutrons slow growth; actual transients need a separate model.

chapters.title: 它为什么会停
chapters.caption: 一膨胀，密度下降，k 跌回一以下，反应自己停下。
chapters.captionEn: Expansion lowers density, k drops below one, and the reaction stops itself.

chapters.title: 靠近，然后被推开
chapters.caption: 两个核带正电，靠近就互相推开。
chapters.captionEn: Both nuclei are positive; closeness pushes them apart.

chapters.title: 合上以后，能量从哪里来
chapters.caption: 氦-4 绑得更紧，多出的能量被释放。
chapters.captionEn: Helium-4 is bound tighter; the surplus is released.

chapters.title: 温度决定分布的尾巴
chapters.caption: 只有分布尾巴上的少数核对能穿过势垒。
chapters.captionEn: Only the few pairs in the tail can tunnel through.

chapters.title: 反应率随温度陡升
chapters.caption: 温度提高几倍，反应率提高几千倍。
chapters.captionEn: A few times hotter, thousands of times faster.

chapters.title: 热核武器中的裂变初级
chapters.titleEn: The fission primary in thermonuclear weapons
chapters.caption: 裂变初级提供高温与辐射；聚变也有激光点火等途径。
chapters.captionEn: A fission primary supplies heat and radiation; lasers provide another route to fusion ignition.

chapters.title: 燃料自带下一份氚
chapters.titleEn: Fuel that makes its own tritium
chapters.caption: 中子把锂变成氚，燃料在燃烧中补给自己。
chapters.captionEn: Neutrons turn lithium into tritium; the fuel restocks itself.

chapters.title: 三种留住高温的办法
chapters.titleEn: Three ways to hold the heat
chapters.caption: 磁场、惯性与引力：燃料和约束条件并不相同。
chapters.captionEn: Magnetic, inertial and gravitational confinement use different fuels and conditions.

chapters.title: 旋转的机翼
chapters.caption: 机身原地不动，桨叶仍迎着空气。
chapters.captionEn: The cabin stays still; the blades meet the air.

chapters.title: 桨距与空气
chapters.caption: 桨距改变迎角，也改变剖面升力。
chapters.captionEn: Pitch changes the angle of attack and section lift.

chapters.title: 一起改变桨距
chapters.caption: 总距一起增加，两片桨叶一起增升力。
chapters.captionEn: Collective raises both blades’ pitch together.

chapters.title: 一圈内的变化
chapters.caption: 同一片桨叶，每转一圈改变一次桨距。
chapters.captionEn: Each blade’s pitch varies around the circle.

chapters.title: 把推力倾斜
chapters.caption: 推力倾斜后，一部分指向水平方向。
chapters.captionEn: Tilt gives the thrust a horizontal component.

chapters.title: 尾桨抵住什么
chapters.caption: 尾桨侧推产生力矩，抵住机身反扭矩。
chapters.captionEn: Tail thrust counters the airframe’s reaction torque.

chapters.title: 倾斜后重新平衡
chapters.caption: 补足垂直分量，水平分量仍然保留。
chapters.captionEn: Restore vertical balance while keeping horizontal thrust.

chapters.title: 一条能量线
chapters.caption: 跟住导气活塞与枪机框。
chapters.captionEn: Follow the piston and carrier.

chapters.title: 燃气做功
chapters.caption: 短暂输入，让联动组开始移动。
chapters.captionEn: A brief input starts the assembly moving.

chapters.title: 始终相连
chapters.caption: 活塞与枪机框保持连接。
chapters.captionEn: Piston and carrier stay connected.

chapters.title: 把运动存起来
chapters.caption: 运动减慢，弹性储能增加。
chapters.captionEn: Motion slows; spring energy grows.

chapters.title: 把能量交回来
chapters.caption: 输入已停，弹簧驱动回程。
chapters.captionEn: The input ends; the spring drives the return.

chapters.title: 同位不同向
chapters.caption: 位置相同，方向相反。
chapters.captionEn: Same position, opposite directions.

chapters.title: 一轮能量路径
chapters.caption: 位置回来了，能量已转移。
chapters.captionEn: Position returns; energy has been transferred.

chapters.title: 地表之下
chapters.caption: 切面打开，地雷位置没有改变。
chapters.captionEn: The section opens; the mine stays fixed.

chapters.title: 完整外壳近看
chapters.caption: 外壳保持封闭，镜头观察外部轮廓。
chapters.captionEn: The camera explores the sealed exterior.

chapters.title: 静止的外表，储存的能量
chapters.caption: 外壳静止，不代表没有储能。
chapters.captionEn: A still exterior does not mean no stored energy.

chapters.title: 地表在变，物体仍在
chapters.caption: 草与落叶变化，同一外壳留在原位。
chapters.captionEn: Cover changes around the same casing.

chapters.title: 时间不是安全证据
chapters.caption: 时间前进，状态仍是未知。
chapters.captionEn: Time advances; the state stays unknown.

chapters.title: 磨损也不是答案
chapters.caption: 涂层和磨损可见，安全状态仍未知。
chapters.captionEn: Visible wear; unknown safety.

chapters.title: 让观察停在接触之前
chapters.caption: 不靠近、不触碰，联系当地专业机构。
chapters.captionEn: Do not approach or touch. Contact professionals.

chapters.title: 按下一颗键
chapters.caption: 轴心下移，弹簧压缩，触点接通。
chapters.captionEn: The stem moves; the spring compresses; contacts meet.

chapters.title: 红与黑：同为线性
chapters.caption: 没有段落，不代表按起来一样重。
chapters.captionEn: A smooth stroke can still require different forces.

chapters.title: 茶轴的段落从哪来？
chapters.titleEn: Where the tactile bump comes from
chapters.caption: 轮廓越过弹片，阻力先升后降。
chapters.captionEn: The profile bends the leaf. Resistance rises, then falls.

chapters.title: 青轴多了一件会动的零件
chapters.caption: 白色套件快速跳移，形成发声事件。
chapters.captionEn: The white jacket jumps, creating a click event.

chapters.title: 触发，不必按到底
chapters.caption: 触发、触底和复位，是三个观察点。
chapters.captionEn: Actuation, bottom-out and reset are separate events.

chapters.title: 短行程与缓冲，是两种改变
chapters.caption: 银轴改变行程；静音轴缓和撞击。
chapters.captionEn: Silver shortens travel; damping softens impacts.

chapters.title: 磁轴把位置交给固件
chapters.caption: 持续测量位置，再按运动距离更新信号。
chapters.captionEn: Position sensing lets firmware follow small reversals.

chapters.title: 光轴仍有机械运动
chapters.caption: 轴心让光路接通，检测无需电触点。
chapters.captionEn: Stem movement opens a light path to the receiver.

chapters.title: 把三件事分开看
chapters.caption: 手感、声音、检测方式，分别比较。
chapters.captionEn: Compare feel, sound and sensing separately.

chapters.title: 一路走，一路换
chapters.caption: 同一部手机，一路上被交给了好几个小区。
chapters.captionEn: One phone on the move, handed from cell to cell.

chapters.title: 频谱有限，所以复用
chapters.caption: 每个小区都用同一段频率；基站越密，每人分得越多。
chapters.captionEn: Every cell reuses one carrier; denser sites mean bigger shares.

chapters.title: 边界来自信号强弱
chapters.caption: 哪个小区最强，哪里就归它；边界是比较出来的。
chapters.captionEn: Each spot belongs to its strongest cell; borders come from comparing.

chapters.title: 手机一直在听邻居
chapters.caption: 手机一直在测量服务小区和邻区的信号。
chapters.captionEn: The phone keeps measuring its serving cell and the neighbours.

chapters.title: 迟滞与触发时间
chapters.caption: 邻区强出 3 dB 并保持 320 毫秒才切换。
chapters.captionEn: A neighbour must lead by 3 dB for 320 ms before a handover.

chapters.title: 切换的那几十毫秒
chapters.caption: 报告、准备、命令、接入；空档里数据先转发。
chapters.captionEn: Report, prepare, command, access: data is forwarded in the gap.

chapters.title: 待机时，网络怎么找到你
chapters.caption: 待机时悄悄换小区，跨区才报到；来电分区寻呼。
chapters.captionEn: Idle phones reselect quietly, report new areas, and are paged by area.

chapters.title: 同一部手机，两种速度
chapters.caption: 速率盒：带宽 × 每格比特 × 层数
chapters.captionEn: The rate box: bandwidth × bits per element × layers.

chapters.title: 把频带切成子载波
chapters.caption: 子载波彼此重叠，却在对方中心为零
chapters.captionEn: Subcarriers overlap, yet each is zero at the others’ centres.

chapters.title: 信号越干净，装得越多
chapters.titleEn: A cleaner signal carries more bits
chapters.caption: 噪声越小，越能分清更密的星座点
chapters.captionEn: Less noise lets the receiver separate denser points.

chapters.title: 更宽的频带
chapters.caption: 4G 载波 20 MHz，5G 可到 100 MHz
chapters.captionEn: A 4G carrier is 20 MHz; one 5G mid-band carrier reaches 100 MHz.

chapters.title: 频率越高，越难穿透
chapters.caption: 阵列补回毫米波损耗，却穿不过墙
chapters.captionEn: An array wins back millimetre-wave loss, but walls still block it.

chapters.title: 天线阵列对准你
chapters.titleEn: An antenna array aims at you
chapters.caption: 逐个错开相位，能量汇成波束
chapters.captionEn: Staggering each element’s phase gathers energy into a beam.

chapters.title: 多路并行与更短时隙
chapters.caption: 空间上并行几层，时间上切短时隙
chapters.captionEn: Parallel layers in space; shorter slots in time.

chapters.title: 速度不只取决于 5G
chapters.caption: 分享、位置与回传一起决定速度
chapters.captionEn: Sharing, your position and backhaul decide what you get.

chapters.title: 落地，开机
chapters.caption: 手机不选最强信号，先看 SIM 里的伙伴名单。
chapters.captionEn: The phone follows the SIM's partner list, not the strongest signal.

chapters.title: SIM 卡里写着你是谁
chapters.titleEn: The SIM says who you are
chapters.caption: IMSI 前五位指明国家和运营商，K 不出卡。
chapters.captionEn: The first five IMSI digits name country and operator; K stays put.

chapters.title: 当地网络去问你家
chapters.caption: 当地网络经 IPX 向你家要认证数据。
chapters.captionEn: Over IPX, the local network asks your home for authentication data.

chapters.title: 不交出密钥也能证明
chapters.caption: SIM 算出的 RES 与家里的 XRES 一致。
chapters.captionEn: The SIM derives RES from K and RAND; it matches XRES.

chapters.title: 家里记下你在哪
chapters.caption: 家里记下你在 002-01，并下发签约数据。
chapters.captionEn: Home records you on 002-01 and sends your subscription.

chapters.title: 上网：绕回家，或就地出去
chapters.caption: 绕回家出口更慢，就地出口更快但地址不同。
chapters.captionEn: Home routing adds distance; local breakout is faster but looks local.

chapters.title: 有人给你打电话
chapters.caption: 来电先到家，再转到你所在的网络。
chapters.captionEn: A call reaches home first, then is forwarded to where you are.

chapters.title: 同一道题
chapters.caption: 三种安排，输入和权重保持相同。
chapters.captionEn: Three schedules keep the same inputs and weights.

chapters.title: CPU：跟着程序走
chapters.caption: CPU 按程序乘加，再决定写入哪个值。
chapters.captionEn: The CPU chooses what to execute and what to write.

chapters.title: GPU：同指令，多数据
chapters.caption: GPU 的通道执行同一指令，各自保留数据身份。
chapters.captionEn: One instruction updates four lanes with their own data.

chapters.title: 分支，让部分通道等待
chapters.caption: Y13 为负：先等待，再单独写零。
chapters.captionEn: Y13 is negative: it waits, then writes zero.

chapters.title: NPU：让数据流过阵列
chapters.titleEn: NPU: stream data through an array
chapters.caption: 输入向右、权重向下；每个交点保留部分和。
chapters.captionEn: Inputs move right; weights move down; each cell holds its sum.

chapters.title: 还要把数据送到
chapters.caption: 实际任务还取决于搬运、精度和算子支持。
chapters.captionEn: Transfers and supported operators are part of the task.

chapters.title: 结果一样，分工不同
chapters.caption: 十六个结果逐项相同；教学步数不是跑分。
chapters.captionEn: All sixteen results match. Teaching steps are not benchmarks.

chapters.title: 省掉卡槽，芯片还在
chapters.caption: eSIM 省掉拔插，安全硬件仍在。
chapters.captionEn: eSIM removes card swapping; secure hardware remains.

chapters.title: 扫码只拿到线索
chapters.caption: 激活码定位订阅，没有网络密钥。
chapters.captionEn: An activation code locates a subscription, not its network key.

chapters.title: 先确认双方身份
chapters.caption: 服务器与芯片互相证明身份。
chapters.captionEn: The server and chip prove their identities.

chapters.title: 封包绑定这一颗芯片
chapters.titleEn: A package bound to this chip
chapters.caption: 同一份封包给 B，不能安装。
chapters.captionEn: Copying the same bound package to B does not allow installation.

chapters.title: 安装不等于启用
chapters.caption: 完整安装以后，仍要单独启用。
chapters.captionEn: Complete installation still needs a separate enable step.

chapters.title: 同样的无线网络认证
chapters.caption: 换 profile 改变身份，天线没有变。
chapters.captionEn: Changing profiles changes identity; the antenna stays.

chapters.title: 焦点落在前面
chapters.caption: 焦点在视网膜前，接收时已散开。
chapters.captionEn: The rays focus before the retina, then spread.

chapters.title: 先把图像看清
chapters.caption: 负光焦度把清晰焦点送回视网膜。
chapters.captionEn: Negative power returns the clear focus to the retina.

chapters.title: 镜片表面的另一层结构
chapters.caption: 中央矫正区周围，微透镜叠加正光焦度。
chapters.captionEn: Surrounding lenslets add positive power to the correction.

chapters.title: 同一光点，两种成分
chapters.caption: 入射角改变，选中的微透镜光才进入瞳孔。
chapters.captionEn: Changing incidence admits the selected lenslet bundle.

chapters.title: 近看两处真实会聚
chapters.caption: 矫正焦点留在视网膜，额外焦点在前方。
chapters.captionEn: The clear focus stays on the retina; the extra focus is forward.

chapters.title: 效果来自独立临床比较
chapters.caption: 两组仍在增长；图中是组平均，不是个人预测。
chapters.captionEn: Both groups grew; averages are not individual forecasts.

chapters.title: 清晰焦点与长期证据
chapters.caption: 计算解释光路；长期变化仍须研究与个体评估。
chapters.captionEn: Optics explains the rays; longer-term change needs evidence and assessment.

chapters.title: 同一镜头，两条路径
chapters.caption: 差别从镜头后开始：一条送光，一条送图像。
chapters.captionEn: One path carries light; the other carries an image.

chapters.title: 跟着光到眼睛
chapters.caption: 反光镜把光送向对焦屏，棱镜再折向目镜。
chapters.captionEn: The mirror sends light to the screen, prism and eye.

chapters.title: 镜子先让路
chapters.caption: 先抬镜、再开帘；取景中断发生在曝光之前。
chapters.captionEn: Mirror up first, then curtains open: optical viewing stops.

chapters.title: 单反也能实时取景
chapters.titleEn: A DSLR can use live view too
chapters.caption: 实时取景让镜子保持抬起，传感器信号送到后屏。
chapters.captionEn: A DSLR can raise its mirror and read the sensor live.

chapters.title: 显示屏发出新的光
chapters.caption: 无反先读传感器，再用显示屏重新发出取景图像。
chapters.captionEn: The sensor is read; a display emits a new viewing image.

chapters.title: 无反也可以有快门帘
chapters.caption: 没有反光镜，也可以用两片机械帘控制曝光。
chapters.captionEn: A mirrorless camera can use two mechanical curtains.

chapters.title: 把反光镜与快门分开
chapters.titleEn: Separate the mirror from the shutter
chapters.caption: 反光镜决定取景路线；快门方式是另一项选择。
chapters.captionEn: The mirror defines the camera type; shutters are separate.

chapters.title: 先记录光，还没成像
chapters.caption: 快门留下潜像；相纸尚未显出照片。
chapters.captionEn: Exposure leaves a latent image; development comes later.

chapters.title: 跟住同一张相纸
chapters.caption: 拨片启动走纸；滚轮接住同一张纸。
chapters.captionEn: A picker starts transport; rollers take the same sheet.

chapters.title: 药囊来到滚轮之间
chapters.caption: 两面挤压药囊，释放内部试剂。
chapters.captionEn: Two rollers compress the pod and release its reagent.

chapters.title: 铺出均匀的一层
chapters.caption: 前沿跟着走纸，试剂铺进层间。
chapters.captionEn: The front follows transport; reagent spreads between layers.

chapters.title: 暗房就在层间
chapters.caption: 曝光控制染料，接收层形成正像。
chapters.captionEn: Exposure controls dyes; the receiver forms a positive.

chapters.title: 成像还需要等待
chapters.caption: 成像时间被压缩；真实等待通常十到十五分钟。
chapters.captionEn: Time is compressed; real development typically takes ten to fifteen minutes.

chapters.title: 同一曝光，两种处理
chapters.caption: 污点周期留下缺口；清洁用于下一张。
chapters.captionEn: A repeating roller spot leaves defects; cleaning helps the next shot.

chapters.title: 跟住一把柔软的伞
chapters.caption: 推动月水母的是伞与水，不是触手划桨。
chapters.captionEn: The bell interacts with water; the tentacles are not oars.

chapters.title: 收缩，挤出水
chapters.caption: 伞下体积减少，出通量从同一形状算出。
chapters.captionEn: The cavity shrinks; outward flux comes from the same shape.

chapters.title: 水的运动卷成一圈
chapters.caption: 收缩附近形成起始涡，随后进入尾流。
chapters.captionEn: A starting vortex forms near contraction and enters the wake.

chapters.title: 回弹，把第二个涡带到伞下
chapters.caption: 伞展开时，反向旋转的停止涡来到伞下。
chapters.captionEn: Reopening brings the counter-rotating stopping vortex beneath the bell.

chapters.title: 伞静止后，还有推力
chapters.titleEn: Thrust after the bell becomes still
chapters.caption: 体积变化已为零，停止涡仍可诱导二次推力。
chapters.captionEn: Volume change is zero, yet the stopping vortex can provide secondary thrust.

chapters.title: 同动作，移除回收项
chapters.caption: 虚拟移除回收项；形变、初始状态和阻力相同。
chapters.captionEn: Virtual comparison: same motion and drag; recovery changes.

chapters.title: 一次脉动，三段因果
chapters.caption: 收缩、回弹和舒张后的流动，连成一个周期。
chapters.captionEn: Contraction, recoil and post-relaxation flow form one cycle.

chapters.title: 一台秤，两种测量
chapters.caption: 秤先测体重，再估计组成。
chapters.captionEn: Weight is measured; composition is estimated.

chapters.title: 重量先落在测力梁上
chapters.caption: 载荷增加，电桥输出随应变改变。
chapters.captionEn: Applied load changes strain and bridge voltage.

chapters.title: 两片送电流，两片测电压
chapters.caption: 电流闭合；电压由另一对电极采样。
chapters.captionEn: A closed current path; a separate voltage pair.

chapters.title: 一对波形，两种信息
chapters.caption: 幅比给出大小，相位区分电阻与电抗。
chapters.captionEn: Amplitude ratio and phase give complex impedance.

chapters.title: 频率改变可通过的支路
chapters.caption: 频率升高，膜电容支路更容易通过。
chapters.captionEn: Higher frequency admits more capacitive response.

chapters.title: 从电阻走到估计
chapters.caption: 水分与去脂体重来自模型假设。
chapters.captionEn: Water and fat-free mass depend on assumptions.

chapters.title: 脂肪不变，估计会变
chapters.caption: 脂肪质量固定，水分仍改变估计。
chapters.captionEn: Fat mass stays fixed while estimates move.

chapters.title: 组织自己发光
chapters.caption: 红外从组织出发，探头被动接收
chapters.captionEn: Infrared starts at the tissue; the probe receives it

chapters.title: 窄口决定看见哪里
chapters.titleEn: A narrow opening selects the view
chapters.caption: 接受路径先遇到哪块组织，就取样哪里
chapters.captionEn: Each accepted path samples the first tissue it meets

chapters.title: 把辐射变成小电压
chapters.titleEn: Turning radiation into a small voltage
chapters.caption: 窗口 → 通道 → 吸收膜 → 电信号
chapters.captionEn: Window → channel → absorber → electrical signal

chapters.title: 一条信号还不够
chapters.caption: 净信号变小，参考变暖，补偿读数保持
chapters.captionEn: Net signal falls; the reference warms; the reading holds

chapters.title: 已知温度作参照
chapters.titleEn: A known temperature provides a reference
chapters.caption: 已知黑体温度与信号建立对应关系
chapters.captionEn: Known blackbody temperature is related to the signal

chapters.title: 温度不变，朝向变了
chapters.caption: 偏转让视场更多接收耳道壁，读数随之改变
chapters.captionEn: Turning collects more canal-wall radiation and changes the reading

chapters.title: 一个数来自一整个视场
chapters.titleEn: One number comes from a whole view
chapters.caption: 朝向、辐射与参考共同决定这个示例数值
chapters.captionEn: Direction, radiation and reference together determine the example

chapters.title: 先认出直线
chapters.caption: 固定相机中，自由滑块匀速直行。
chapters.captionEn: The free puck moves straight at constant speed in the fixed view.

chapters.title: 相机跟着转盘
chapters.caption: 坐标轴转动，同一轨迹显出弯曲。
chapters.captionEn: Rotating coordinates make the same trajectory appear curved.

chapters.title: 把时刻配成一对
chapters.caption: 两台相机记录的是同一个时刻。
chapters.captionEn: Both cameras describe the puck at the same instant.

chapters.title: 只改变转速
chapters.caption: 同一释放条件，转速改变相对轨迹。
chapters.captionEn: Rotation rate changes the relative trail for the same release.

chapters.title: 反转转盘
chapters.caption: 反转角速度，中央释放的偏转镜像翻转。
chapters.captionEn: Reversing rotation mirrors the central release trail.

chapters.title: 离开中心释放
chapters.caption: 偏心释放继承转盘的切向速度。
chapters.captionEn: An off-centre release inherits tangential velocity.

chapters.title: 曲率需要两项
chapters.caption: 科里奥利项与离心项共同给出相对加速度。
chapters.captionEn: Coriolis and centrifugal terms together give relative acceleration.

chapters.title: 把旋转慢慢停下
chapters.caption: 旋转归零，两种观察连续重合。
chapters.captionEn: As rotation reaches zero, the two observations converge.

chapters.title: 新月为何错过太阳
chapters.caption: 新月附近，月球仍可能高于或低于太阳。
chapters.captionEn: At new moon, the Moon can still pass above or below the Sun.

chapters.title: 靠近轨道交点
chapters.caption: 月球靠近轨道交点时，高度差减小。
chapters.captionEn: Near an orbital node, the height difference becomes smaller.

chapters.title: 用两个视圆面判断
chapters.caption: 视半径与角距离共同决定遮挡。
chapters.captionEn: Apparent radii and angular separation determine overlap.

chapters.title: 追到影锥里面
chapters.caption: 本影内的观测点看见太阳完全被遮住。
chapters.captionEn: An observer within the umbra sees the Sun fully covered.

chapters.title: 同一天空，不同位置
chapters.caption: 移出本影，仍可能留在半影中。
chapters.captionEn: An observer can leave the umbra while remaining in the penumbra.

chapters.title: 月球稍远一些
chapters.caption: 月球视圆面变小，中心对齐也可能留下光环。
chapters.captionEn: A smaller apparent Moon can leave a ring even at alignment.

chapters.title: 看完一次穿越
chapters.caption: 同一尺寸下，偏食、全食、偏食依次出现。
chapters.captionEn: One crossing progresses from partial to total and back to partial.

chapters.title: 把条件重新拆开
chapters.caption: 相位、交点、视大小与观测位置缺一不可。
chapters.captionEn: Phase, node alignment, apparent size and observing position all matter.

chapters.title: 自己的节拍
chapters.caption: 松手后，物体按固有节拍振动。
chapters.captionEn: Release reveals the natural rhythm.

chapters.title: 慢慢推
chapters.caption: 推得太慢，振幅保持较小。
chapters.captionEn: A slow push gives a modest response.

chapters.title: 节拍接近
chapters.caption: 节拍接近，运动逐圈建立。
chapters.captionEn: Near the natural rhythm, motion builds.

chapters.title: 追踪能量
chapters.caption: 力与速度同向时，能量流入。
chapters.captionEn: Force along velocity supplies energy.

chapters.title: 加入阻尼
chapters.caption: 损失增多，稳定振幅下降。
chapters.captionEn: Greater losses reduce the steady motion.

chapters.title: 扫过频率
chapters.caption: 最大位移出现在固有频率附近。
chapters.captionEn: The largest response lies near the natural frequency.

chapters.title: 推得太快
chapters.caption: 推得太快，质量块难以跟随。
chapters.captionEn: A very fast push produces little displacement.

chapters.title: 回到共振
chapters.caption: 共振靠节拍积累，也受损失限制。
chapters.captionEn: Resonance accumulates energy and remains limited by loss.

chapters.title: 先留一个音
chapters.caption: 一个稳定频率，振幅保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: One steady frequency keeps a constant amplitude.

chapters.title: 加入同频
chapters.caption: 同频且同相，两波始终相加。
chapters.captionEn: Equal frequencies in phase keep reinforcing.

chapters.title: 只差一点
chapters.caption: 微小频差，让相位缓慢滑开。
chapters.captionEn: A small frequency difference creates a slow phase drift.

chapters.title: 走到同相
chapters.caption: 同向声压叠加，包络达到峰值。
chapters.captionEn: Aligned pressures produce a large envelope.

chapters.title: 走到反相
chapters.caption: 反向声压相抵，合成振幅变小。
chapters.captionEn: Opposing pressures reduce the combined amplitude.

chapters.title: 数慢节拍
chapters.caption: 每秒两次变强，对应 2 Hz 频差。
chapters.captionEn: Two swells per second match a 2 Hz difference.

chapters.title: 拉开频差
chapters.caption: 频差加倍，强弱起伏也加倍。
chapters.captionEn: Doubling the difference doubles the swelling rate.

chapters.title: 调回一致
chapters.caption: 越接近同频，拍越慢，最终消失。
chapters.captionEn: As frequencies agree, beats slow and disappear.

chapters.title: 拆开一列波
chapters.caption: 先跟住行波向前移动的波峰。
chapters.captionEn: First follow a crest traveling forward.

chapters.title: 加入返回波
chapters.caption: 相反方向的两波，共用频率与振幅。
chapters.captionEn: The opposite waves share frequency and amplitude.

chapters.title: 看见驻波
chapters.caption: 两波相加，形状只在原地起伏。
chapters.captionEn: Their sum oscillates without traveling crests.

chapters.title: 节点不走
chapters.caption: 节点在所有时刻都保持零位移。
chapters.captionEn: Nodes remain at zero displacement at every time.

chapters.title: 波腹与能量
chapters.caption: 波腹位移最大，能量在两种形式间交换。
chapters.captionEn: Antinodes move most as energy changes form.

chapters.title: 第二个模式
chapters.caption: 放进两个半波，增加一个内部节点。
chapters.captionEn: Two half-wavelengths add one internal node.

chapters.title: 第三个模式
chapters.caption: 三个半波对应第三谐波。
chapters.captionEn: Three half-wavelengths form the third harmonic.

chapters.title: 拉紧弦
chapters.caption: 张力增大，频率升高，节点位置不变。
chapters.captionEn: Higher tension raises frequency without moving the nodes.

chapters.title: 连续不等于记录
chapters.caption: 连续波只留下离散的点。
chapters.captionEn: A continuous wave leaves discrete samples.

chapters.title: 只看采样点
chapters.caption: 每秒八点，先记录两次起伏。
chapters.captionEn: Eight samples record two cycles per second.

chapters.title: 频率折回来
chapters.caption: 输入越过半采样率，频率折返。
chapters.captionEn: Frequency folds after half the sampling rate.

chapters.title: 两种解释
chapters.caption: 六赫兹与二赫兹留下相同记录。
chapters.captionEn: Six and two hertz leave the same record.

chapters.title: 加快采样钟
chapters.caption: 采样点变密，低频伪装消失。
chapters.captionEn: Denser sampling removes the false low frequency.

chapters.title: 恰好两倍的陷阱
chapters.caption: 恰好两倍，某些相位会全变零。
chapters.captionEn: At exactly twice, one phase can vanish.

chapters.title: 先过滤再记录
chapters.caption: 先移除高频，避免折成假低频。
chapters.captionEn: Remove high frequencies before they can fold.

chapters.title: 同样输入再比较
chapters.caption: 提高采样率，让两个分量都可辨。
chapters.captionEn: Raise the rate to retain both components.

chapters.title: 一条复杂的线
chapters.caption: 复杂波形来自几个简单分量。
chapters.captionEn: A complex trace can contain simple components.

chapters.title: 先取基础节奏
chapters.caption: 一赫兹分量只还原大轮廓。
chapters.captionEn: The one hertz term restores the broad shape.

chapters.title: 再加第三次
chapters.caption: 加入三赫兹，局部形状改变。
chapters.captionEn: Adding three hertz changes the smaller bends.

chapters.title: 完整重建
chapters.caption: 五赫兹补上剩下的细节。
chapters.captionEn: Five hertz supplies the remaining detail.

chapters.title: 用试探波提问
chapters.caption: 匹配的节奏累加，不匹配的抵消。
chapters.captionEn: Matching rhythms accumulate; others cancel.

chapters.title: 相位不是幅度
chapters.caption: 转动相位，幅度保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: Phase rotates while amplitude stays constant.

chapters.title: 移除一个分量
chapters.caption: 减弱三赫兹，波形随之改变。
chapters.captionEn: Reducing three hertz changes the waveform.

chapters.title: 窗口也会留下痕迹
chapters.caption: 非整数周期，让频谱向邻点扩散。
chapters.captionEn: A fractional cycle spreads across neighboring bins.

chapters.title: 每个字母一样长？
chapters.caption: 同一消息，先给每个字母三位。
chapters.captionEn: Start with three bits for every symbol.

chapters.title: 先数，再分配
chapters.caption: A 出现六次，D 只出现一次。
chapters.captionEn: A occurs six times; D occurs once.

chapters.title: 让最轻的两个先成为邻居
chapters.caption: 每次合并最小的两个权重。
chapters.captionEn: Repeatedly merge the two smallest weights.

chapters.title: 把路径写成零和一
chapters.titleEn: Write the path as zeros and ones
chapters.caption: 左走写 0，右走写 1。
chapters.captionEn: Write 0 for left and 1 for right.

chapters.title: 把整条消息穿过码树
chapters.caption: 同一字符，每次使用同一个码字。
chapters.captionEn: Every occurrence uses the same codeword.

chapters.title: 到叶子，就输出一个字
chapters.titleEn: At a leaf, emit one symbol
chapters.caption: 读到叶子后，回到根继续。
chapters.captionEn: Reach a leaf, emit, and restart at the root.

chapters.title: 省的是消息位数
chapters.caption: 42 位变成 28 位；码表另算。
chapters.captionEn: 42 message bits become 28; the codebook is extra.

chapters.title: 频数改变，树也改变
chapters.titleEn: Change the frequencies, change the tree
chapters.caption: 更短的码字，留给更常见的字符。
chapters.captionEn: Reserve shorter codewords for more frequent symbols.

chapters.title: 同一段文字，又出现了
chapters.caption: ABRA 再次出现，要再写一次吗？
chapters.captionEn: ABRA appears again. Must we write it again?

chapters.title: 记忆是有限的
chapters.caption: 只在当前指针后方的窗口里找。
chapters.captionEn: Search only the history behind the cursor.

chapters.title: 找出一段完全相同的字符
chapters.caption: 逐字相同，才能延长匹配。
chapters.captionEn: A match grows only while characters agree.

chapters.title: 一段重复，换成两个数
chapters.titleEn: Replace a repeated run with two numbers
chapters.caption: 引用写成：向后距离、复制长度。
chapters.captionEn: A reference contains backward distance and length.

chapters.title: 接收者只看自己的输出
chapters.titleEn: The decoder copies its own output
chapters.caption: 解码器不用提前知道后面的原文。
chapters.captionEn: The decoder needs no future original text.

chapters.title: 刚写下的，也能接着抄
chapters.titleEn: New output can immediately become a source
chapters.caption: 距离 2、长度 10，也能合法回抄。
chapters.captionEn: Distance 2, length 10 is a legal overlapping copy.

chapters.title: 窗口变小，重复也会错过
chapters.caption: 太远的旧片段，不能再被引用。
chapters.captionEn: A run outside the window cannot be referenced.

chapters.title: 更少的令牌，还要编码成位
chapters.titleEn: Tokens still need a bit representation
chapters.caption: 令牌减少，不等于文件按比例变小。
chapters.captionEn: Fewer tokens do not imply proportionally fewer bytes.

chapters.title: 静止的直杆
chapters.caption: 静止时，逐行记录仍然竖直。
chapters.captionEn: A stationary pole stays straight during a scan.

chapters.title: 每行有自己的时刻
chapters.titleEn: Each row has its own time
chapters.caption: 曝光窗口逐行错开。
chapters.captionEn: Each row has a later exposure window.

chapters.title: 直杆为什么倾斜
chapters.caption: 不同位置被拼进同一张照片。
chapters.captionEn: Different positions become one photograph.

chapters.title: 同一运动，两种曝光
chapters.caption: 全局曝光让所有行共享时刻。
chapters.captionEn: Global exposure gives every row the same window.

chapters.title: 快门更快为何仍歪
chapters.titleEn: Why a shorter exposure still leans
chapters.caption: 曝光变短，模糊减少，倾斜仍在。
chapters.captionEn: Shorter exposure reduces blur but preserves skew.

chapters.title: 真正缩短行间差
chapters.caption: 加快整帧扫描，倾斜减小。
chapters.captionEn: A faster full-frame scan reduces the lean.

chapters.title: 方向决定倾斜
chapters.caption: 运动反向，照片倾斜也反向。
chapters.captionEn: Reverse motion and the lean reverses.

chapters.title: 一瞬闪光，一条亮带
chapters.titleEn: One brief flash, one bright band
chapters.caption: 只有曝光重叠的行接到闪光。
chapters.captionEn: Only overlapping exposures receive the flash.

chapters.title: 扰动出发
chapters.caption: 传播的是扰动，物质点留在附近。
chapters.captionEn: The disturbance travels while matter stays nearby.

chapters.title: 沿传播方向
chapters.caption: P 波沿传播方向压缩与疏松。
chapters.captionEn: P waves compress and dilate along their path.

chapters.title: 跟住金点
chapters.caption: 金点来回运动，不随波前远行。
chapters.captionEn: The gold point oscillates rather than riding the front.

chapters.title: 换成剪切
chapters.caption: S 波垂直于传播方向摆动。
chapters.captionEn: S waves move across the propagation direction.

chapters.title: 先到与后到
chapters.caption: P 先到，S 后到，共用一个发震时刻。
chapters.captionEn: P arrives first and S later from the same event.

chapters.title: 台站移远
chapters.caption: 距离增加，P 与 S 的到时差扩大。
chapters.captionEn: A longer path widens the P–S interval.

chapters.title: 理想液体
chapters.caption: 没有剪切刚度，S 体波无法传播。
chapters.captionEn: Without shear rigidity, an S body wave cannot propagate.

chapters.title: 从运动读材料
chapters.caption: 运动方向与到时，共同揭示介质。
chapters.captionEn: Motion directions and arrival times reveal the medium.

chapters.title: 先看纯水
chapters.caption: 两侧相同，双向交换没有净流动。
chapters.captionEn: Identical sides exchange water without net flow.

chapters.title: 溶质留在一侧
chapters.caption: 溶质不能穿膜，水仍可以通过。
chapters.captionEn: Solute stays behind while water can cross.

chapters.title: 追踪穿膜的水
chapters.caption: 进入溶液的是水，溶质始终被保留。
chapters.captionEn: Water enters the solution while solute remains retained.

chapters.title: 液面开始分开
chapters.caption: 水进入溶液，液面升高且溶质被稀释。
chapters.captionEn: Incoming water raises and dilutes the solution.

chapters.title: 液柱推回去
chapters.caption: 液柱压差逐渐抵消渗透驱动。
chapters.captionEn: Hydrostatic head increasingly opposes osmosis.

chapters.title: 平衡仍在交换
chapters.caption: 净流动停止，两侧浓度仍可不同。
chapters.captionEn: Net flow stops even with unequal concentrations.

chapters.title: 增加溶质
chapters.caption: 更多溶质，需要更大的反向压力。
chapters.captionEn: More retained solute requires a larger opposing pressure.

chapters.title: 用压力反转
chapters.caption: 外压超过渗透驱动，净水流向反转。
chapters.captionEn: Sufficient external pressure reverses the net water flow.

chapters.title: 没有水泵的上升
chapters.caption: 相同液体，细管中的液柱更高。
chapters.captionEn: The narrower tube supports a taller liquid column.

chapters.title: 走近接触线
chapters.caption: 润湿形成凹液面，接触角从液体内测量。
chapters.captionEn: Wetting forms a concave meniscus with an internal contact angle.

chapters.title: 分解表面张力
chapters.caption: 沿接触线的张力，具有向上的分量。
chapters.captionEn: Surface tension has an upward component at the contact line.

chapters.title: 把管变细
chapters.caption: 半径减小，周长与面积的比例增大。
chapters.captionEn: A smaller radius increases circumference relative to area.

chapters.title: 重量建立平衡
chapters.caption: 液柱升高，重量逐渐平衡表面张力。
chapters.captionEn: The rising column gains weight until forces balance.

chapters.title: 改变界面性质
chapters.caption: 更大表面张力，能支撑更高液柱。
chapters.captionEn: Greater surface tension can support a taller column.

chapters.title: 跨过九十度
chapters.caption: 接触角超过 90°，竖直分量反向。
chapters.captionEn: Above 90 degrees, the vertical component reverses.

chapters.title: 回到高度
chapters.caption: 周长上的力，平衡截面积内的重量。
chapters.captionEn: Force around the rim balances weight across the area.

chapters.title: 先看完整颜色
chapters.caption: 测试图每个位置都有三种通道。
chapters.captionEn: The reference image has three channels at each site.

chapters.title: 一格一种滤片
chapters.caption: RGGB：一红、两绿、一蓝。
chapters.captionEn: RGGB repeats one red, two green and one blue.

chapters.title: 传感器真正留下什么
chapters.caption: 原始记录每格只有一个通道。
chapters.captionEn: Each raw site contains one measured channel.

chapters.title: 先补绿色
chapters.caption: 红格的绿色来自四个邻居。
chapters.captionEn: Estimate green at a red site from four neighbors.

chapters.title: 再补蓝色
chapters.caption: 蓝色来自四个对角邻居。
chapters.captionEn: Estimate blue from the four diagonal neighbors.

chapters.title: 把推断铺满整张图
chapters.caption: 保留实测值，补齐每格缺失通道。
chapters.captionEn: Keep measurements and fill each missing channel.

chapters.title: 细条纹会长出假色
chapters.titleEn: Fine stripes can create false color
chapters.caption: 原图无彩色，重建却可能偏色。
chapters.captionEn: An achromatic reference can reconstruct false color.

chapters.title: 移动一点，结果不同
chapters.titleEn: A tiny shift changes the result
chapters.caption: 亚像素平移，改变取样与假色。
chapters.captionEn: A subpixel shift changes samples and false color.

chapters.title: 发射一个有长度的脉冲
chapters.caption: 脉冲前进，宽度对应一段空间。
chapters.captionEn: A finite pulse occupies a length in space.

chapters.title: 同一脉冲返回
chapters.caption: 回波还要走完回程。
chapters.captionEn: The echo must also travel back.

chapters.title: 为什么要除以二
chapters.caption: 往返计时除以二，才是目标距离。
chapters.captionEn: Halve the round-trip distance to get target range.

chapters.title: 目标移远
chapters.caption: 距离增加，回波在时间轴后移。
chapters.captionEn: A farther target shifts its echo later in time.

chapters.title: 两个目标挤在一起
chapters.caption: 长脉冲的两个回波相互覆盖。
chapters.captionEn: Long-pulse echoes from nearby targets overlap.

chapters.title: 缩短脉冲
chapters.caption: 脉冲变短，相邻回波分开。
chapters.captionEn: Shorter pulses separate the nearby echoes.

chapters.title: 近处也可能看不全
chapters.titleEn: A nearby echo can be obscured
chapters.caption: 近回波前缘落入发射遮挡期。
chapters.captionEn: A near echo begins while the receiver is blanked.

chapters.title: 回波属于哪次发射
chapters.caption: 晚回波可能被下一次发射误计时。
chapters.captionEn: A late echo may be timed from the next pulse.

chapters.title: 一束光只测一个方向
chapters.caption: 射线先碰到的表面给出距离。
chapters.captionEn: The first surface sets the measured range.

chapters.title: 计时得到半程距离
chapters.caption: 收到回波，往返时间换成距离。
chapters.captionEn: Convert the returning pulse time into range.

chapters.title: 方向与距离变成点
chapters.titleEn: Convert direction and range to a point
chapters.caption: 距离与角度，确定平面坐标。
chapters.captionEn: Range and angle determine a planar point.

chapters.title: 把许多方向拼起来
chapters.titleEn: Build a scan from many directions
chapters.caption: 逐个方向测量，积成一圈点云。
chapters.captionEn: Measurements across directions form a point cloud.

chapters.title: 角度间隔决定稀密
chapters.caption: 角度采得更密，轮廓点也更密。
chapters.captionEn: Smaller angular steps produce denser contours.

chapters.title: 看不见遮挡背后
chapters.caption: 光被挡住，后墙不产生返回点。
chapters.captionEn: An occluded wall produces no first-return point.

chapters.title: 纳秒误差变成散点
chapters.caption: 计时抖动，让点沿射线散开。
chapters.captionEn: Timing jitter spreads points along their rays.

chapters.title: 没有点不等于没有物体
chapters.titleEn: No return is not no object
chapters.caption: 弱回波低于阈值，物体仍然存在。
chapters.captionEn: A weak return can disappear while the object remains.

chapters.title: 一块记不住名字的记忆
chapters.caption: 32 个位，起初全是 0。
chapters.captionEn: Thirty-two bits begin at zero.

chapters.title: 一个键，点亮几个位置
chapters.caption: apple 的三个哈希地址置为 1。
chapters.captionEn: Set the three hash positions for apple.

chapters.title: 不同名字，可以共用记号
chapters.titleEn: Different keys can share a mark
chapters.caption: 插入新键，不清除任何旧的 1。
chapters.captionEn: Insertion sets bits without clearing old ones.

chapters.title: 把同一个键再问一遍
chapters.caption: 三个位置都是 1，只能说可能有。
chapters.captionEn: All queried positions are one: possibly present.

chapters.title: 一个零，就足够否定
chapters.titleEn: One zero is enough to reject
chapters.caption: 至少一个位置是 0：确定没有。
chapters.captionEn: At least one position is zero: definitely absent.

chapters.title: 每个记号都在，名字却没来过
chapters.titleEn: Every mark is present, but the key is new
chapters.caption: 真实集合没有它，检查位置却全是 1。
chapters.captionEn: The key is absent, yet all its positions are one.

chapters.title: 把一个键的位清零，会误伤谁？
chapters.titleEn: What breaks if we clear a key’s bits?
chapters.caption: 共享位被清零，另一个已插入键被误判。
chapters.captionEn: Clearing shared bits creates a false negative.

chapters.title: 一越来越多，区分能力越来越少
chapters.caption: 阵列逐渐填满，误报更容易发生。
chapters.captionEn: As the array fills, false positives become easier.

chapters.title: 先给字节一个位置
chapters.caption: A 到 F 各占 100 字节，序号不随路径改变。
chapters.captionEn: A–F each span 100 bytes; sequence ranges stay fixed.

chapters.title: 确认的是连续前缀
chapters.titleEn: An ACK confirms a continuous prefix
chapters.caption: ACK 1100：下一期待字节是 1100。
chapters.captionEn: ACK 1100 means byte 1100 is expected next.

chapters.title: 先到，不代表先交付
chapters.titleEn: Arrival order is not delivery order
chapters.caption: C、D 先到，等待 B 补齐缺口。
chapters.captionEn: C and D arrive early and wait for B.

chapters.title: 这次，B 真的没有到
chapters.caption: B 丢了；后续数据停在缺口后。
chapters.captionEn: B is lost; later data waits behind the gap.

chapters.title: 用原来的序号再发一次
chapters.caption: 缺口补齐，累计确认向前跳。
chapters.captionEn: Fill the gap and the cumulative ACK advances.

chapters.title: 数据到了，确认却丢了
chapters.titleEn: The data arrives but its ACK is lost
chapters.caption: 重复数据可以重到，应用只读一次。
chapters.captionEn: Data may arrive twice; the application reads it once.

chapters.title: 别把未确认的数据无限发出去
chapters.caption: 确认前，最多保留两个未确认段。
chapters.captionEn: At most two segments remain unacknowledged here.

chapters.title: 把不可靠的抵达，变成有序的读取
chapters.titleEn: Turn imperfect arrivals into ordered reads
chapters.caption: 完整字节流，按原序且不重复。
chapters.captionEn: The complete byte stream is ordered and duplicate-free.

chapters.title: 多发，不会让出口变宽
chapters.titleEn: Sending more does not widen the exit
chapters.caption: 出口每轮只服务四个包。
chapters.captionEn: The bottleneck serves four packets per round.

chapters.title: 拥挤先藏在等待里
chapters.caption: 缓存增长，等待增加；满了才溢出。
chapters.captionEn: A growing queue adds delay, then overflows.

chapters.title: 先用确认探路
chapters.caption: 窗口从 1、2、4 向上试探。
chapters.captionEn: The window probes upward: 1, 2, 4.

chapters.title: 溢出后，必须改变发送决定
chapters.titleEn: A loss must change the sending decision
chapters.caption: 检测到溢出，回退到在途量的一半。
chapters.captionEn: Detected overflow reduces the window to half the flight.

chapters.title: 靠近容量后，小步增加
chapters.titleEn: Near capacity, grow in smaller steps
chapters.caption: 每个新确认，窗口只增加约 1/W。
chapters.captionEn: Each new ACK adds approximately 1/W.

chapters.title: 小增，大退
chapters.caption: 加性增加，乘性回退，形成锯齿。
chapters.captionEn: Additive increase and multiplicative decrease form a sawtooth.

chapters.title: 把缓存变大，会怎样？
chapters.titleEn: What changes when the buffer grows?
chapters.caption: 出口仍是四个包，缓存从 4 增到 12。
chapters.captionEn: Service stays at four while buffer size grows from 4 to 12.

chapters.title: 反馈的价值，是少做无效工作
chapters.caption: 同一出口下，对比响应反馈与固定窗口。
chapters.captionEn: Compare feedback with a fixed window at the same exit.

chapters.title: 机器数一变，取模结果大变
chapters.titleEn: Changing the modulus changes many owners
chapters.caption: 3 台变 4 台，许多取模归属改变。
chapters.captionEn: Three nodes become four, remapping many modulo owners.

chapters.title: 把哈希空间绕成一个环
chapters.titleEn: Wrap the hash space into a ring
chapters.caption: 从键的位置顺时针找第一个节点。
chapters.captionEn: Find the first node clockwise from the key.

chapters.title: 经过终点，仍然接得上
chapters.caption: 经过 100%，继续从 0% 顺时针找。
chapters.captionEn: After 100%, continue clockwise from zero.

chapters.title: 加入 D，只接管它前面的弧段
chapters.titleEn: D takes only its predecessor interval
chapters.caption: 已有位置不动；部分键改归 D。
chapters.captionEn: Existing positions stay fixed; some keys move to D.

chapters.title: 拿走 C，只有它的键找新家
chapters.titleEn: Remove C and reassign only its keys
chapters.caption: 原来归 C 的键，交给新的顺时针后继。
chapters.captionEn: Only C’s former keys need a new successor.

chapters.title: 环很稳定，份额却未必平均
chapters.titleEn: A stable ring can still be uneven
chapters.caption: 随机弧段不等长，键的负载也不保证相等。
chapters.captionEn: Random arcs need not be equal, and key loads can differ.

chapters.title: 让每个节点拥有多段份额
chapters.titleEn: Give each node several separate intervals
chapters.caption: 每台机器映射成 8 个虚拟位置。
chapters.captionEn: Each machine receives eight virtual positions.

chapters.title: 多段接管，仍然保持局部迁移
chapters.titleEn: Several tokens still preserve local migration
chapters.caption: D 的多个位置，只接走各自前驱区间。
chapters.captionEn: D’s tokens take only their own predecessor intervals.

chapters.title: 两种相反的转动趋势
chapters.caption: 相同力臂，用相同的力平衡。
chapters.captionEn: Equal moment arms need equal forces.

chapters.title: 把用力点移远
chapters.caption: 距离翻倍，平衡所需的力减半。
chapters.captionEn: Twice the radius needs half the effort.

chapters.title: 力臂要垂直量
chapters.caption: 连接点不动，倾斜的力仍会失去力矩。
chapters.captionEn: Tilting the force reduces its moment.

chapters.title: 把失去的力矩补回来
chapters.caption: 力臂减半，力要加倍才能重新平衡。
chapters.captionEn: Half the moment arm requires twice the force.

chapters.title: 作用线穿过支点
chapters.caption: 沿杆推，力再大也没有这个方向的力矩。
chapters.captionEn: A force through the pivot produces no moment.

chapters.title: 省力，也要多走一段
chapters.caption: 一半的力走两倍距离，输入功没有减少。
chapters.captionEn: Half the force moves twice as far.

chapters.title: 一个问题，两种服务
chapters.caption: 应用等待答案，解析器负责追踪。
chapters.captionEn: The application waits; the resolver follows the trail.

chapters.title: 根知道下一站
chapters.titleEn: The root knows a next step
chapters.caption: 根返回转介，不替解析器转发。
chapters.captionEn: The root returns a referral to the resolver.

chapters.title: 再靠近一个区域
chapters.caption: 顶级域指出 orchid.test 的权威。
chapters.captionEn: The TLD identifies orchid.test’s authority.

chapters.title: 地址终于出现
chapters.caption: 权威应答带回地址和 60 秒 TTL。
chapters.captionEn: The authority returns an address with a 60-second TTL.

chapters.title: 命中不会重置时钟
chapters.titleEn: A hit does not restart the clock
chapters.caption: 20 秒后，地址还剩 40 秒。
chapters.captionEn: After 20 seconds, the address has 40 seconds left.

chapters.title: 只重查过期的那条
chapters.caption: 地址过期，仍可直达已知权威。
chapters.captionEn: The address expires; the known authority remains usable.

chapters.title: 两束反射
chapters.caption: 改变膜厚，两束光的相对相位在变。
chapters.captionEn: Thickness changes the relative phase of the reflected light.

chapters.title: 零厚度的暗
chapters.caption: 光程差趋近零，反射相位仍差半周。
chapters.captionEn: The path difference vanishes, but the reflection phase does not.

chapters.title: 四分之一波膜
chapters.caption: 2nd 为半个波长，补偿了反射的半周差。
chapters.captionEn: A half-wavelength round trip compensates the reflection reversal.

chapters.title: 继续加厚又变暗
chapters.caption: 再多半周，增强变成抵消。
chapters.captionEn: Another half cycle turns reinforcement into cancellation.

chapters.title: 换掉背面
chapters.caption: 两次反射都翻转，亮暗条件随之互换。
chapters.captionEn: When both reflections reverse, the bright and dark conditions swap.

chapters.title: 白光中的色带
chapters.caption: 同一膜厚，对不同波长给出不同相位。
chapters.captionEn: One thickness gives different phases to different wavelengths.

chapters.title: 定滑轮只改变方向
chapters.caption: 一段绳托住负载，仍需同样大的力。
chapters.captionEn: One supporting strand needs the full load force.

chapters.title: 让轮子跟着负载走
chapters.titleEn: Move a pulley with the load
chapters.caption: 两段绳各拉六十牛顿，共同托住负载。
chapters.captionEn: Two strands share the supporting force.

chapters.title: 两段绳同时缩短
chapters.caption: 负载升一段，自由端要拉出两段。
chapters.captionEn: The free end travels twice as far as the load.

chapters.title: 四段绳共同承重
chapters.caption: 四段各三十牛顿，不是数所有轮子。
chapters.captionEn: Four strands carry thirty newtons each.

chapters.title: 拉力和路程一起算
chapters.caption: 拉力剩四分之一，拉绳距离变成四倍。
chapters.captionEn: One quarter of the force travels four times as far.

chapters.title: 移动的轮组也有重量
chapters.titleEn: The moving block also has weight
chapters.caption: 加入轮组自重，绳子必须一起托住它。
chapters.captionEn: The rope also supports the moving block itself.

chapters.title: 最短的一步，不是最短的路
chapters.titleEn: The cheapest step is not the cheapest route
chapters.caption: 局部短边走出 13，另一条路只需 7。
chapters.captionEn: Cheap local edges cost 13; another route costs 7.

chapters.title: 所有候选从同一起点计算
chapters.titleEn: Every candidate starts at the same source
chapters.caption: A 暂定 2，B 暂定 5。
chapters.captionEn: A has tentative distance 2; B has 5.

chapters.title: 第一次抵达，还不能定案
chapters.caption: T 的第一个已知代价是 22。
chapters.captionEn: The first known route to T costs 22.

chapters.title: 跨回全局队列
chapters.caption: C 之后选 B：比较的是 5、12、13。
chapters.captionEn: After C, choose B: compare 5, 12 and 13.

chapters.title: 同一终点，再次被改小
chapters.caption: B 把 D 改为 6，D 把 T 改为 7。
chapters.captionEn: B improves D to 6; D improves T to 7.

chapters.title: 最低暂定值成为确定值
chapters.titleEn: The least tentative value becomes final
chapters.caption: T 现在以 7 定案。
chapters.captionEn: T can now be settled at 7.

chapters.title: 拆掉非负这个前提
chapters.caption: 负边可以推翻已经定案的 2。
chapters.captionEn: A negative edge can overturn a settled value of 2.

chapters.title: 光线在孔口交叉
chapters.caption: 同一物点的方向穿过小孔，像上下颠倒。
chapters.captionEn: Rays from each point cross the hole and form an inverted image.

chapters.title: 一个点变成一个斑
chapters.caption: 孔径有限，同一物点会照亮一片区域。
chapters.captionEn: A finite opening sends one object point to a finite patch.

chapters.title: 缩孔也少了光
chapters.titleEn: A smaller hole admits less light
chapters.caption: 孔径减半，进入的光功率约为四分之一。
chapters.captionEn: Halving diameter reduces admitted light power to about one quarter.

chapters.title: 很小的孔会衍射
chapters.caption: 继续缩孔，衍射扩展的尺度反而增大。
chapters.captionEn: Shrinking further increases the diffraction spreading scale.

chapters.title: 比较两种模糊
chapters.caption: 几何斑与衍射尺度要一起考虑。
chapters.captionEn: Geometric and diffraction spreading must be considered together.

chapters.title: 移动接收屏
chapters.caption: 屏距增大，倒像放大，模糊尺度也改变。
chapters.captionEn: Increasing screen distance enlarges the inverted image and changes blur.

chapters.title: 零读数发生在哪里
chapters.caption: 检流计读零，电源仍有电流。
chapters.captionEn: The detector reads zero while the supply delivers current.

chapters.title: 比较的是两个中点
chapters.caption: A 与 B 都是二点五伏，没有差值驱动检流计。
chapters.captionEn: Both midpoints are at 2.5 volts.

chapters.title: 只改变一个电阻
chapters.caption: R4 改变，B 的电势偏离 A。
chapters.captionEn: Changing R4 moves B away from A.

chapters.title: 用比例恢复零点
chapters.caption: R2 也按相同比例改变，两个中点重新相等。
chapters.captionEn: Matching the branch ratios restores the null.

chapters.title: 电源变化，零点不变
chapters.caption: 相同比例保持平衡，支路电流仍随电源变化。
chapters.captionEn: The null stays while branch currents change.

chapters.title: 仪表也属于电路
chapters.titleEn: The instrument is part of the circuit
chapters.caption: 失衡时，检流计电阻会改变被测电势差。
chapters.captionEn: Away from balance, detector resistance changes the measured difference.

chapters.title: 接通的第一瞬间
chapters.caption: 空电容电压为零，初始电流由电阻限制。
chapters.captionEn: The resistor limits the initial charging current.

chapters.title: 五伏在两处重新分配
chapters.caption: 电容电压增加，留给电阻的电压减少。
chapters.captionEn: As capacitor voltage rises, resistor voltage falls.

chapters.title: 一个时间常数还没充满
chapters.titleEn: One time constant is not full
chapters.caption: 一秒到百分之六十三，五秒接近百分之九十九。
chapters.captionEn: One second reaches 63%; five seconds approaches 99%.

chapters.title: 同一秒，换一只电阻
chapters.titleEn: Change resistance at the same time
chapters.caption: 电阻更大，初始电流更小，同一秒充得更慢。
chapters.captionEn: More resistance reduces initial current and slows the rise.

chapters.title: 换电容，初始电流不变
chapters.caption: 更大电容需要更多电荷，初始电流仍由电阻决定。
chapters.captionEn: More capacitance needs more charge for each volt.

chapters.title: 移除电源，电流反向
chapters.caption: 电容保持初始电压，通过电阻释放储能。
chapters.captionEn: The charged capacitor drives current in reverse.

chapters.title: 电源的能量去了哪里
chapters.caption: 电源供能等于电场储能加电阻热量。
chapters.captionEn: Source energy becomes field energy and heat.

chapters.title: 固定的位置
chapters.caption: 端点被加热，晶格位置没有沿杆迁移。
chapters.captionEn: Heating an end does not carry the lattice sites along the rod.

chapters.title: 温度梯度与通量
chapters.caption: 相邻段温度不同，就有净能量通量。
chapters.captionEn: Neighbouring temperature differences produce a net energy flux.

chapters.title: 稳定不等于停止
chapters.caption: 温度剖面稳定后，流入与流出仍可同时非零。
chapters.captionEn: A steady temperature profile can carry nonzero inflow and outflow.

chapters.title: 改变导热率
chapters.caption: 相同温差与杆长下，提高导热率会增大传热。
chapters.captionEn: At the same length and temperature difference, higher conductivity increases transfer.

chapters.title: 改变传导距离
chapters.caption: 同温差下，较长的路径降低稳态温度梯度。
chapters.captionEn: A longer path reduces the steady gradient at the same temperature difference.

chapters.title: 均匀才是平衡
chapters.caption: 整根杆同温，净传导通量为零。
chapters.captionEn: When the whole rod is uniform, net conductive flux vanishes.

chapters.title: 反转梯度
chapters.caption: 交换冷热端，净通量方向反转。
chapters.captionEn: Exchanging the hot and cold ends reverses the net flux.

chapters.title: 先让冰升温
chapters.caption: 相变之前，输入能量使冰的温度上升。
chapters.captionEn: Before melting, added energy raises the ice temperature.

chapters.title: 平台不是停电
chapters.titleEn: A plateau is not a power cut
chapters.caption: 温度保持零度，液态比例仍不断增加。
chapters.captionEn: Temperature remains at zero while the liquid fraction grows.

chapters.title: 在中途查账
chapters.caption: 相变能量等于已经融化的质量乘熔化潜热。
chapters.captionEn: Phase-change energy equals melted mass times latent heat of fusion.

chapters.title: 融完以后再升温
chapters.caption: 最后一份冰融完，新增能量再次使温度升高。
chapters.captionEn: After the last ice melts, additional energy raises temperature again.

chapters.title: 功率改变的是用时
chapters.caption: 到达相同能量与相态，更大功率所需时间更短。
chapters.captionEn: Higher power reaches the same energy and phase state sooner.

chapters.title: 反向释放潜热
chapters.caption: 移出能量时，液态比例减少，平台仍可存在。
chapters.captionEn: Removing energy reduces liquid fraction while the plateau can persist.

chapters.title: 先看圆的特例
chapters.caption: 圆上等时间，也对应等角度。
chapters.captionEn: On a circle, equal time also gives equal angle.

chapters.title: 焦点不是几何中心
chapters.titleEn: The focus is not the center
chapters.caption: 椭圆中心与引力焦点分开了。
chapters.captionEn: The geometric center and gravitational focus separate.

chapters.title: 近处加速，远处减速
chapters.caption: 距离与速度由同一个轨道状态给出。
chapters.captionEn: Distance and speed come from the same orbital state.

chapters.title: 让两只时钟一起走
chapters.caption: 两块形状不同的区域，同步扫过等面积。
chapters.captionEn: Different-shaped sectors sweep equal areas together.

chapters.title: 换形状，不换等时规则
chapters.titleEn: Change the shape, keep the timing rule
chapters.caption: 偏心率改变形状，等时面积仍然相等。
chapters.captionEn: Eccentricity changes the shape, while equal-time areas remain equal.

chapters.title: 放大轨道，周期才跟着变
chapters.titleEn: A larger orbit changes the period
chapters.caption: 半长轴 1.6 倍，对应周期约 2.02 倍。
chapters.captionEn: A semi-major axis of 1.6 gives about 2.02 times the period.

chapters.title: 先数原来的总体
chapters.caption: 一万张纸签中，一千张属于蓝色组。
chapters.captionEn: Of ten thousand tickets, one thousand are blue.

chapters.title: 同样星标，两种来源
chapters.caption: 800 张蓝色纸签与 900 张非蓝纸签有星标。
chapters.captionEn: 800 blue tickets and 900 non-blue tickets have stars.

chapters.title: 证据重新圈定总体
chapters.caption: 不符合证据的纸签暂时退出比较。
chapters.captionEn: Set aside tickets that do not match the evidence.

chapters.title: 换分母，再问颜色
chapters.titleEn: Change the denominator, then ask about color
chapters.caption: 星标总体中的蓝色比例为 800 / 1700。
chapters.captionEn: Within starred tickets, the blue fraction is 800 / 1700.

chapters.title: 只改基准率
chapters.caption: 蓝色变少，同样的星标规则给出约 7.5%。
chapters.captionEn: A rarer blue group gives about 7.5% under the same marking rule.

chapters.title: 再看一次，不一定是新证据
chapters.titleEn: A second look need not be new evidence
chapters.caption: 重复同一证据不变；条件独立的新证据才再更新。
chapters.captionEn: A repeated mark adds no evidence; a new one can.

chapters.title: 先固定搬运目标
chapters.caption: 同一个一百二十牛顿负载，升高一米。
chapters.captionEn: Raise the same 120 N load by one metre.

chapters.title: 换一条更长的路
chapters.caption: 三十度无摩擦斜面：六十牛顿，走两米。
chapters.captionEn: A frictionless 30° ramp needs 60 N over two metres.

chapters.title: 只改变坡度
chapters.caption: 同一高度，坡越缓，路径越长。
chapters.captionEn: A shallower route to the same height is longer.

chapters.title: 把整段路程算进去
chapters.caption: 理想斜面没有减少提升所需的功。
chapters.captionEn: The ideal ramp does not reduce the lifting work.

chapters.title: 给接触面加上摩擦
chapters.caption: 拉力还要克服摩擦，输入功开始超过势能增加。
chapters.captionEn: Friction makes input work exceed the potential-energy gain.

chapters.title: 缓坡的另一笔账
chapters.titleEn: The other cost of a shallow ramp
chapters.caption: 有摩擦时，更省力的缓坡可能更费功。
chapters.captionEn: A shallower rough ramp can need less force but more work.

chapters.title: 转一圈，升一个导程
chapters.caption: 旋转与轴向位移由同一条螺旋约束。
chapters.captionEn: The helix couples rotation to axial travel.

chapters.title: 把螺旋的一圈展开
chapters.caption: 一圈圆周距离，对应很小的轴向升高。
chapters.captionEn: A full circumference produces a small axial rise.

chapters.title: 理想情况下的功
chapters.caption: 小力矩转过大角度，仍要付出提升重物的功。
chapters.captionEn: Small torque through a large angle supplies the lifting work.

chapters.title: 把导程加倍
chapters.caption: 相同圈数升得更高，也需要更大的理想力矩。
chapters.captionEn: More lead gives more lift and requires more ideal torque.

chapters.title: 接触摩擦要付出能量
chapters.caption: 摩擦增加提升力矩，额外输入变成热。
chapters.captionEn: Thread friction adds torque and dissipates energy.

chapters.title: 自锁有一个条件
chapters.caption: 摩擦不足时，负载可能反向驱动丝杆。
chapters.captionEn: With insufficient friction, the load can back-drive the screw.

chapters.title: 圆盘先绕圆心转
chapters.caption: 没有偏心，转动不会带来升降。
chapters.captionEn: With no offset, rotation produces no lift.

chapters.title: 把转轴移离圆心
chapters.caption: 偏心距八毫米，完整升降行程十六毫米。
chapters.captionEn: An eight-millimetre offset gives a sixteen-millimetre stroke.

chapters.title: 跟住真实接触点
chapters.caption: 有限半径滚子与凸轮始终沿两圆心连线接触。
chapters.captionEn: Two-circle tangency locates the actual contact.

chapters.title: 匀速输入，非匀速输出
chapters.caption: 升降方向改变之前，滚子速度先经过零。
chapters.captionEn: Follower speed passes through zero at each reversal.

chapters.title: 凸轮不能隔空往下拉
chapters.titleEn: A cam cannot pull across a gap
chapters.caption: 高速、无弹簧时，滚子会离开凸轮。
chapters.captionEn: At high speed without a spring, contact is lost.

chapters.title: 相同转速，加上预压弹簧
chapters.titleEn: Keep the speed and add preload
chapters.caption: 弹簧提供向下作用力，让这一组参数保持接触。
chapters.captionEn: A preloaded spring maintains contact for these parameters.

chapters.title: 先保留所有可能
chapters.caption: 候选区间按索引连续，数值已经有序。
chapters.captionEn: The candidate interval is contiguous by index, and values are sorted.

chapters.title: 小于目标，整段都能排除
chapters.titleEn: Too small excludes a whole prefix
chapters.caption: 29 小于 37，所以索引 0–7 都不可能。
chapters.captionEn: 29 is below 37, so indices 0–7 cannot match.

chapters.title: 大于目标，收回另一侧
chapters.caption: 46 大于 37，候选区间缩到索引 8–10。
chapters.captionEn: 46 exceeds 37; candidates shrink to indices 8–10.

chapters.title: 三次比较，命中索引九
chapters.caption: 37 与目标相等，查找结束。
chapters.captionEn: 37 equals the target, so the search ends.

chapters.title: 不存在，也要有明确结果
chapters.caption: 找 38 时，最终 low 大于 high。
chapters.captionEn: Searching for 38 ends with low greater than high.

chapters.title: 乱序会毁掉舍弃的理由
chapters.titleEn: Unsorted input destroys the exclusion proof
chapters.caption: 索引 1 的 37 暴露了错误舍弃。
chapters.captionEn: The 37 at index 1 exposes an invalid exclusion.

chapters.title: 先跟踪同一批对象
chapters.titleEn: Keep track of the same items
chapters.caption: 值可以重复，编号始终保留身份。
chapters.captionEn: Values may repeat; item numbers preserve identity.

chapters.title: 一个元素，已经有序
chapters.caption: 把原数带拆成单项有序段。
chapters.captionEn: Split the input into one-item sorted runs.

chapters.title: 小段合成较大的段
chapters.titleEn: Make a larger run from smaller runs
chapters.caption: 比较头部，把较小的一项送入输出。
chapters.captionEn: Compare the heads and emit the smaller item.

chapters.title: 相等时，稳定性由规则决定
chapters.caption: 两个 3 相等时，先取编号 2。
chapters.captionEn: When the two 3s tie, take original item 2 first.

chapters.title: 头部之后不会藏更小的值
chapters.titleEn: No smaller item hides behind a sorted head
chapters.caption: 两个有序段，逐项合成完整结果。
chapters.captionEn: Merge the two sorted runs into the complete result.

chapters.title: 一个藏起来的 2
chapters.caption: 乱序段会让只看头部的推理失效。
chapters.captionEn: An unsorted run invalidates head-only selection.

chapters.title: 选一个比较基准
chapters.caption: 主元 3 把关系分成小于、等于、大于。
chapters.captionEn: Pivot 3 separates below, equal and above.

chapters.title: 换到右边，指针先别走
chapters.titleEn: Swap right, but keep the scan
chapters.caption: 6 送往右段，换来的 3 仍待检查。
chapters.captionEn: 6 moves right; the incoming 3 still needs inspection.

chapters.title: 较小项穿过等值区
chapters.titleEn: Move a smaller item through the equal region
chapters.caption: 2 到左边界，lt 与 i 一起前进。
chapters.captionEn: 2 reaches the left boundary; lt and i both advance.

chapters.title: 重复键直接留在中间
chapters.titleEn: Collect duplicate keys in the middle
chapters.caption: 三个 3 已分类，无需继续递归它们。
chapters.captionEn: All three 3s are classified and need no further recursion.

chapters.title: 分区完成，内部仍然乱序
chapters.titleEn: A completed partition can still contain disorder
chapters.caption: 右段的 8、6 说明分区不是完整排序。
chapters.captionEn: The right group’s 8,6 inversion shows that partitioning is not sorting.

chapters.title: 只递归尚未解决的两段
chapters.titleEn: Recurse only on the unsolved groups
chapters.caption: 中间不动，外侧逐步排成完整顺序。
chapters.captionEn: Keep the equal group; sort the outer regions.

chapters.title: 极端主元，会一层层剥掉
chapters.titleEn: Extreme pivots peel away one item at a time
chapters.caption: 相同八项：极端分区 35 次，均衡对照 17 次。
chapters.captionEn: The same eight values: 35 classifications versus 17.

chapters.title: 先看两边的波前
chapters.caption: 界面两边的波前相接，传播方向改变。
chapters.captionEn: Wavefronts join at the interface while the direction changes.

chapters.title: 正入射的反例
chapters.caption: 波长改变，并不一定让光线转弯。
chapters.captionEn: A changed wavelength does not always bend the ray.

chapters.title: 只改折射率
chapters.caption: 相同入射角下，更高折射率使折射方向靠近法线。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed incidence, a higher second index moves the ray toward the normal.

chapters.title: 反向穿过界面
chapters.caption: 从高折射率走向低折射率，光线偏离法线。
chapters.captionEn: From higher to lower index, the ray bends away from the normal.

chapters.title: 频率没有换掉
chapters.caption: 频率连续，介质内波长按折射率改变。
chapters.captionEn: Frequency remains continuous while wavelength changes with index.

chapters.title: 角度从法线量起
chapters.caption: 把角度改从表面量，公式就不再是同一个正弦关系。
chapters.captionEn: Measuring from the surface changes which angle enters the sine relation.

chapters.title: 先有反射与透射
chapters.caption: 临界角以下，部分功率反射，部分传播到外侧。
chapters.captionEn: Below critical incidence, power divides between reflection and transmission.

chapters.title: 折射方向贴近界面
chapters.titleEn: The transmitted direction approaches the surface
chapters.caption: 临界时，传播折射方向达到相对法线90度。
chapters.captionEn: At critical incidence, the transmitted direction reaches ninety degrees.

chapters.title: 超过临界角
chapters.caption: 没有向外传播的法向功率，反射功率达到100%。
chapters.captionEn: No outward propagating normal power remains; reflection reaches one hundred percent.

chapters.title: 只改外侧介质
chapters.caption: 固定入射角，提高外侧折射率可以恢复传播透射。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed incidence, raising the outer index can restore transmission.

chapters.title: 反过来未必全反射
chapters.titleEn: The reverse direction need not totally reflect
chapters.caption: 从低折射率走向高折射率，没有同样的临界角。
chapters.captionEn: Lower-to-higher index incidence has no corresponding critical angle.

chapters.title: 外侧并非没有电场
chapters.titleEn: The outer field is not zero
chapters.caption: 消逝场沿法线衰减，不是离开界面的传播光束。
chapters.captionEn: The evanescent field decays normally instead of propagating away.

chapters.title: 一次进入，一次离开
chapters.caption: 光线在棱镜的两个真实表面分别折射。
chapters.captionEn: The ray refracts at the prism’s two physical surfaces.

chapters.title: 把多种波长一起送入
chapters.caption: 同一白光输入中，不同波长出射方向略有不同。
chapters.captionEn: Different wavelengths in the same input leave in slightly different directions.

chapters.title: 读取真实材料色散
chapters.caption: N-BK7在可见光范围内，较短波长的折射率较高。
chapters.captionEn: In visible N-BK7 glass, shorter wavelengths have higher index.

chapters.title: 保留棱镜，关闭色散
chapters.titleEn: Keep the prism but remove dispersion
chapters.caption: 相同折射率仍使光偏折，却不把波长分开。
chapters.captionEn: A common index still deflects light but no longer separates wavelengths.

chapters.title: 转动同一块棱镜
chapters.caption: 改变几何入射条件会改变偏向角，材料色散仍在。
chapters.captionEn: Rotating the geometry changes deviation while material dispersion remains.

chapters.title: 单色光不会凭空成白光
chapters.caption: 只输入一个波长，棱镜不会创造其他颜色。
chapters.captionEn: One input wavelength does not create new colours in the prism.

chapters.title: 从两条缝出发
chapters.caption: 不同观察方向给相邻缝带来不同相位差。
chapters.captionEn: Observation direction sets the phase difference between neighbouring slits.

chapters.title: 增加缝，不改间距
chapters.caption: 更多相干贡献让主峰变窄，主峰方向不因此改写。
chapters.captionEn: More coherent slits narrow the principal peaks without changing their directions.

chapters.title: 对准一个主峰
chapters.caption: 相邻缝的路程差为整波长，相量同向相加。
chapters.captionEn: Whole-wavelength path differences align the slit contributions.

chapters.title: 稍微偏开方向
chapters.caption: 相量逐步转向，首尾闭合时合成场为零。
chapters.captionEn: Phasors turn relative to one another; closure cancels the resultant field.

chapters.title: 同一光栅分开波长
chapters.caption: 相同级次下，较长波长出现在更大的偏转角。
chapters.captionEn: For the same order, a longer wavelength appears at a larger angle.

chapters.title: 间距限制级次
chapters.caption: 缩小缝距会把主峰推开，也使某些级次不再能传播。
chapters.captionEn: Smaller spacing moves orders outward and can remove propagating orders.

chapters.title: 有级次，未必有亮线
chapters.titleEn: An allowed order can still be dark
chapters.caption: 单缝衍射包络为零时，主峰级次也会消失。
chapters.captionEn: A single-slit envelope zero can suppress a principal order.

chapters.title: 轴线对齐时
chapters.caption: 夹角为零，输入与输出同速。
chapters.captionEn: Zero bend gives equal input and output speed.

chapters.title: 弯折轴线，保持连接
chapters.titleEn: Bend the axes, keep the connection
chapters.caption: 十字轴允许两根传动轴带着夹角转动。
chapters.captionEn: The cross connects shafts with intersecting axes.

chapters.title: 一圈里面，快慢两次
chapters.titleEn: Two speed cycles in one turn
chapters.caption: 30°夹角：输入120 rpm，输出约104–139 rpm。
chapters.captionEn: At 30°: input 120 rpm, output about 104–139 rpm.

chapters.title: 夹角改变波动大小
chapters.caption: 在相同输入相位，增大夹角会扩大整圈速度波动。
chapters.captionEn: Greater bend gives larger speed variation.

chapters.title: 总圈数相同，瞬时速度不同
chapters.caption: 输入每完成一圈，输出也完成一圈。
chapters.captionEn: Each full input turn gives one full output turn.

chapters.title: 第二节反向补偿
chapters.caption: 夹角相等、相位正确：末端匀速，中间轴仍变速。
chapters.captionEn: Equal bends, phased yokes: the final speed is steady.

chapters.title: 少一个条件，波动就回来
chapters.titleEn: Break one condition, restore the ripple
chapters.caption: 第二节改为15°，抵消不再完整。
chapters.captionEn: Changing the second bend to 15° leaves residual variation.

chapters.title: 根最大，不等于全体有序
chapters.titleEn: Maximum root, not a sorted array
chapters.caption: 父项不小于孩子；数组里的 7、8 仍可逆序。
chapters.captionEn: Parents dominate children; array neighbors 7 and 8 can remain inverted.

chapters.title: 先维持形状
chapters.caption: 10 先接到下一个叶位，完整树没有空洞。
chapters.captionEn: 10 first occupies the next leaf position, preserving completeness.

chapters.title: 沿父链上浮
chapters.caption: 同一个 10 经过索引 7、3、1、0；其余分支不动。
chapters.captionEn: The same 10 visits indices 7, 3, 1 and 0; other branches stay.

chapters.title: 弹出，再填根
chapters.caption: 弹出 10，用最后的 3 填根，先保住完整形状。
chapters.captionEn: Remove 10; the last 3 fills the root, preserving the complete shape.

chapters.title: 必须选较大孩子
