chapters.caption: 先选 9 而非 8，再让 3 沿同一条路径下沉。
chapters.captionEn: Choose 9 over 8, then sink 3 along that path.

chapters.title: 逐次取出，不必全排
chapters.titleEn: Repeated removal without a fully sorted heap
chapters.caption: 每次只取根，输出优先级非增，最后队列为空。
chapters.captionEn: Each removal takes the root; output is nonincreasing, until empty.

chapters.title: 输入不停，输出停一停
chapters.caption: 输入连续转动，槽轮分步前进。
chapters.captionEn: Continuous rotation produces discrete output steps.

chapters.title: 销钉沿切线进入
chapters.caption: 进入槽口时，输出速度从零开始。
chapters.captionEn: Output starts from zero speed as the pin enters.

chapters.title: 一个槽，一次九十度
chapters.caption: 四槽轮每次前进90°，中途速度更快。
chapters.captionEn: A four-slot wheel advances 90°, speeding up within the move.

chapters.title: 退出后，圆弧接手
chapters.caption: 销钉离开后，配合圆弧保持输出位置。
chapters.captionEn: Matching circular faces hold position after pin exit.

chapters.title: 四槽与六槽比较
chapters.caption: 槽数改变步长，也改变分度和停歇比例。
chapters.captionEn: Slot count changes both step angle and timing fractions.

chapters.title: 提高转速，比例不变
chapters.caption: 相同几何：时间缩短，输出峰值速度上升。
chapters.captionEn: With fixed geometry, times shrink and peak output speed rises.

chapters.title: 先分成八组
chapters.caption: 根指向自己；每个成员开始各自成组。
chapters.captionEn: Each root points to itself; every member starts in its own set.

chapters.title: 合并的是根
chapters.caption: 把小集合的根接到大集合，分量减一。
chapters.captionEn: Attach the smaller root to the larger set; the count falls by one.

chapters.title: 按大小保持浅树
chapters.titleEn: Use size to keep trees shallow
chapters.caption: 合并较小的根，逐渐形成两个四成员集合。
chapters.captionEn: Smaller roots attach as two four-member sets emerge.

chapters.title: 一组，不等于一层
chapters.titleEn: One set can still have depth
chapters.caption: 两根合并后，7 仍沿 7 → 6 → 4 → 0 查找。
chapters.captionEn: After joining roots, 7 still follows 7 → 6 → 4 → 0.

chapters.title: 查找后压缩路径
chapters.caption: 沿链找到 0，再把经过的非根成员直接指向 0。
chapters.captionEn: Reach root 0, then redirect visited non-root members straight to it.

chapters.title: 重复合并是空操作
chapters.titleEn: A redundant union changes no sets
chapters.caption: 1 与 7 已同根，分量数仍为 1。
chapters.captionEn: 1 and 7 already share a root, so the count remains 1.

chapters.title: 先数未完成前提
chapters.caption: A、B、C 入度为零，最初都可执行。
chapters.captionEn: A, B and C have zero indegree and are initially ready.

chapters.title: 一个前提还不够
chapters.caption: 完成 A 后，D 仍有来自 B 的一个前提。
chapters.captionEn: After A, D still has its prerequisite from B.

chapters.title: 就绪来自计数归零
chapters.caption: 完成 B 后 D 就绪，E 却仍需等待 C。
chapters.captionEn: B releases D, while E still waits for C.

chapters.title: 正确顺序可以不唯一
chapters.caption: C 完成后 D、E 都就绪，谁先都可满足依赖。
chapters.captionEn: After C, both D and E are ready; either can come first.

chapters.title: 所有前提解除才放行
chapters.titleEn: Release only when every count clears
chapters.caption: F 等 D、E 都输出后才就绪，完整顺序覆盖所有项。
chapters.captionEn: F becomes ready after both D and E; the complete order includes every task.

chapters.title: 环与下游阻塞
chapters.titleEn: A cycle and its blocked descendants
chapters.caption: 加入 E → B：环是 B ↔ E，D、F 只是被阻塞。
chapters.captionEn: Add E → B: B ↔ E is the cycle; D and F are blocked downstream.

chapters.title: 已付出，加剩余下界
chapters.titleEn: Cost paid plus a remaining lower bound
chapters.caption: 普通格成本 1；曼哈顿值忽略墙，因此只是下界。
chapters.captionEn: Plain cells cost 1; Manhattan distance ignores walls and is only a lower bound.

chapters.title: 选的是 g 加 h
chapters.caption: 前沿按 f = g + h 比较，不只看谁离目标近。
chapters.captionEn: The frontier compares f = g + h, not distance to the goal alone.

chapters.title: 障碍让真实成本增长
chapters.caption: 遇墙要绕行；g 随真实进入的格子累加。
chapters.captionEn: Walls force detours; g sums the actual entered cells.

chapters.title: 终点被选中才停止
chapters.titleEn: Stop when the goal is selected
chapters.caption: 合法下界下，终点从前沿取出，成本为 12。
chapters.captionEn: With the valid lower bound, selecting the goal returns cost 12.

chapters.title: 去掉估计也能求解
chapters.titleEn: Remove the estimate, keep the optimum
chapters.caption: h = 0 仍得到成本 12，本例需要取出更多项。
chapters.captionEn: h = 0 still returns cost 12, with more selections on this map.

chapters.title: 高估会改变答案
chapters.caption: 六倍曼哈顿估计先取到成本 15，超过最优的 12。
chapters.captionEn: Sixfold Manhattan selects a cost-15 goal before the cost-12 optimum.

chapters.title: 没有路线也是结果
chapters.titleEn: No route is a valid result
chapters.caption: 封闭整列墙后，前沿耗尽，终点不可达。
chapters.captionEn: Seal the column: the frontier empties and the goal is unreachable.

chapters.title: 先有一幅实像
chapters.caption: 同一远方物点的平行光，在物镜后交于同一点。
chapters.captionEn: Parallel rays from one distant point meet behind the objective.

chapters.title: 目镜接着做什么
chapters.caption: 中间实像位于目镜前焦面，出射光重新平行。
chapters.captionEn: The intermediate image lies in the eyepiece focal plane.

chapters.title: 短目镜的代价
chapters.caption: 目镜焦距变短，角放大率增加，出瞳同时变小。
chapters.captionEn: A shorter eyepiece raises magnification and shrinks the exit pupil.

chapters.title: 出瞳不是星像
chapters.titleEn: The pupil is not the star image
chapters.caption: 出瞳是物镜孔径的像；多个视场的光束在这里对齐。
chapters.captionEn: The exit pupil images the objective aperture, not a star.

chapters.title: 眼睛前后移动
chapters.titleEn: Move the eye along the axis
chapters.caption: 离开出瞳平面，离轴视场先受到遮挡。
chapters.captionEn: Away from the exit pupil, off-axis fields become clipped.

chapters.title: 横向偏离
chapters.caption: 光路没有消失，眼瞳与光束的重叠面积变小了。
chapters.captionEn: The beam remains, but less of it overlaps the eye pupil.

chapters.title: 一面镜只翻一项
chapters.caption: 镜面反转垂直于它的方向分量，另外两项保留。
chapters.captionEn: A mirror reverses its normal component and keeps the other two.

chapters.title: 两面仍少一项
chapters.caption: 在三维中，两次垂直反射仍保留第三个分量。
chapters.captionEn: Two perpendicular reflections still preserve the third component.

chapters.title: 第三面完成反向
chapters.caption: 真正经历三面反射后，三个分量全部反号。
chapters.captionEn: After three actual reflections, all three components reverse.

chapters.title: 不必每次瞄正
chapters.caption: 入射方向变化，只要仍遇到三面，返回关系保留。
chapters.captionEn: The return persists while the changed ray still reaches all three faces.

chapters.title: 平行不等于原路
chapters.titleEn: Parallel is not the same line
chapters.caption: 返回方向相反，两条直线仍可有横向间隔。
chapters.captionEn: Opposite directions can belong to laterally separated lines.

chapters.title: 有限大小的边界
chapters.caption: 这条边缘光只遇到两面，已经从入口离开。
chapters.captionEn: This edge ray leaves through the entrance after only two encounters.

chapters.title: 容量与守恒
chapters.caption: 边有容量上限，中间节点必须流入等于流出。
chapters.captionEn: Edges have capacity bounds; intermediate vertices conserve flow.

chapters.title: 先选一条有效绕路
chapters.caption: 先沿 S → A → B → T 发送 1，瓶颈是中间边。
chapters.captionEn: Send 1 on S → A → B → T; the middle edge is the bottleneck.

chapters.title: 正向看似走不通
chapters.caption: 直接路线把总量增到 3，B → T 已满。
chapters.captionEn: Direct routes raise the total to 3, saturating B → T.

chapters.title: 反向残余允许改账
chapters.titleEn: Reverse residual capacity revises an allocation
chapters.caption: A → B 已有 1，因此 B → A 允许撤回 1。
chapters.captionEn: A → B carries 1, so B → A may cancel 1.

chapters.title: 撤回局部，增加整体
chapters.caption: A → B 从 1 变 0，总流量从 3 变 4。
chapters.captionEn: A → B falls from 1 to 0 while total flow rises from 3 to 4.

chapters.title: 用上界证明完成
chapters.titleEn: Certify completion with an upper bound
chapters.caption: 割容量 2 + 2 = 4，已实现的流量正好达到它。
chapters.captionEn: The cut capacity is 2 + 2 = 4, exactly matching achieved flow.

chapters.title: 正向走过一颗颗齿
chapters.caption: 斜面抬起棘爪，弹簧让它落回。
chapters.captionEn: The ramp lifts the pawl; the spring returns it.

chapters.title: 近看斜面与回位
chapters.titleEn: Look closely at the ramp and return
chapters.caption: 有限宽度的棘爪沿真实齿面升降。
chapters.captionEn: The finite pawl follows the actual tooth face.

chapters.title: 先退一点，才碰到止挡
chapters.caption: 前进49.5°后，12齿轮可回退19.5°。
chapters.captionEn: After 49.5° of advance, a twelve-tooth wheel can roll back 19.5°.

chapters.title: 陡面把反向作用传到导向
chapters.titleEn: The steep face transfers load to the guide
chapters.caption: 虚线目标继续回退，实际轮子已被挡住。
chapters.captionEn: The dashed target continues backward; the wheel stays held.

chapters.title: 抬起棘爪，约束解除
chapters.titleEn: Lift the pawl to release the constraint
chapters.caption: 离开全部齿尖后，同一轮子可以反转。
chapters.captionEn: Clear the tooth tips and the same wheel can reverse.

chapters.title: 更多齿，较小的空回区间
chapters.titleEn: More teeth, a smaller lost-motion interval
chapters.caption: 相同前进22°：12齿与24齿停在不同位置。
chapters.captionEn: After the same 22° advance, twelve and twenty-four teeth stop differently.

chapters.title: 公共状态与私有草稿
chapters.caption: 初始余票 1、订单 0，两者合计等于容量。
chapters.captionEn: Initially stock 1 plus orders 0 equals capacity.

chapters.title: 准备修改不立即公布
chapters.caption: T1 拟写 0，但公共状态仍是余票 1、订单 0。
chapters.captionEn: T1 stages 0 while public stock stays 1 and orders stay 0.

chapters.title: 回滚丢弃整笔草稿
chapters.caption: 未提交的拟写被丢弃，公共状态保持 1、0。
chapters.captionEn: Discard uncommitted writes; public state remains 1 and 0.

chapters.title: 两笔原子，也可能冲突
chapters.titleEn: Two atomic commits can still conflict
chapters.caption: 两者先读 1，再各写 0，最后出现两张订单。
chapters.captionEn: Both read 1, then each writes 0, producing two orders.

chapters.title: 提交前检验旧读数
chapters.caption: T1 改变版本，T2 的旧版本整笔中止，订单不公布。
chapters.captionEn: T1 changes the version; T2’s stale transaction aborts without an order.

chapters.title: 重试必须重新读取
chapters.caption: 第二位重试读到 0，拒绝预订，库存约束保持。
chapters.captionEn: The retry reads 0 and refuses the reservation, preserving the invariant.

chapters.title: 分走了哪些光
chapters.caption: 每个波长：直达与被散射的部分，加起来等于入射。
chapters.captionEn: At each wavelength: direct + redirected = input.

chapters.title: 四次方的选择
chapters.caption: 450nm的散射截面，约为650nm的4.35倍。
chapters.captionEn: Cross-section ratio: σ450 / σ650 ≈ 4.35.

chapters.title: 光分散到哪里
chapters.caption: 非偏振光在90度仍散射，前后方向更强。
chapters.captionEn: At 90°, scattering density is half its forward value.

chapters.title: 更长的直达路径
chapters.caption: 路径增长，短波长更早从直达光中减少。
chapters.captionEn: Longer paths remove more blue from the direct beam.

chapters.title: 为什么不能只选最短
chapters.titleEn: Why the shortest wavelength is not the whole answer
chapters.caption: 看见的颜色取决于入射光谱、散射和视觉匹配。
chapters.captionEn: Colour combines the spectrum and visual sensitivity.

chapters.title: 红光不会变蓝光
chapters.titleEn: Red light does not turn blue
chapters.caption: 瑞利散射改变方向，不把650nm变成另一种波长。
chapters.captionEn: Red light is redirected without turning blue.

chapters.title: 厚度不是处处有用
chapters.caption: 光在均匀材料中直行，转向发生在界面。
chapters.captionEn: Light travels straight inside the material and bends at its surfaces.

chapters.title: 分给各个环带
chapters.caption: 各环表面单独设计，仍把轴向平行光折向共同焦点。
chapters.captionEn: Each annular surface redirects axial rays toward the same focus.

chapters.title: 放大一段真实曲面
chapters.caption: 局部法线改变，出射方向随斯涅尔定律确定。
chapters.captionEn: The local normal and Snell’s law determine the emerging direction.

chapters.title: 少了多少材料
chapters.caption: 保持口径与设计焦点，比较实际旋转体积。
chapters.captionEn: Compare rotational volume at the same aperture and design focus.

chapters.title: 相同折射率的反例
chapters.caption: 保留所有环带，减小折射率差，聚光逐渐消失。
chapters.captionEn: Keep the grooves but remove index contrast, and focusing disappears.

chapters.title: 同焦点不等于同相位
chapters.titleEn: One focus does not mean one phase
chapters.caption: 各环光程不同；几何光线不足以保证高质量成像。
chapters.captionEn: Zone optical paths differ; geometric rays alone cannot guarantee image quality.

chapters.title: 内存新，数据页旧
chapters.caption: 内存改为 11，持久页暂时仍是 7。
chapters.captionEn: Memory changes to 11 while the durable page remains 7.

chapters.title: 写入缓存不算持久
chapters.caption: 修改与 COMMIT 都在缓存时，还不能确认成功。
chapters.captionEn: An update and COMMIT in memory cannot yet acknowledge success.

chapters.title: 日志先持久，再确认
chapters.titleEn: Make the log durable, then acknowledge
chapters.caption: 提交日志已持久，可以确认，旧数据页仍为 7。
chapters.captionEn: The commit log is durable, so acknowledgement can precede the page write.

chapters.title: 故障只留下持久部分
chapters.titleEn: A crash leaves the durable parts
chapters.caption: 内存消失；持久日志与值为 7 的旧页留下。
chapters.captionEn: Memory disappears; the durable log and old page containing 7 remain.

chapters.title: 按日志恢复已提交结果
chapters.caption: 重放已提交 SET，页恢复为 11，并记录页 LSN。
chapters.captionEn: Replay the committed SET to restore 11 and record the page LSN.

chapters.title: 无确认，不代表未提交
chapters.titleEn: No acknowledgement does not mean no commit
chapters.caption: 只有修改日志恢复为 7；提交持久但没确认，恢复为 11。
chapters.captionEn: Update-only recovers 7; durable commit without acknowledgement recovers 11.

chapters.title: 把反馈路径连起来
chapters.caption: 飞球 → 套筒 → 阀门 → 驱动力。
chapters.captionEn: Flyballs → sleeve → valve → driving torque.

chapters.title: 外部改变转速
chapters.caption: 转速提高，飞球展开，套筒升高，阀口减小。
chapters.captionEn: Higher speed spreads the balls, raises the sleeve and reduces opening.

chapters.title: 负载增加后，阀门再响应
chapters.titleEn: Add load, then watch the response
chapters.caption: 负载↑ → 转速↓ → 阀口↑ → 驱动力↑。
chapters.captionEn: More load → lower speed → more opening → more drive.

chapters.title: 断开连接，固定阀门
chapters.titleEn: Disconnect the linkage and hold the valve
chapters.caption: 相同负载，固定开度不足以维持转动。
chapters.captionEn: Under the same load, fixed opening cannot sustain rotation.

chapters.title: 稳定之后，仍有偏差
chapters.titleEn: Settling can leave a speed error
chapters.caption: 接通反馈后稳定，但低于原先72 rpm。
chapters.captionEn: Feedback settles the speed below its original 72 rpm.

chapters.title: 响应变慢，偏离更大
chapters.caption: 相同负载，3秒响应比0.4秒响应偏离更大。
chapters.captionEn: The same load causes a larger excursion with a three-second response.

chapters.title: 红与绿相遇
chapters.caption: 两束光到达同一点，能量相加，不是相互涂掉。
chapters.captionEn: Two lights at one place add energy rather than covering each other.

chapters.title: 第三束补上蓝
chapters.caption: 合适的红绿蓝比例，可以匹配白色外观。
chapters.captionEn: A suitable balance of red, green and blue can match white.

chapters.title: 一半能量的灰
chapters.caption: 三个通道同减为一半，色相不变，显示编码不是128。
chapters.captionEn: 50% linear light → sRGB 188, not 128.

chapters.title: 改走同一条路
chapters.titleEn: Send one beam through a filter
chapters.caption: 青色滤片保留绿蓝，减少红通道。
chapters.captionEn: An ideal cyan filter keeps green and blue while reducing red.

chapters.title: 青与黄留下绿
chapters.caption: 串联的透射率相乘，只有共同能通过的部分保留。
chapters.captionEn: Serial transmissions multiply, retaining what can pass both filters.

chapters.title: 最后一个通道也被挡住
chapters.caption: 再加品红，理想三通道都不能通过。
chapters.captionEn: Magenta rejects the last remaining channel in this ideal model.

chapters.title: 照明也是条件
chapters.caption: 滤片不变，换掉输入光谱，输出也会改变。
chapters.captionEn: The filters stay fixed, but changing the input changes the result.

chapters.title: 三票才当选
chapters.caption: 五节点的多数是 3；A 先取得三票。
chapters.captionEn: A majority of five is 3; A obtains three votes.

chapters.title: 两份复制，不够提交
chapters.titleEn: Two copies are not a commit
chapters.caption: x 只在 A、B，确认数 2/5，提交索引仍为 0。
chapters.captionEn: Only A and B hold x: 2/5 confirmed, commit index still 0.

chapters.title: 多数分区选出新任期
chapters.titleEn: The majority partition elects a new term
chapters.caption: A、B 被隔离；C、D、E 以三票选出任期 2 的 C。
chapters.captionEn: A,B are isolated; C,D,E elect C in term 2 with three votes.

chapters.title: 当前任期取得多数
chapters.caption: C 的 y 复制到三份后，提交索引才能推进。
chapters.captionEn: C advances commitment after three copies of current-term y.

chapters.title: 修复未提交冲突
chapters.caption: 恢复连接后，A 接受更高任期，未提交 x 被 y 替换。
chapters.captionEn: After healing, A accepts the higher term and pending x is replaced by y.

chapters.title: 旧任期不能只数副本
chapters.caption: 另一条序列中，旧 x 有三份确认，提交仍为 0。
chapters.captionEn: In a separate sequence, inherited x has three acknowledgements but commit stays 0.

chapters.title: 当前条目提交旧前缀
chapters.titleEn: A current entry commits the older prefix
chapters.caption: 当前任期 no-op 取得多数，提交索引到 2，旧 x 间接提交。
chapters.captionEn: A current-term no-op reaches a majority; commit index 2 includes old x.

chapters.title: 同一点，不同位置
chapters.caption: 对齐注视点后，位于同一深度的中央物点没有相对视差。
chapters.captionEn: After registration, a central target at fixation depth has zero relative disparity.

chapters.title: 比注视点更近
chapters.caption: 物点移近，左右登记位置向相反方向分开。
chapters.captionEn: A nearer point separates in opposite directions in the registered views.

chapters.title: 比注视点更远
chapters.caption: 物点移远，视差方向反过来。
chapters.captionEn: A farther point reverses the sign of relative disparity.

chapters.title: 基线缩到零
chapters.caption: 相同观察位置产生相同投影，双目深度信息消失。
chapters.captionEn: Coincident viewpoints give identical projections and no stereo depth information.

chapters.title: 同样间隔，远处更难分
chapters.caption: 保持200mm深度间隔，整体移远后相对视差缩小。
chapters.captionEn: The same 200 mm depth gap gives less disparity farther away.

chapters.title: 还要先配对
chapters.caption: 交换右图配对，同样的观测可被算成错误深度。
chapters.captionEn: Swapping right-view matches reconstructs different, incorrect depths.

chapters.title: 内容先成为叶哈希
chapters.caption: 每项使用 00 前缀；显示短码，内部保留完整 SHA-256。
chapters.captionEn: Each leaf uses prefix 00; short labels represent full SHA-256 digests.

chapters.title: 有序地合成父节点
chapters.caption: 01 前缀后拼接左、右哈希原字节，得到 AB 与 CD。
chapters.captionEn: Prefix 01 plus raw left/right digests creates AB and CD.

chapters.title: 根绑定整组顺序
chapters.titleEn: The root binds the ordered group
chapters.caption: AB 与 CD 再合成根，根承诺四项内容及其顺序。
chapters.captionEn: AB and CD combine into a root binding all four ordered contents.

chapters.title: 只带必要的兄弟
chapters.caption: 验证 C，只需 D 和 AB 两个兄弟哈希，不用其余原文。
chapters.captionEn: Verifying C needs D and AB as sibling hashes, not the other payloads.

chapters.title: 左右次序不能乱
chapters.caption: 先 C 与右侧 D 合成 CD，再把左侧 AB 加回来。
chapters.captionEn: Combine C with right sibling D, then prepend left sibling AB.

chapters.title: 修改沿祖先传播
chapters.caption: gamma 改成 Gamma，只改动 C、CD 与根，原根验证失败。
chapters.captionEn: Changing gamma to Gamma alters C, CD and the root; original-root verification fails.

chapters.title: 根也要有可信来源
chapters.caption: 连根一起替换可以自洽，却不能认证来源或证明内容真实。
chapters.captionEn: Replacing the root too can be self-consistent without authenticating its origin or truth.

chapters.title: 先认清细纹
chapters.caption: 一层透射率周期为4mm，还没有两层的差频。
chapters.captionEn: One layer repeats every 4 mm; no two-layer difference yet.

chapters.title: 慢慢错开的重合
chapters.caption: 4mm与4.4mm细纹的乘积，含44mm的大周期。
chapters.captionEn: 4 mm and 4.4 mm pitches produce a 44 mm coarse period.

chapters.title: 越接近，粗纹越宽
chapters.caption: 细纹频率越接近，差频越小，周期越长。
chapters.captionEn: Closer pitches produce a wider coarse pattern.

chapters.title: 转角也能产生差频
chapters.caption: 周期相同，方向不同，空间频率向量仍有差。
chapters.captionEn: Equal pitches can still form moiré when rotated.

chapters.title: 小移动，大响应
chapters.caption: 第二层向右4.4mm，差频峰向左44mm。
chapters.captionEn: Move the layer 4.4 mm right; its coarse peak moves 44 mm left.

chapters.title: 完全相同的边界
chapters.caption: 两层同周期同方向并对齐，仍有细纹，但没有独立粗周期。
chapters.captionEn: Aligned, equal pitches leave no independent coarse period.

chapters.title: 输入起伏，负载平稳
chapters.caption: 转矩差让飞轮加速或减速。
chapters.captionEn: The torque difference speeds up or slows down the rotor.

chapters.title: 输入多出的部分存起来
chapters.caption: 输入大于负载，转速与储能一起上升。
chapters.captionEn: Surplus input raises both speed and stored energy.

chapters.title: 输入不足，释放储能
chapters.caption: 输入仍在做功，飞轮补上暂时的差额。
chapters.captionEn: The drive still supplies work; stored energy covers the shortfall.

chapters.title: 同样重量，放得更靠外
chapters.titleEn: Move equal mass toward the rim
chapters.caption: 保持质量和平均速度，惯量越大，波动越小。
chapters.captionEn: At equal mass and mean speed, more inertia gives less ripple.

chapters.title: 切断驱动，能转多久
chapters.titleEn: Cut the drive and watch stored energy run out
chapters.caption: 负载持续取走能量，飞轮最终停止。
chapters.captionEn: The load keeps taking energy until the flywheel stops.

chapters.title: 更稳，也更难加速
chapters.caption: 相同启动转矩下，较大惯量加速更慢。
chapters.captionEn: The same starting torque accelerates the larger inertia more slowly.

chapters.title: 私钥签，公钥验
chapters.caption: 私钥 137 对应公钥 y；演示小群没有安全性。
chapters.captionEn: Private scalar 137 gives public y; this tiny group is insecure.

chapters.title: 消息参与挑战
chapters.caption: nonce 形成 R，R、公钥与消息一起形成挑战 e。
chapters.captionEn: A nonce gives R; R, the public key and message determine challenge e.

chapters.title: 生成两个签名量
chapters.caption: s 将 nonce、挑战和私钥合入模 q 的关系。
chapters.captionEn: s combines nonce, challenge and private key modulo q.

chapters.title: 公开核对等式
chapters.caption: 用公钥比较两边，原消息的验证关系成立。
chapters.captionEn: The public key makes both sides equal for the original message.

chapters.title: 固定签名，改动消息
chapters.titleEn: Keep the signature, edit the message
chapters.caption: HELLO 变成 HELLO!，右侧改变，原签名验证失败。
chapters.captionEn: HELLO becomes HELLO!; the right side changes and verification fails.

chapters.title: 公钥也必须正确
chapters.titleEn: The key must also be the right one
chapters.caption: 换公钥会失败；公钥与真实身份的绑定需要另外认证。
chapters.captionEn: Another public key fails; binding the key to identity needs separate authentication.

chapters.title: 复用 nonce，泄露私钥
chapters.titleEn: Nonce reuse exposes the private key
chapters.caption: HELLO 与 WORLD 复用 R，两式实际恢复出私钥 137。
chapters.captionEn: HELLO and WORLD reuse R; their equations recover private scalar 137.

chapters.title: 两边各留私数
chapters.caption: Alice 留 6，Bob 留 7；小群仅作不安全教学。
chapters.captionEn: Alice keeps 6, Bob 7; the tiny group is insecure teaching only.

chapters.title: 私数变成公开值
chapters.caption: A=18、B=13 可以发送，私数并未直接发送。
chapters.captionEn: A=18 and B=13 are public; the private exponents are not sent.

chapters.title: 交叉收到公开值
chapters.caption: Alice 收到 13，Bob 收到 18，各自保留自己的私数。
chapters.captionEn: Alice receives 13, Bob receives 18, retaining their own exponents.

chapters.title: 指数次序给出同值
chapters.caption: 13⁶ 与 18⁷ 模 23，都等于 6。
chapters.captionEn: 13⁶ and 18⁷ modulo 23 both equal 6.

chapters.title: 改一个私数，两边一起变
chapters.titleEn: Change one exponent, both results change
chapters.caption: Alice 的 6 改为 7，公开值与两侧共享值一起变化。
chapters.captionEn: Changing Alice from 6 to 7 changes her public value and both shared results.

chapters.title: 小群可轻易倒查
chapters.titleEn: The tiny group is easy to search
chapters.caption: 十个候选就恢复私数 6；这些参数不提供保密。
chapters.captionEn: Ten candidates recover exponent 6; these parameters provide no secrecy.

chapters.title: 主动替换打破端到端
chapters.caption: 中间人替换为 8、16，并分别算出端点的 13、18。
chapters.captionEn: An intermediary substitutes 8 and 16 and computes endpoint values 13 and 18.

chapters.title: 先不用近轴近似
chapters.caption: 球面不同高度的反射光，不经过同一轴上交点。
chapters.captionEn: Rays reflected at different spherical-mirror heights have different axial crossings.

chapters.title: 放大交会区域
chapters.caption: 浅绿近轴交点与橙色边缘交点，在轴上分开。
chapters.captionEn: The pale near-axis crossing and warm marginal crossing are separated along the axis.

chapters.title: 调焦不能让全部重合
chapters.caption: 移动接收面能缩小光斑，但不能同时消除各高度的差异。
chapters.captionEn: Moving the screen can reduce the spot without eliminating every ray’s error.

chapters.title: 只接收靠轴部分
chapters.caption: 有效口径缩小，几何球差减弱，接收面积也下降。
chapters.captionEn: A smaller effective pupil reduces geometric blur while reducing accepted area.

chapters.title: 改变面形，而非接收面
chapters.titleEn: Change the surface, not the screen
chapters.caption: 保持顶点与近轴焦距，把球面改为抛物面。
chapters.captionEn: Keep vertex and paraxial focal length while changing the sphere to a parabola.

chapters.title: 轴上校正仍有条件
chapters.caption: 抛物面消除轴上球差，不保证离轴也无其他像差。
chapters.captionEn: A parabola corrects on-axis spherical aberration without eliminating every off-axis aberration.

chapters.title: 先明确原始表示
chapters.caption: 8×8 像素，每像素 1 字节，共 64 字节。
chapters.captionEn: 8×8 pixels at one byte per pixel: 64 bytes.

chapters.title: 只合并连续同值
chapters.caption: 值不变就增加计数，遇到新值才开启下一段。
chapters.captionEn: Increase the count while values match; a new value starts a run.

chapters.title: 序列化真实字节
chapters.caption: 四段各 2 字节，加 R1 头 2 字节，共 10 字节。
chapters.captionEn: Four two-byte runs plus a two-byte R1 header total 10 bytes.

chapters.title: 按次数展开
chapters.caption: 解码逐段恢复，最终字节与原始数据完全相同。
chapters.captionEn: Decode each run; the recovered bytes exactly match the original.

chapters.title: 短段会放大开销
chapters.caption: 细竖纹有 64 段，实际 R1 变成 130 字节。
chapters.captionEn: Thin stripes have 64 runs and produce 130 R1 bytes.

chapters.title: 计数也有编码成本
chapters.caption: 127 次用 7f，128 次用 80 01，完整表示从 4 到 5 字节。
chapters.captionEn: 127 uses 7f; 128 uses 80 01, growing the full record from 4 to 5 bytes.

chapters.title: 自转之外，还有进动
chapters.titleEn: Spin and precession are different rotations
chapters.caption: 转盘绕轴自转，轴线绕竖直方向进动。
chapters.captionEn: The disk spins about its shaft while the shaft precesses.

chapters.title: 重量仍在，力矩有方向
chapters.titleEn: Weight remains; torque has its own direction
chapters.caption: 支点承担重量，重力矩沿水平方向。
chapters.captionEn: The pivot carries weight; gravity produces horizontal torque.

chapters.title: 力矩让角动量转向
chapters.caption: 水平角动量的端点沿圆周移动。
chapters.captionEn: The horizontal momentum tip follows a circle.

chapters.title: 自转加倍，进动减半
chapters.caption: 相同重力矩改变更大的角动量，转向更慢。
chapters.captionEn: The same torque turns a larger momentum more slowly.

chapters.title: 反转自转，也反转进动
chapters.caption: 重力不变，角动量与进动方向都反转。
chapters.captionEn: Gravity stays the same; momentum and precession reverse.

chapters.title: 去掉重力矩
chapters.caption: 无重力矩、零初始进动，轴向保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: With no gravity torque and zero initial precession, the axis stays fixed.

chapters.title: 均匀空气中的视线
chapters.caption: 没有温度梯度时，这条向下的视线直接到达路面。
chapters.captionEn: Without a temperature gradient, this downward direction reaches the road.

chapters.title: 热空气改变折射率
chapters.caption: 地面附近更热、折射率更低，光在薄层中逐渐弯曲。
chapters.captionEn: Hotter near-ground air has a lower index, bending the ray within a thin layer.

chapters.title: 没有一面空气镜
chapters.caption: 放大近地2cm，最低点仍在空气中，切线连续变化。
chapters.captionEn: Inside the enlarged 2 cm layer, the minimum stays above ground and the tangent changes continuously.

chapters.title: 眼睛按来向定位
chapters.caption: 把入眼切线当直线延长，会指向更低的路面位置。
chapters.captionEn: Extending the arrival tangent as a straight line points toward the road.

chapters.title: 并非所有角度都返回
chapters.caption: 视线更陡时，光真的到达地面，路径就在那里终止。
chapters.captionEn: A steeper direction really reaches the ground, where the ray must stop.

chapters.title: 视点也是条件
chapters.caption: 改变眼高，同样入眼角对应的近地位置随之移动。
chapters.captionEn: Changing eye height moves the near-ground part of the same viewing direction.

chapters.title: 一个脉冲，一份响应
chapters.caption: 索引 2 的单位脉冲，让 h 的 1、0.5、0.25 整体移位。
chapters.captionEn: A unit impulse at 2 shifts response 1,0.5,0.25 together.

chapters.title: 非对称核要翻转
chapters.caption: 原核顺序是 1、0.5、0.25；对齐输入时反向排列。
chapters.captionEn: Original order is 1,0.5,0.25; alignment reverses it.

chapters.title: 重叠项相乘再求和
chapters.caption: n=3 时，贡献 2、0.5、0，相加得到 2.5。
chapters.captionEn: At n=3, contributions 2,0.5,0 sum to 2.5.

chapters.title: 滑动建立整个序列
chapters.titleEn: Slide to build the output sequence
chapters.caption: 每移动一格，重新计算相应乘积和。
chapters.captionEn: Move one index and recompute the aligned product sum.

chapters.title: 相关没有同样翻转
chapters.caption: 同一 n=2，卷积为 1，前向相关为 2.25。
chapters.captionEn: At the same n=2, convolution is 1 and forward correlation is 2.25.

chapters.title: 截取会丢掉真实尾部
chapters.caption: 末端脉冲完整输出有尾部 0.5、0.25；取前 7 项会舍弃。
chapters.captionEn: The final impulse has a 0.5,0.25 tail; the first-7 crop drops it.

chapters.title: 循环边界把尾部折回
chapters.titleEn: Periodic boundaries fold the tail back
chapters.caption: 周期假设让 0.5、0.25 回到索引 0、1。
chapters.captionEn: Periodicity folds 0.5,0.25 into indices 0 and 1.

chapters.title: 先保持质量位置不变
chapters.caption: 没有外力矩，转台保持原来的角动量。
chapters.captionEn: Without external torque, the rotor keeps its angular momentum.

chapters.title: 向内移动，速度上升
chapters.caption: 惯量减小，角速度增加，乘积保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: Inertia falls and speed rises, preserving their product.

chapters.title: 再向外，转速下降
chapters.caption: 相同角动量下，质量远离轴线使速度降低。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed momentum, moving mass outward lowers speed.

chapters.title: 角动量不变，动能增加
chapters.titleEn: Momentum stays fixed while energy rises
chapters.caption: 增加的动能来自内部执行器做功。
chapters.captionEn: Internal actuator work supplies the kinetic-energy increase.

chapters.title: 只收拢一部分
chapters.caption: 半径停在450 mm，得到中间的惯量和速度。
chapters.captionEn: Stopping at 450 mm gives intermediate inertia and speed.

chapters.title: 外力矩改变守恒条件
chapters.caption: 半径不变，反向外力矩仍会减少角动量。
chapters.captionEn: An opposing external torque reduces momentum even at fixed radius.

chapters.title: 压力变化在传播
chapters.caption: 波形表示压缩与稀疏，不是管道横向摆动。
chapters.captionEn: The curve represents compression and rarefaction, not sideways motion of a tube.

chapters.title: 一部分返回，一部分通过
chapters.caption: 较高阻抗一侧产生同号的反射压力脉冲。
chapters.captionEn: A higher-impedance second medium produces an upright reflected pressure pulse.

chapters.title: 压力幅度不是能量份额
chapters.titleEn: Pressure amplitude is not an energy share
chapters.caption: 透射压力为1.6倍，但透射能量只有64%。
chapters.captionEn: Transmitted pressure is 1.6 times the input, but its energy share is only 64%.

chapters.title: 低阻抗反过来
chapters.caption: 改为低阻抗第二介质，反射压力发生符号翻转。
chapters.captionEn: A lower-impedance second medium reverses the reflected pressure sign.

chapters.title: 速度不同也能不反射
chapters.titleEn: Different speeds can still be matched
chapters.caption: 保持阻抗相等，只改声速，反射仍为零。
chapters.captionEn: With equal impedances, changing sound speed still produces zero reflection.

chapters.title: 再看粒子速度
chapters.caption: 反向波的压力与速度反号，不能把压力曲线当速度曲线。
chapters.captionEn: Pressure and velocity have opposite signs in a backward wave.

chapters.title: 下降方向来自梯度
chapters.titleEn: The gradient gives a descent direction
chapters.caption: 损失 f=(x²+8y²)/2，负梯度为 (−x,−8y)。
chapters.captionEn: Loss f=(x²+8y²)/2 has negative gradient (−x,−8y).

chapters.title: 用步长决定真实位移
chapters.caption: η=0.08 的第一步到 (2.3,0.54)，损失降到 3.8114。
chapters.captionEn: With η=.08, the first step reaches (2.3,.54), reducing loss to 3.8114.

chapters.title: 重复同一更新
chapters.caption: 两个方向都缩小，有限步后接近最低点。
chapters.captionEn: Both components contract, approaching the minimizer over finite steps.

chapters.title: 之字形也能收敛
chapters.caption: η=0.22，y 每步反号但幅度减小，损失仍下降。
chapters.captionEn: With η=.22, y alternates sign while shrinking and loss still decreases.

chapters.title: 大步会越过下降区域
chapters.caption: η=0.3，让陡方向误差放大，损失增长。
chapters.captionEn: At η=.3, the steep-direction error and loss grow.

chapters.title: 临界点不等于安全内部
chapters.titleEn: The boundary is not the stable interior
chapters.caption: η=0.25 时 |y| 保持 1.5，损失趋近 9 而不是 0。
chapters.captionEn: At η=.25, |y| stays 1.5 and loss approaches 9 rather than 0.

chapters.title: 先看均值在哪里
chapters.caption: 八点均值为 (4,3)，偏移不等于变化方向。
chapters.captionEn: The eight-point mean is (4,3); offset is not variation.

chapters.title: 逐列减去均值
chapters.caption: 减去 (4,3)，均值到零，点间相对关系不变。
chapters.captionEn: Subtract (4,3): the mean reaches zero while point differences stay unchanged.

chapters.title: 随便选轴会丢更多
chapters.caption: 水平轴保留 3.8125，正交均方误差为 1.4375。
chapters.captionEn: The horizontal axis retains 3.8125 with mean-square error 1.4375.

chapters.title: 旋转找到最大变化
chapters.caption: 30° 时保留 5、误差 0.25，保留比例约 95.24%。
chapters.captionEn: At 30°, retained variance is 5, error 0.25 and retained fraction 95.24%.

chapters.title: 保留多数，仍会丢信息
chapters.titleEn: Most variation is not all information
chapters.caption: 八个点压成一维，成对点得到相同坐标。
chapters.captionEn: Eight observations become one-dimensional scores; pairs share a coordinate.

chapters.title: 单位改变度量
chapters.caption: x 数值乘 10，主轴与保留比例随新单位改变。
chapters.captionEn: Multiply x by 10: the principal axis and fraction change with the units.

chapters.title: 有时没有唯一第一方向
chapters.titleEn: Sometimes no first direction is unique
chapters.caption: 等方差四点在任何轴上都保留 0.5、丢失 0.5。
chapters.captionEn: The isotropic points retain 0.5 and lose 0.5 in every direction.

chapters.title: 相同质量的小车相遇
chapters.caption: 等质量时，分离后速度交换。
chapters.captionEn: Equal masses exchange velocities after separation.

chapters.title: 压缩时，动能暂存
chapters.caption: 接触力等大反向，部分动能变成弹簧能量。
chapters.captionEn: Equal opposite forces transfer kinetic energy into the springs.

chapters.title: 回弹把能量交回来
chapters.caption: 弹簧恢复原长后，平移动能恢复。
chapters.captionEn: After the springs regain their free length, kinetic energy is restored.

chapters.title: 轻车撞重车，会反弹
chapters.titleEn: A light cart rebounds from a heavy one
chapters.caption: 质量不相同，速度不再简单交换。
chapters.captionEn: Unequal masses do not simply exchange velocities.

chapters.title: 重车让轻车跑得更快
chapters.titleEn: A heavy cart sends the light one faster
chapters.caption: 轻车可以比重车原先更快，总能量仍守恒。
chapters.captionEn: The light cart can leave faster than the incoming heavy cart.

chapters.title: 换到质心参考系
chapters.caption: 两车动量等大反向，质心保持静止。
chapters.captionEn: The two momenta are equal and opposite around a fixed center.

chapters.title: 开放端不等于空气不动
chapters.titleEn: An open end does not freeze the air
chapters.caption: 开放端压力变化接近零，空气位移却可以很大。
chapters.captionEn: An open end has nearly zero pressure variation but can have large particle motion.

chapters.title: 经过平衡时动得最快
chapters.caption: 压力与位移减小时，粒子速度可以正在增大。
chapters.captionEn: Pressure and displacement can fall while particle speed grows.

chapters.title: 封闭顶端
chapters.caption: 同样长度，一端塞闭后的基频约低一个八度。
chapters.captionEn: At the same length, stopping one end lowers the ideal fundamental by an octave.

chapters.title: 第二个模态不是二倍频
chapters.titleEn: The second mode is not twice the fundamental
chapters.caption: 理想塞闭圆柱的下一允许模态是三倍基频。
chapters.captionEn: The next allowed stopped-cylinder mode is three times the fundamental.

chapters.title: 长度选择音高
chapters.caption: 同样边界下，声柱变长，允许波长增长，频率下降。
chapters.captionEn: With the same boundaries, a longer column gives a longer wavelength and lower frequency.

chapters.title: 开放端不是精确零面
chapters.titleEn: The open boundary is not exactly at the rim
chapters.caption: 低频端修正把压力节点移到管口之外，使频率略降。
chapters.captionEn: Low-frequency end correction moves the pressure node outside the rim and lowers frequency.

chapters.title: 空气也能组成振子
chapters.caption: 颈部空气来回运动，腔内压力随之变化。
chapters.captionEn: Neck air moves back and forth as cavity pressure changes.

chapters.title: 从压缩能到动能
chapters.caption: 经过平衡位置时，颈部空气速度最大。
chapters.captionEn: Neck-air speed is greatest through equilibrium.

chapters.title: 装水为什么升高音调
chapters.caption: 空气体积越小，同样位移产生的压力变化越大。
chapters.captionEn: Less cavity air gives a larger pressure change for the same displacement.

chapters.title: 长颈增加惯性
chapters.caption: 同样腔体，更长的空气柱使振动变慢。
chapters.captionEn: With the same cavity, a longer moving air column lowers frequency.

chapters.title: 宽颈不只是更重
chapters.titleEn: A wider neck changes more than mass
chapters.caption: 截面积同时改变惯性、体积通量和恢复力。
chapters.captionEn: Area changes inertia, volume displacement and restoring force together.

chapters.title: 管口不是运动终点
chapters.caption: 加入两端附近的空气，有效颈长增加、频率降低。
chapters.captionEn: Air near both ends adds effective length and lowers frequency.

chapters.title: 质心不是几何中点
chapters.caption: 较重的平台，让质心更靠近平台中心。
chapters.captionEn: The heavier platform draws the center closer to its midpoint.

chapters.title: 配重前进，平台后退
chapters.titleEn: Cargo advances while the platform retreats
chapters.caption: 无水平外力、最初静止，系统质心保持不动。
chapters.captionEn: With no external horizontal force and no initial drift, the center stays fixed.

chapters.title: 相对平台与相对地面
chapters.titleEn: Platform-relative travel differs from ground travel
chapters.caption: 相对平台走1.6 m，配重对地只走约1.07 m。
chapters.captionEn: A 1.6 m relative trip moves the cargo about 1.07 m over the ground.

chapters.title: 质量相同，位移对称
chapters.caption: 两部分同为120 kg，对地位移等大反向。
chapters.captionEn: Both parts are 120 kg and travel equal distances in opposite directions.

chapters.title: 无外力，也可以一直前进
chapters.titleEn: Zero external force can still mean steady motion
chapters.caption: 质心原先有速度，就保持匀速运动。
chapters.captionEn: A center with initial velocity continues at that constant velocity.

chapters.title: 外力让质心加速
chapters.titleEn: An external force accelerates the center
chapters.caption: 外合力除以总质量，决定质心加速度。
chapters.captionEn: Net external force divided by total mass gives center acceleration.

chapters.title: 下一步只问当前状态
chapters.caption: 每一行描述从当前状态出发的下一步概率。
chapters.captionEn: Each row gives next-step probabilities conditional on the present state.

chapters.title: 概率质量怎样流动
chapters.caption: 从全 A 出发，一步后成为 80% A、20% B。
chapters.captionEn: Starting entirely in A produces 80% A and 20% B after one step.

chapters.title: 重复更新逐渐接近
chapters.caption: 固定规则反复更新，分布趋近 60% A、40% B。
chapters.captionEn: Repeated updates under these rules approach 60% A and 40% B.

chapters.title: 分布不动，个体仍动
chapters.caption: 60/40 更新后仍是 60/40，个体轨迹仍能切换。
chapters.captionEn: The 60/40 distribution stays fixed while an individual can still switch.

chapters.title: 规则改变，平衡也变
chapters.caption: A→B 为 50%、B→A 为 10%，稳态改为约 16.7/83.3。
chapters.captionEn: With A→B at 50% and B→A at 10%, stationarity becomes about 16.7/83.3.

chapters.title: 存在不保证收敛
chapters.caption: 每步必定翻转；50/50 是稳态，全 A 起点却永远交替。
chapters.captionEn: Every step flips; 50/50 is stationary, but an all-A start alternates forever.

chapters.title: 完全不转移，稳态不唯一
chapters.caption: 两项转移概率都为零，每种初始分布都保持。
chapters.captionEn: With both switching probabilities at zero, every initial distribution stays fixed.

chapters.title: 真空并不隔绝辐射
chapters.titleEn: A vacuum does not stop radiation
chapters.caption: 物体发射辐射，也吸收环境送来的辐射。
chapters.captionEn: The object emits radiation and absorbs radiation from its surroundings.

chapters.title: 相等不代表停止
chapters.caption: 同温时两项相等，净热流为零。
chapters.captionEn: At equal temperatures, the two powers balance and net heat flow is zero.

chapters.title: 四次方看的是开尔文
chapters.caption: 绝对温度加倍，发射功率变为十六倍。
chapters.captionEn: Doubling absolute temperature multiplies emission by sixteen.

chapters.title: 低发射率改变两项
chapters.caption: 灰体发射减弱，吸收也按相同比例减弱。
chapters.captionEn: A grey surface emits less and absorbs less by the same factor.

chapters.title: 环境更热会怎样
chapters.caption: 球面仍在发射，但吸收更强，净能量向内。
chapters.captionEn: The sphere still emits, but stronger absorption gives a net inward transfer.

chapters.title: 热辐射不需要看得见
chapters.titleEn: Thermal radiation need not be visible
chapters.caption: 三百到六百开尔文的谱峰仍在红外。
chapters.captionEn: The peak remains in the infrared from three hundred to six hundred kelvins.

chapters.title: 把面积变成命中比例
chapters.titleEn: Turn area into a hit fraction
chapters.caption: 独立均匀抽样时，圆内命中比例估计 π/4。
chapters.captionEn: Independent uniform sampling makes the hit fraction estimate π/4.

chapters.title: 真实计数给出估计
chapters.caption: 每个新增点改变整数计数，估计为 4×命中/N。
chapters.captionEn: Each point updates integer counts; the estimate is 4×hits/N.

chapters.title: 更多点，不保证步步更准
chapters.titleEn: More points need not improve every step
chapters.caption: 前缀估计会上下波动，不单调逼近已知基准。
chapters.captionEn: Prefix estimates fluctuate instead of approaching the reference monotonically.

chapters.title: 同样数量，也有不同结果
chapters.titleEn: Equal counts can give different results
chapters.caption: 四个固定种子各取 256 点，估计不同。
chapters.captionEn: Four fixed seeds each use 256 points and produce different estimates.

chapters.title: 样本乘四，标准误差减半
chapters.caption: 独立均匀条件下，N 从 1024 到 4096，理论 SE 减半。
chapters.captionEn: Under independent uniform sampling, N rising from 1024 to 4096 halves theoretical SE.

chapters.title: 更多点不能修复抽样偏差
chapters.titleEn: More points cannot repair sampling bias
chapters.caption: 改用 x=u²，点偏向左侧，未加权命中比例不再表示面积。
chapters.captionEn: With x=u², points favor the left; an unweighted hit fraction no longer measures area.

chapters.title: 没有样本，与只有一次命中
chapters.caption: N=0 时未定义；N=1 即使命中，区间仍很宽。
chapters.captionEn: N = 0 is undefined; even one hit at N = 1 leaves a wide interval.

chapters.title: 孔会缩小吗
chapters.caption: 自由均匀膨胀时，孔径也随整体变大。
chapters.captionEn: Under free uniform expansion, the hole grows with the plate.

chapters.title: 只加热孔板
chapters.caption: 孔变大，保持初温的塞子与孔缘间隙增加。
chapters.captionEn: The hole grows while a cold plug stays the same size.

chapters.title: 塞子也会膨胀
chapters.caption: 同材质塞子随后升温，额外间隙大部分消失。
chapters.captionEn: Heating the matching plug removes most of the extra clearance.

chapters.title: 允许伸长时
chapters.caption: 同一热应变，杆的自由增量与初长成正比。
chapters.captionEn: For the same thermal strain, free extension is proportional to initial length.

chapters.title: 挡住伸长时
chapters.caption: 两端固定，长度不变，压缩应力随温升增加。
chapters.captionEn: Fixed ends preserve length while compressive stress grows with heating.

chapters.title: 冷却时方向反过来
chapters.caption: 同样固定两端，冷却会产生拉应力。
chapters.captionEn: With the same fixed ends, cooling produces tensile stress.

chapters.title: 从正极板到负极板
chapters.titleEn: From the positive plate to the negative
chapters.caption: 电势沿电场方向降低。
chapters.captionEn: Potential decreases along the field direction.

chapters.title: 提高电压，电势坡更陡
chapters.titleEn: Raise voltage and steepen the potential slope
chapters.caption: 间距不变，电压越高，场强越大。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed separation, higher voltage gives a stronger field.

chapters.title: 隔离后拉开极板
chapters.caption: 自由电荷固定，空气场强不变，电压升高。
chapters.captionEn: Fixed free charge preserves the air field while voltage rises.

chapters.title: 同样电荷，比较不同介质
chapters.titleEn: Compare dielectrics at the same free charge
chapters.caption: 完全填充时，介电常数4使电压降到四分之一。
chapters.captionEn: A full dielectric of relative permittivity four quarters the voltage.

chapters.title: 同样电压，电源补充电荷
chapters.titleEn: At fixed voltage, the source supplies charge
chapters.caption: 完全填充后场强仍是V/d，自由电荷增加。
chapters.captionEn: With full filling, field remains V/d while free charge increases.

chapters.title: 空气与介质分担电压
chapters.titleEn: Air and dielectric share the voltage drop
chapters.caption: 界面电势连续，不同材料中的斜率不同。
chapters.captionEn: Potential is continuous while slopes differ between materials.

chapters.title: 一次试验只有两根柱
chapters.caption: 一次公平 0/1 试验，两种结果各占一半。
chapters.captionEn: One fair 0/1 trial assigns one-half to each outcome.

chapters.title: 独立相加，路径汇入中间
chapters.caption: 两次试验中，01 和 10 都得到成功次数 1。
chapters.captionEn: For two trials, both 01 and 10 produce one success.

chapters.title: 有限次数仍然离散
chapters.caption: 8 次公平试验的精确分布仍有离散格子。
chapters.captionEn: Eight fair trials still give an exact discrete distribution.

chapters.title: 减去中心，再缩放
chapters.caption: 32 次的和减去均值、除以标准差，改用 z 坐标。
chapters.captionEn: Center the 32-trial sum and divide by its standard deviation to obtain z.

chapters.title: 和变宽，均值更集中
chapters.caption: N 从 8 到 32，均值标准差减半，和的方差反而增加。
chapters.captionEn: From N = 8 to 32, mean SD halves while sum variance increases.

chapters.title: 稀少事件仍很偏斜
chapters.caption: p = 0.05、N = 8 时，零次成功仍占约 66.3%。
chapters.captionEn: At p = 0.05 and N = 8, zero successes still has about 66.3% probability.

chapters.title: 复制不等于独立信息
chapters.caption: 同一次结果复制 32 份，和只有 0 或 32。
chapters.captionEn: Copy one outcome 32 times: the sum can only be 0 or 32.

chapters.title: 碰撞怎样变成压强
chapters.caption: 壁面得到的冲量，除以时间与面积，给出平均压强。
chapters.captionEn: Wall impulse divided by time and area gives mean pressure.

chapters.title: 定容加热
chapters.caption: 相同粒子数和容积，绝对温度加倍使压强加倍。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed amount and volume, doubling absolute temperature doubles pressure.

chapters.title: 等温缩小容积
chapters.caption: 速度不变，壁面往返距离更短，压强上升。
chapters.captionEn: Speeds stay fixed; shorter wall round trips raise pressure.

chapters.title: 增加的是原子数量
chapters.caption: 同温、同容积，数量增加使平均压强增加。
chapters.captionEn: At equal temperature and volume, more atoms give more pressure.

chapters.title: 表压有另一个零点
chapters.caption: 状态方程算绝对压强；表压还要减去环境压强。
chapters.captionEn: The gas law gives absolute pressure; gauge pressure subtracts ambient pressure.

chapters.title: 重原子不一定压强更高
chapters.titleEn: Heavier atoms need not mean higher pressure
chapters.caption: 同温、同数量、同容积，换成较重原子仍给出相同压强。
chapters.captionEn: At equal temperature, amount and volume, heavier atoms give the same pressure.

chapters.title: 一步一格，真实累积
chapters.caption: 每步 ±1；下行位置等于前面步长的累积。
chapters.captionEn: Each step is ±1; lower positions accumulate the preceding moves.

chapters.title: 一条路可以很曲折
chapters.caption: 曲线记录一个个体的位置，不要求最终回到零。
chapters.captionEn: The curve follows one individual and need not end at zero.

chapters.title: 总体分布不是三条样本
chapters.titleEn: A population is not three sample paths
chapters.caption: 精确终点分布均值为零，三条样本末点不必对称。
chapters.captionEn: The exact endpoint distribution has zero mean; three sample endpoints need not be symmetric.

chapters.title: 时间乘四，RMS 乘二
chapters.caption: 公平无限格点从 16 到 64 步，RMS 从 4 到 8。
chapters.captionEn: For a fair unbounded walk, 16 to 64 steps raises RMS from 4 to 8.

chapters.title: 偏置带来漂移
chapters.caption: P(+1)=0.7 时，32 步均值为 12.8，标准差约 5.185。
chapters.captionEn: With P(+1) = 0.7, the 32-step mean is 12.8 and SD is about 5.185.

chapters.title: 奇偶性限制当前位置
chapters.caption: 31 步不可能恰在零；32 步返回零的概率非零。
chapters.captionEn: Zero is unreachable after 31 steps but has positive probability after 32.

chapters.title: 碰到边界就留下
chapters.caption: ±4 一旦触及便停止，边界概率累积而不丢失。
chapters.captionEn: At ±4, walkers stop and boundary probability accumulates rather than disappearing.

chapters.title: 电流逐渐建立
chapters.caption: 电感限制电流变化的速度。
chapters.captionEn: Inductance limits the rate of current change.

chapters.title: 六伏如何分配
chapters.caption: 电阻压降增大，电感压降减小。
chapters.captionEn: The resistor drop rises as the inductor drop falls.

chapters.title: 增大电感只改变快慢
chapters.caption: 电感加倍，时间常数加倍，终值相同。
chapters.captionEn: Double inductance doubles the time constant, not the final current.

chapters.title: 开关断开，回路改变
chapters.titleEn: Open the switch and change the loop
chapters.caption: 电流方向保持，线圈电压反转。
chapters.captionEn: Current keeps its direction while coil voltage reverses.

chapters.title: 更快释放的代价
chapters.titleEn: The voltage cost of faster release
chapters.caption: 30 V钳位缩短衰减，开关承受36 V。
chapters.captionEn: A 30 V clamp speeds release; the switch sees 36 V.

chapters.title: 磁能去了哪里
chapters.caption: 磁能变成电阻热与钳位热，总量守恒。
chapters.captionEn: Magnetic energy becomes resistor and clamp heat.

chapters.title: 没有热输入，也能升温
chapters.caption: 绝热压缩中，外界做功增加气体内能。
chapters.captionEn: Adiabatic compression adds internal energy through work.

chapters.title: 沿程的功在哪里
chapters.caption: 压强乘小体积变化，沿路径累计为活塞功。
chapters.captionEn: Pressure times a small volume change accumulates into piston work.

chapters.title: 保持同温需要热流
chapters.caption: 等温压缩时，输入的功以热量移走。
chapters.captionEn: During isothermal compression, work input is removed as heat.

chapters.title: 热容改变温升
chapters.titleEn: Heat capacity changes the temperature rise
chapters.caption: 同样压缩比，较大γ对应更大的绝热温升。
chapters.captionEn: At the same compression ratio, larger gamma gives a greater adiabatic temperature rise.

chapters.title: 反向释放活塞
chapters.caption: 绝热膨胀时，气体对外做功，内能与温度下降。
chapters.captionEn: In adiabatic expansion, gas does work and loses internal energy.

chapters.title: 绝热不保证降温
chapters.titleEn: Adiabatic does not always mean cooling
chapters.caption: 向真空自由膨胀：没有热交换，也没有边界功。
chapters.captionEn: Free expansion into vacuum has neither heat transfer nor boundary work.

chapters.title: 数量很少时，近似指数
chapters.caption: N 远小于 K 时，限制因子接近 1。
chapters.captionEn: When N is much smaller than K, the limiting factor is near 1.

chapters.title: 数量与限制共同决定增速
chapters.caption: 总增速是 rN 与 1−N/K 的乘积。
chapters.captionEn: Total growth multiplies rN by 1−N/K.

chapters.title: 总增速在一半处最大
chapters.caption: K=100 时，N=25/50/75 的增速为 11.25/15/11.25。
chapters.captionEn: At K = 100, N = 25, 50 and 75 give rates 11.25, 15 and 11.25.

chapters.title: 从下方渐近承载量
chapters.caption: 0<N<K 时增速为正，接近 K 时趋近零。
chapters.captionEn: For 0<N<K, growth is positive and approaches zero near K.

chapters.title: 超载时，同一规则给出下降
chapters.titleEn: Above capacity, the same rule gives decline
chapters.caption: N₀=140>K=100，限制因子为负，数量从上方趋近。
chapters.captionEn: With N₀ = 140 above K = 100, negative limitation approaches equilibrium from above.

chapters.title: 承载量改变，斜率也改变
chapters.caption: t=6 时 K 从 100 降到 60，数量连续而增速转负。
chapters.captionEn: At t = 6, K falls from 100 to 60; abundance stays continuous while growth turns negative.

chapters.title: 零初值与零增长率
chapters.titleEn: Zero initial abundance and zero rate
chapters.caption: 没有迁入时零初值不增长；r=0 时任意初值保持。
chapters.captionEn: Without immigration, zero stays zero; at r = 0 every initial abundance stays fixed.

chapters.title: 浸下去多少，排开多少
chapters.caption: 浸没体积增加，浮力随之增加。
chapters.captionEn: Buoyant force grows with immersed volume.

chapters.title: 更深，不一定浮力更大
chapters.titleEn: Deeper need not mean more buoyancy
chapters.caption: 完全浸没后，深度增加但上下压力差不变。
chapters.captionEn: After full immersion, greater depth leaves the pressure difference unchanged.

chapters.title: 放手才看净力
chapters.caption: 轻物体上浮，直到部分浸没时浮力与重力相等。
chapters.captionEn: A light object rises until partial immersion balances its weight.

chapters.title: 加重会吃水更深
chapters.titleEn: A heavier load needs more draft
chapters.caption: 漂浮平衡时，排液重量必须随总重量增加。
chapters.captionEn: A floating equilibrium displaces liquid equal to the total weight.

chapters.title: 下沉也有浮力
chapters.caption: 重物体浮力仍向上，但不足以平衡重力。
chapters.captionEn: A sinking object still has upward buoyancy, smaller than its weight.

chapters.title: 换液体，平衡怎样调整
chapters.caption: 更密的液体让同一轻物体浮得更高，平衡浮力仍等于重力。
chapters.captionEn: A denser liquid gives less draft; equilibrium buoyancy still equals weight.

chapters.title: 先比较一个位置
chapters.caption: Q 到各站点的直线距离来自实际坐标。
chapters.captionEn: Actual coordinates determine straight-line distances from Q to each site.

chapters.title: 两个站点，一条平分线
chapters.caption: 两站点等距位置在垂直平分线上，两侧分别更近。
chapters.captionEn: The perpendicular bisector ties two sites; opposite sides favor opposite sites.

chapters.title: 多个条件一起求交
chapters.caption: 每个单元必须同时比其他所有站点更近。
chapters.captionEn: A cell must satisfy every competing nearest-site inequality at once.

chapters.title: 移动站点，比较重新计算
chapters.caption: D 移到 (200,125)，固定 Q 的最近站点从 B 改为 D。
chapters.captionEn: Moving D to (200,125) changes fixed Q’s nearest site from B to D.

chapters.title: 边与顶点可以平局
chapters.caption: 共享边上两站点等距，三单元交点可同时等距。
chapters.captionEn: Shared edges can tie two sites; a three-cell vertex can tie three.

chapters.title: 重合不是一条平局边
chapters.titleEn: Coincidence creates more than one tied edge
chapters.caption: A 与 B 重合，整个对应区域都等距；填色约定不等于唯一。
chapters.captionEn: Coincident A and B tie across a region; coloring order does not make ownership unique.

chapters.title: 直线最近，不一定绕行最短
chapters.titleEn: Straight-line nearest can lose on route cost
chapters.caption: 有墙时 A 直线最近，绕端点后 B 的路程更短。
chapters.captionEn: With a wall, A is nearest by straight line but B has the shorter route.

chapters.title: 没有端电流，仍有内建场
chapters.titleEn: Zero terminal current, a built-in field
chapters.caption: 耗尽区留下固定离子，电场从n指向p。
chapters.captionEn: Fixed ions remain; the field points from n to p.

chapters.title: 宽度不同，电荷相等
chapters.caption: 低掺杂一侧耗尽得更宽，正负面积相等。
chapters.captionEn: The less doped side depletes farther; signed areas cancel.

chapters.title: 正向偏置降低势垒
chapters.caption: 结电压升高，势垒与耗尽宽度减小。
chapters.captionEn: Rising forward junction voltage lowers and narrows the barrier.

chapters.title: 小幅电压，大幅电流
chapters.titleEn: Small voltage changes, large current changes
chapters.caption: 300 K时，约60 mV对应十倍理想正向电流。
chapters.captionEn: At 300 K, about 60 mV gives ten times the ideal forward current.

chapters.title: 反向偏置拉宽耗尽层
chapters.caption: 势垒升高，理想反向电流趋近微小饱和值。
chapters.captionEn: The barrier rises while ideal reverse current approaches saturation.

chapters.title: 外加电压不全落在结上
chapters.caption: 串联电阻分担电压，必须同时满足回路方程。
chapters.captionEn: The resistor shares the voltage; the loop equation must hold.

chapters.title: 只追踪垂直深度
chapters.caption: 探头越深，液体重量带来的表压越大。
chapters.captionEn: Greater depth gives greater hydrostatic gauge pressure.

chapters.title: 形状不同也能同压
chapters.caption: 连通静止液体的共同液位，让同底深度给出同压。
chapters.captionEn: A common level in connected static liquid gives equal bottom pressure.

chapters.title: 换密度，改变梯度
chapters.caption: 同样深度，更密的液体产生更大的静水表压。
chapters.captionEn: At equal depth, denser liquid gives greater hydrostatic gauge pressure.

chapters.title: 液面本身也受压
chapters.caption: 改变共同液面气压，绝对压强一起平移。
chapters.captionEn: Changing common surface pressure shifts all absolute readings.

chapters.title: 底部没有独自承重
chapters.titleEn: The bottom need not carry all the weight
chapters.caption: 斜壁的竖直分力，让同底压与不同液重同时成立。
chapters.captionEn: Vertical wall forces reconcile equal bottom pressure with unequal liquid weight.

chapters.title: 同压不等于同力
chapters.titleEn: Equal pressure is not equal force
chapters.caption: 同一点处增大膜片面积，压强不变，总力增加。
chapters.captionEn: At one depth, larger diaphragm area increases force, not pressure.

chapters.title: 正午有两个参照
chapters.titleEn: Noon starts with two aligned references
chapters.caption: 先用一年 12×24h 的放大模型，区分恒星与太阳方向。
chapters.captionEn: Use an enlarged 12×24 h year to separate stellar and solar directions.

chapters.title: 转一圈，只保证恒星方向恢复
chapters.titleEn: One spin restores the stellar reference
chapters.caption: P 相对恒星转完一圈，太阳方向已随公转改变。
chapters.captionEn: After P completes one spin relative to stars, orbital motion has changed the Sun direction.

chapters.title: 再追上太阳，才到下个正午
chapters.titleEn: Catch the Sun to reach the next noon
chapters.caption: 继续自转，P 再次朝向太阳，太阳日才结束。
chapters.captionEn: Continue spinning until P faces the Sun again, completing a solar day.

chapters.title: 关闭公转，保留原自转
chapters.caption: 只关闭公转，两种参照的周期变得相同。
chapters.captionEn: Switching off orbit alone makes both reference periods equal.

chapters.title: 地球比例约差四分钟
chapters.titleEn: Earth-like periods differ by about four minutes
chapters.caption: 地球近似比例：恒星日约 23:56:04，平均太阳日 24h。
chapters.captionEn: Earth-like ratio: about 23:56:04 per sidereal day versus a 24 h mean solar day.

chapters.title: 反向自转，关系可以反过来
chapters.titleEn: Reverse spin and the ordering can reverse
chapters.caption: 反向自转使相对角速度绝对值增大，太阳日可更短。
chapters.captionEn: Retrograde spin increases relative-speed magnitude, so the solar day can be shorter.

chapters.title: 先留下上下摆动的空间
chapters.caption: 基极偏置决定集电极的静态输出。
chapters.captionEn: Base bias sets the collector operating point.

chapters.title: 电流增大，输出降低
chapters.caption: 输出等于电源电压减去集电极电阻压降。
chapters.captionEn: Output equals supply voltage minus the collector resistor drop.

chapters.title: 用同一时刻对照波形
chapters.titleEn: Compare both traces at the same instant
chapters.caption: 毫伏输入产生较大的反向输出变化。
chapters.captionEn: A millivolt input produces a larger inverted output variation.

chapters.title: 输入过大，放大失去比例
chapters.caption: 正半周饱和，负半周接近截止。
chapters.captionEn: One side saturates while the other approaches cutoff.

chapters.title: 发射极电阻形成负反馈
chapters.caption: 电流升高时，Ve升高，抵消部分Vb变化。
chapters.captionEn: Rising current raises Ve, opposing part of the Vb change.

chapters.title: 放大的能量从哪里来
chapters.caption: 主要功率来自集电极电源，基极功率也计入。
chapters.captionEn: Most power comes from the collector supply; base power also counts.

chapters.title: 从液位差读流量
chapters.titleEn: Read flow from a level difference
chapters.caption: 宽段与喉部静压不同，双液管把差值变成液位差。
chapters.captionEn: Wide and throat static pressures differ; a manometer turns that into a level difference.

chapters.title: 收窄的是面积
chapters.caption: 同一流量穿过更小面积，喉部速度增加、静压降低。
chapters.captionEn: The same flow through less area raises throat speed and lowers static pressure.

chapters.title: 压差不是正比刻度
chapters.titleEn: The differential scale is not linear
chapters.caption: 管径固定时，流量加倍需要四倍压差。
chapters.captionEn: With fixed geometry, doubling flow requires four times the pressure difference.

chapters.title: 喉部压降不等于全损失
chapters.titleEn: Throat pressure drop is not all lost
chapters.caption: 理想扩散段减速，静压恢复，机械能密度总和不变。
chapters.captionEn: The ideal diffuser slows flow and recovers static pressure at constant total energy density.

chapters.title: 有收缩也可以没有压差
chapters.titleEn: A constriction can have zero differential
chapters.caption: 零流量时标记静止，双液界面同高。
chapters.captionEn: At zero flow, markers stop and manometer interfaces align.

chapters.title: 同样差值，不同方向
chapters.caption: 这两个静压读数可求大小，单独不能判断流向。
chapters.captionEn: These two static readings give magnitude, not direction by themselves.

chapters.title: 先有一条圆轨道
chapters.caption: 初始圆轨道速度由半径与中心引力决定。
chapters.captionEn: Initial circular speed follows radius and central gravity.

chapters.title: 第一次加速，位置不跳
chapters.titleEn: Impulse one changes velocity, not position
chapters.caption: 第一次顺行脉冲使圆轨道转为相切椭圆。
chapters.captionEn: A prograde first impulse produces a tangent transfer ellipse.

chapters.title: 上升滑行，速度下降
chapters.caption: 椭圆滑行中 E 保持，半径增加而速度下降。
chapters.captionEn: Coast energy E stays fixed while radius rises and speed falls.

chapters.title: 到达高度，速度还不匹配
chapters.caption: 远端 v≈0.630，小于圆轨道所需 0.745。
chapters.captionEn: Arrival speed about 0.630 is below required circular speed 0.745.

chapters.title: 第二次加速，圆化轨道
chapters.caption: 第二次增加约 0.115，随后保持目标圆半径。
chapters.captionEn: A second increment of about 0.115 establishes the target circle.

chapters.title: 省略第二次，就继续返回
chapters.titleEn: Skip impulse two and the ellipse returns
chapters.caption: 不圆化就继续原椭圆，回到原来的低半径。
chapters.captionEn: Without circularization, the same ellipse returns to the original lower radius.

chapters.title: 降轨反过来，两次减速
chapters.caption: 降轨两次 Δv 为负，中间下落仍会加速。
chapters.captionEn: Lowering uses two negative increments, although the falling coast gains speed.

chapters.title: 大增益不会自动找到正确输出
chapters.titleEn: Large gain alone does not find the desired output
chapters.caption: 开环中，1 mV也能把输出推到电源轨。
chapters.captionEn: Open loop, even 1 mV can drive output to a rail.

chapters.title: 让输出返回反相端
chapters.titleEn: Return output to the inverting input
chapters.caption: 输出升高，反馈电压升高，误差减小。
chapters.captionEn: Rising output increases feedback voltage and reduces error.

chapters.title: 电阻比例设定闭环增益
chapters.titleEn: The resistor ratio sets closed-loop gain
chapters.caption: 改变反馈比例，输出随之调整。
chapters.captionEn: Changing the feedback fraction changes the required output.

chapters.title: 虚短究竟有多近
chapters.titleEn: How close is a virtual short?
chapters.caption: 环路增益有限，两输入仍有差值。
chapters.captionEn: Finite loop gain leaves a nonzero differential error.

chapters.title: 碰到电源轨，校正停住了
chapters.titleEn: At the rail, correction runs out of room
chapters.caption: 输出饱和后，输入误差持续存在。
chapters.captionEn: Saturation leaves a persistent input error.

chapters.title: 输出变化也有速度上限
chapters.titleEn: Output also has a speed limit
chapters.caption: 较大阶跃沿相同斜率爬升更久。
chapters.captionEn: A larger step follows the same limited slope for longer.

chapters.title: 没有大尾涡的阻力
chapters.caption: 低Re时，黏性效应主导；球面流体相对速度为零。
chapters.captionEn: At low Re, viscosity dominates and relative velocity vanishes on the surface.

chapters.title: 低速下是一次方
chapters.caption: 尺寸和黏度固定，阻力与相对速度成正比。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed size and viscosity, drag is proportional to relative speed.

chapters.title: 黏度改变应力大小
chapters.caption: 规定速度相同，黏度增加使阻力增加，归一流线形状不变。
chapters.captionEn: At the same prescribed speed, viscosity raises drag without changing normalized streamline shape.

chapters.title: 半径不能随便换成面积
chapters.caption: 规定速度下，球阻力与半径成正比。
chapters.captionEn: At prescribed speed, sphere drag is proportional to radius.

chapters.title: 终端速度是力平衡
chapters.caption: 终端沉降时，阻力加浮力等于重力。
chapters.captionEn: At terminal settling, drag plus buoyancy equals weight.

chapters.title: 先算，再检查假设
chapters.caption: 黏度降低后，斯托克斯试算可能不再满足低Re条件。
chapters.captionEn: Lower viscosity can make the Stokes trial violate its own low-Re assumption.

chapters.title: 满月可以绕开影子
chapters.titleEn: A full Moon can miss the shadow
chapters.caption: i≈5.145°，满月离交点较远时越过影区。
chapters.captionEn: At i ≈ 5.145°, a full Moon far from a node misses the shadow.

chapters.title: 把倾角设为零作对照
chapters.caption: 只把倾角设为零，同一满月对日几何进入本影。
chapters.captionEn: Setting inclination to zero centers this full-Moon alignment in the umbra.

chapters.title: 接近交点才进入影区
chapters.titleEn: Move the full-Moon geometry toward a node
chapters.caption: 恢复倾角，再把满月距交点角 F 从 35° 降到零。
chapters.captionEn: Restore inclination and reduce full-Moon node angle F from 35° to zero.

chapters.title: 半影不等于本影
chapters.caption: 只进入半影时，本影覆盖仍为 0%，月面却可稍暗。
chapters.captionEn: A penumbral eclipse can have 0% umbral area while the Moon dims slightly.

chapters.title: 部分投影进入本影
chapters.titleEn: Part of the projected disk enters the umbra
chapters.caption: 月球圆投影与本影部分重叠，成为月偏食。
chapters.captionEn: Partial overlap of the lunar projection and umbra produces a partial eclipse.

chapters.title: 全食不意味着绝对无光
chapters.titleEn: Totality does not mean absolute darkness
chapters.caption: 整个投影在本影中；大气余光可让月面仍显铜红。
chapters.captionEn: The whole disk is in the umbra, yet atmospheric light can leave a copper-red Moon.

chapters.title: 距离也改变相交范围
chapters.caption: 月地距离改变时，月心偏移与影锥截面同时改变。
chapters.captionEn: Changing lunar distance changes both axial offset and the shadow-cone section.

chapters.title: 电流方向与电子漂移
chapters.caption: 传统电流向右，电子平均漂移向左。
chapters.captionEn: Conventional current goes right; electrons drift left.

chapters.title: 磁力指向哪一边
chapters.titleEn: Which way does magnetic force point?
chapters.caption: 负电子向左、磁场穿出屏幕，磁力向下。
chapters.captionEn: For electrons drifting left in an outward field, force points down.

chapters.title: 电场力让横向偏转停止
chapters.titleEn: Electric force balances the sideways push
chapters.caption: 稳态时，FE与FB等大反向。
chapters.captionEn: In steady state, FE and FB are equal and opposite.

chapters.title: 反转磁场，读数翻转
chapters.titleEn: Reverse the field and the reading
chapters.caption: 只反转B，边缘极性与霍尔电压一起翻转。
chapters.captionEn: Reversing only B reverses edge polarity and Hall voltage.

chapters.title: 换载流子，不换传统电流
chapters.caption: 正载流子漂移反向，磁力仍向同一侧。
chapters.captionEn: Positive carriers drift the other way, but magnetic force stays downward.

chapters.title: 同样电流，更少载流子
chapters.titleEn: The same current with fewer carriers
chapters.caption: 密度降低，需要更快漂移，霍尔电压增大。
chapters.captionEn: Lower density requires faster drift and gives a larger Hall voltage.

chapters.title: 上板启动后
chapters.caption: 靠近上板的流体先动，动量向内部扩散。
chapters.captionEn: Fluid near the upper plate moves first as momentum diffuses inward.

chapters.title: 速度建立之后
chapters.caption: 下板固定、上板匀速时，稳态速度沿高度线性变化。
chapters.captionEn: A fixed lower plate and moving upper plate give a linear steady profile.

chapters.title: 两种黏度相接
chapters.caption: 界面速度连续，相同剪应力对应不同速度梯度。
chapters.captionEn: Interface velocity stays continuous while equal stress permits different gradients.

chapters.title: 间隙也是条件
chapters.titleEn: The gap is a condition too
chapters.caption: 同样板速下，间隙增大使剪应力减小。
chapters.captionEn: At the same plate speeds, a wider gap reduces shear stress.

chapters.title: 换序，不换总阻力
chapters.caption: 等厚两层换序后，总剪应力相同，界面速度不同。
chapters.captionEn: Swapping equal-thickness layers preserves total stress but changes interface speed.

chapters.title: 匀速仍要持续做功
chapters.caption: 板输入的机械功率，等于流体中的黏性耗散。
chapters.captionEn: Mechanical power from the plates equals viscous dissipation.

chapters.title: 一起移动没有剪切
chapters.caption: 两板同速时，标记线整体平移，速度梯度和耗散为零。
chapters.captionEn: Equal plate speeds translate the line with zero gradient and dissipation.

chapters.title: 半年两端，量到的是 2p
chapters.caption: 相对两端隔 2B，天空角位移为 2p，p 是半幅。
chapters.captionEn: Opposite viewpoints span 2B and an angular displacement 2p; p is the half-amplitude.

chapters.title: 距离加倍，视差减半
chapters.caption: B = 1 AU 时，距离 1→2 pc，p 约从 1″ 到 0.5″。
chapters.captionEn: At B = 1 AU, increasing distance from 1 to 2 pc reduces p from about 1″ to 0.5″.

chapters.title: 基线减半，也会减小位移
chapters.titleEn: A smaller baseline also reduces motion
chapters.caption: 距离不变，B 从 1 到 0.5 AU，p 减半但估距不变。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed distance, B changing from 1 to 0.5 AU halves p without changing inferred distance.

chapters.title: 天空形状由方向投影
chapters.caption: 黄纬 0°、45°、90° 对应近线、椭圆、近圆。
chapters.captionEn: Ecliptic latitudes 0°, 45° and 90° produce near-line, elliptical and near-circular tracks.

chapters.title: 自行让一年后不完全重合
chapters.titleEn: Proper motion prevents an exact annual return
chapters.caption: 叠加 0.35″/年横向自行，年度周期随线性漂移前进。
chapters.captionEn: Add 0.35″ per year of proper motion and the annual pattern drifts.

chapters.title: 没有基线，就失去这项距离信息
chapters.titleEn: No baseline removes this distance information
chapters.caption: B 从 1 变为零，视差消失，估距不再定义。
chapters.captionEn: Set B from 1 to zero: parallax disappears and the distance inference becomes undefined.

chapters.title: 移动不等于相对运动
chapters.caption: 两板速度同为 (1,0)，边界没有相对张开或错动。
chapters.captionEn: Both plates moving at (1,0) give no relative opening or sliding.

chapters.title: 法向张开，出现新生宽度
chapters.caption: 法向相对速度为正，新生宽度等于速度乘时间。
chapters.captionEn: Positive normal relative velocity creates width equal to speed times time.

chapters.title: 汇聚下的俯冲需要前提
chapters.titleEn: Subduction under convergence needs a premise
chapters.caption: 给定左板可俯冲，物质沿连续等弧长路径下沉。
chapters.captionEn: Assuming left-plate subduction, material follows a continuous unit-arclength path.

chapters.title: 纯错动，没有法向新生量
chapters.titleEn: Pure sliding has no normal opening
chapters.caption: 法向为零，切向运动使两侧参照线错开。
chapters.captionEn: Zero normal velocity with tangential motion offsets the reference lines.

chapters.title: 斜向边界可以同时有两项
chapters.caption: 同一相对速度可同时包含汇聚与切向错动。
chapters.captionEn: One relative velocity can combine convergence with tangential sliding.

chapters.title: 相同汇聚，不自动决定俯冲
chapters.titleEn: The same convergence does not decide subduction
chapters.caption: 取消可俯冲前提，刚体停在大陆接触处，需额外变形模型。
chapters.captionEn: Remove the subduction premise: rigid geometry stops at contact and needs a deformation model.

chapters.title: 一个环，两个切口
chapters.caption: 切面中的两个涡核属于同一个闭合环。
chapters.captionEn: The two section cores belong to one closed ring.

chapters.title: 跟住一小团流体
chapters.caption: 流体绕核运动，环并非一只刚体。
chapters.captionEn: Fluid rolls around a core; the ring is not a rigid body.

chapters.title: 增加环量
chapters.caption: 半径与核宽比固定，速度随环量同比增加。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed geometry, velocity scales with circulation.

chapters.title: 同样环量，扩大半径
chapters.caption: 相似核形下，传播速度与半径成反比。
chapters.captionEn: For similar cores, propagation speed is inversely proportional to radius.

chapters.title: 换回实验室
chapters.caption: 环向前传播，流体相对环仍在翻滚。
chapters.captionEn: The ring advances while fluid keeps rolling relative to it.

chapters.title: 核宽也参与答案
chapters.caption: 同样半径和环量，核模型改变传播速度。
chapters.captionEn: Core structure changes speed even at fixed radius and circulation.

chapters.title: 追波峰，还是追水？
chapters.titleEn: A crest or a water parcel?
chapters.caption: 波峰前进，水质点在局部往复。
chapters.captionEn: The crest travels while a parcel moves locally.

chapters.title: 往深处看
chapters.caption: 深水中，轨道随深度迅速缩小。
chapters.captionEn: In deep water, orbital motion decays rapidly with depth.

chapters.title: 水底压扁轨道
chapters.caption: 底面禁止竖直穿透，水平运动仍可存在。
chapters.captionEn: The bed prevents vertical motion but allows horizontal motion.

chapters.title: 长波与短波
chapters.caption: 同样深水中，较长的重力波相速更大。
chapters.captionEn: Longer gravity waves travel faster in the same deep water.

chapters.title: 两种速度
chapters.caption: 深水中，包络传播慢于内部波峰。
chapters.captionEn: In deep water, the envelope moves more slowly than its crests.

chapters.title: 浅水让两者接近
chapters.caption: 长波浅水极限中，群速与相速趋于相同。
chapters.captionEn: For long waves in shallow water, group and phase speeds converge.

chapters.title: 有磁场，却没有制动
chapters.caption: 均匀磁场中，电势可以抵消运动电动势。
chapters.captionEn: In a uniform field, electrostatic potential cancels motional emf.

chapters.title: 局部磁场打开回路
chapters.caption: 局部磁场让电流在金属内部闭合。
chapters.captionEn: A localized field drives closed currents inside the metal.

chapters.title: 把运动反过来
chapters.caption: 速度反向，电流与制动力一起反向。
chapters.captionEn: Reverse velocity and both current and braking force reverse.

chapters.title: 越慢，制动力越小
chapters.caption: 涡流制动不能提供静止保持力。
chapters.captionEn: Eddy-current braking cannot hold a stationary sheet.

chapters.title: 切开大回路
chapters.caption: 纵向绝缘切缝显著减小制动力。
chapters.captionEn: Longitudinal insulating slits greatly reduce drag.

chapters.title: 机械功率变成热
chapters.caption: 维持匀速所补充的功率等于焦耳热。
chapters.captionEn: Power supplied to maintain speed equals Joule heating.

chapters.title: 先核对没有灰层作用的平衡
chapters.titleEn: First balance an inactive gray layer
chapters.caption: ε=0 时，表面辐射直接逸出，约 238.2 W/m²。
chapters.captionEn: At ε = 0, surface radiation escapes directly at about 238.2 W/m².

chapters.title: 灰层双向发射，不创造能量
chapters.caption: 灰层吸收表面长波，再向上、向下发射；自己的账也要平衡。
chapters.captionEn: The layer absorbs surface IR and emits both ways, balancing its own budget.

chapters.title: 参数骤变，温度不能瞬跳
chapters.caption: ε 从 0.4 变到 0.8，初温保持，净储热率约 +59.5 W/m²。
chapters.captionEn: Step ε from 0.4 to 0.8 at fixed initial temperatures: net storage is about +59.5 W/m².

chapters.title: 多余输入成为储热
chapters.caption: 正热容方程使温度逐渐变化，储热与顶层净通量积分一致。
chapters.captionEn: Positive heat capacities evolve temperatures; stored heat matches integrated planetary imbalance.

chapters.title: 更暖的平衡，逸出仍等于输入
chapters.titleEn: A warmer equilibrium still balances the same input
chapters.caption: ε=0.8 解析平衡：表面约 289.3 K，逸出仍约 238.2 W/m²。
chapters.captionEn: At ε = 0.8 equilibrium, the surface is about 289.3 K while outgoing flux remains 238.2 W/m².

chapters.title: 改变反照率，改变的是输入
chapters.caption: α 从 0.3 到 0.6，吸收太阳减少，与长波 ε 的作用不同。
chapters.captionEn: Changing α from 0.3 to 0.6 reduces absorbed sunlight, unlike changing longwave ε.

chapters.title: 全吸收，也仍能向太空发射
chapters.titleEn: Complete absorption still allows emission to space
chapters.caption: ε=1 时表面直达为零，灰层向上长波仍平衡太阳输入。
chapters.captionEn: At ε = 1 direct surface escape is zero, but upward atmospheric IR still balances sunlight.

chapters.title: 不必等到沸腾
chapters.caption: 水膜蒸发，温度先向下。
chapters.captionEn: Evaporation makes the film temperature fall.

chapters.title: 湿空气，冷却较少
chapters.caption: 同样空气温度，湿度改变蒸发驱动力。
chapters.captionEn: At the same air temperature, humidity changes evaporation.

chapters.title: 换气改变速度
chapters.caption: 同时加强传热和传质，较快接近相同平衡。
chapters.captionEn: Stronger heat and mass exchange reaches the same balance faster.

chapters.title: 冷下来后，谁来供热？
chapters.caption: 平衡时，空气补热等于相变带走。
chapters.captionEn: At equilibrium, air heat input balances latent heat loss.

chapters.title: 关闭质量出口
chapters.caption: 同温、无蒸发时，没有这条冷却通道。
chapters.captionEn: At equal temperatures, removing evaporation removes this cooling pathway.

chapters.title: 太冷时，方向反过来
chapters.titleEn: A colder surface reverses the flux
chapters.caption: 凝结增加液体质量，并向水膜释放潜热。
chapters.captionEn: Condensation adds liquid mass and releases latent heat.

chapters.title: 同温，读数为零
chapters.caption: 两端都是25°C，热电电压为零。
chapters.captionEn: Both ends are at 25°C, so thermoelectric voltage is zero.

chapters.title: 只加热测量端
chapters.caption: 接线端保持25°C，热端升温，电压增加。
chapters.captionEn: Keep the reference at 25°C and heat the measuring junction.

chapters.title: 热端不变，读数仍会变
chapters.titleEn: A fixed hot end can give changing voltage
chapters.caption: 接线端变暖，原始毫伏读数下降。
chapters.captionEn: Warming the reference end reduces the raw millivolt reading.

chapters.title: 先补电压，再换温度
chapters.caption: 加入参考端热电势，恢复同一个400°C。
chapters.captionEn: Adding the reference EMF recovers the same 400°C result.

chapters.title: 加一种金属，何时不出错
chapters.titleEn: When an extra metal adds no error
chapters.caption: 金属M的两个新接点同温，净贡献为零。
chapters.captionEn: Metal M adds no net EMF when its new contacts are isothermal.

chapters.title: 温度梯度换位置
chapters.caption: 均匀导线端点不变，积分电压不变。
chapters.captionEn: Unchanged endpoints give the same integral in homogeneous wires.

chapters.title: 先看能量从哪里来
chapters.caption: PEM 电解：直流电源输入能量，两个产气侧分开。
chapters.captionEn: PEM electrolysis takes energy from a DC source and separates the two gas sides.

chapters.title: 正阳极把水氧化
chapters.titleEn: Oxidize water at the positive anode
chapters.caption: 正阳极：两份水给出一份氧、四份 H⁺ 与四份 e⁻。
chapters.captionEn: Positive anode: two waters give one oxygen, four H⁺ and four e⁻.

chapters.title: 两条通道在阴极汇合
chapters.titleEn: Reunite two carrier routes at the cathode
chapters.caption: H⁺ 穿膜；e⁻ 经过外部电源；负阴极还原生成 H₂。
chapters.captionEn: H⁺ crosses the membrane; e⁻ passes through the source; reduction makes H₂ at the negative cathode.

chapters.title: 用电荷核对两倍产量
chapters.titleEn: Check the two-to-one yield with charge
chapters.caption: 2 A × 60 s = 120 C：H₂ 约 0.622、O₂ 约 0.311 mmol。
chapters.captionEn: 2 A × 60 s = 120 C: about 0.622 mmol H₂ and 0.311 mmol O₂.

chapters.title: 把电流翻倍，比例不变
chapters.titleEn: Double current without changing the ratio
chapters.caption: 同样 60 s，电流从 2 A 到 4 A，两种累计产量都翻倍。
chapters.captionEn: For the same 60 s, stepping current from 2 A to 4 A doubles both amounts.

chapters.title: 同样产量，不同电输入
chapters.titleEn: Equal yield can cost different electrical input
chapters.caption: 相同电荷下，1.60 V → 2.00 V 不改产量，却增加电输入与净放热。
chapters.captionEn: At equal charge, 1.60 V → 2.00 V preserves yield but increases electrical input and heat out.

chapters.title: 有限的水会让累计量停住
chapters.caption: 只有 0.300 mmol 水：耗尽后产量封顶，持续电流归零。
chapters.captionEn: With only 0.300 mmol water, depletion caps yield and stops sustained current.

chapters.title: 冷一点，还没有露
chapters.caption: 镜面降温，环境水汽分压保持不变。
chapters.captionEn: The mirror cools while ambient vapour pressure stays fixed.

chapters.title: 穿过露点
chapters.caption: 镜面饱和值低于环境分压，净凝结出现。
chapters.captionEn: Below the dew point, ambient vapour pressure exceeds surface saturation.

chapters.title: 同一镜面，更湿空气
chapters.caption: 空气温度不变，水汽增加会抬高露点。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed air temperature, more vapour raises the dew point.

chapters.title: 升温不一定减少水汽
chapters.caption: 定压且水汽比例不变时，露点不变、相对湿度变。
chapters.captionEn: At fixed pressure and mixing ratio, dew point stays while relative humidity changes.

chapters.title: 继续冷却后的水账
chapters.caption: 低于露点，部分水汽变成液水；总水量守恒。
chapters.captionEn: Below the dew point, vapour becomes liquid while total water is conserved.

chapters.title: 复热，再回到水汽
chapters.caption: 保留液水时，复热可逆转气液分配。
chapters.captionEn: With condensate retained, reheating reverses the phase allocation.

chapters.title: 加力，建立电压
chapters.caption: 理想绝缘时，电荷变化与力成正比。
chapters.captionEn: With ideal isolation, charge change is proportional to force.

chapters.title: 力还在，电压却消退
chapters.caption: 载荷保持100 N，电压按RC时间常数衰减。
chapters.captionEn: At a held 100 N, voltage decays with time constant RC.

chapters.title: 卸载会出现反向脉冲
chapters.caption: 负电压出现时，压力正在回到零。
chapters.captionEn: The voltage turns negative as compressive force returns to zero.

chapters.title: 仪表改变可观察的时间
chapters.titleEn: The instrument changes the observable timescale
chapters.caption: 电阻减小十倍，保持信号消失得更快。
chapters.captionEn: Ten times less resistance makes the held signal disappear faster.

chapters.title: 同样的力，慢加读数更小
chapters.titleEn: The same force can give a smaller slow signal
chapters.caption: 慢加力时，电荷一边产生一边流失。
chapters.captionEn: During a slow ramp, charge leaks while it is generated.

chapters.title: 把电压变成微小位移
chapters.titleEn: Turn voltage into a small displacement
chapters.caption: 没有外力时，电压正负控制伸缩方向。
chapters.captionEn: With no external force, voltage polarity controls deformation direction.

chapters.title: 有电压，不等于正在供电
chapters.titleEn: Voltage does not mean current is flowing
chapters.caption: 负载开路：可以有参考开路电压，却没有持续电流与电输出。
chapters.captionEn: Open load: a reference open-circuit voltage can exist without sustained current or power.

chapters.title: 负阳极让氢失去电子
chapters.titleEn: Hydrogen loses electrons at the negative anode
chapters.caption: 燃料电池的负阳极氧化氢：2 H₂ → 4 H⁺ + 4 e⁻。
chapters.captionEn: The negative fuel-cell anode oxidizes hydrogen: 2 H₂ → 4 H⁺ + 4 e⁻.

chapters.title: 膜内与膜外两路汇合
chapters.titleEn: Two routes meet at the positive cathode
chapters.caption: H⁺ 穿膜，e⁻ 经负载；正阴极将氧还原并生成水。
chapters.captionEn: H⁺ crosses the membrane, e⁻ passes through the load, and oxygen becomes water at the positive cathode.

chapters.title: 把物质变化系在同一份电荷上
chapters.titleEn: Tie material conversion to the same charge
chapters.caption: 每生成两份水，消耗两份氢与一份氧；累计量由电荷决定。
chapters.captionEn: Two waters require two hydrogens and one oxygen; transferred charge fixes the accumulated amounts.

chapters.title: 降低负载，先让输出增加
chapters.titleEn: Lower the load to increase output first
chapters.caption: 固定 r=0.20 Ω：R 从 2.00 到 0.20 Ω，电输出增大，焓效率下降。
chapters.captionEn: With r = 0.20 Ω, R from 2.00 to 0.20 Ω increases output but lowers HHV efficiency.

chapters.title: 接近短路不是更好的供能
chapters.titleEn: A near short is not better power delivery
chapters.caption: R 降到 0.05 Ω：电流更大，外部功率反而低于匹配负载。
chapters.captionEn: At R = 0.05 Ω, current rises but external power falls below the matched-load output.

chapters.title: 氧耗尽后，剩氢也不能继续供电
chapters.titleEn: Excess hydrogen cannot replace exhausted oxygen
chapters.caption: 氧额度 0.100 mmol：最多产水 0.200 mmol，留下氢 1.800 mmol。
chapters.captionEn: An oxygen allowance of 0.100 mmol caps water at 0.200 mmol and leaves 1.800 mmol hydrogen.

chapters.title: 相差120°的三条波形
chapters.caption: 三相同频同幅，峰值到达时间依次错开。
chapters.captionEn: The phases share frequency and amplitude but reach peaks at different times.

chapters.title: 两相之间要做相减
chapters.caption: 230 V相电压对应约398 V线电压。
chapters.captionEn: A 230 V phase voltage gives about 398 V between phases.

chapters.title: 先看单相功率的起伏
chapters.caption: 单相电阻功率在零与两倍平均值之间起伏。
chapters.captionEn: Single-phase resistive power varies from zero to twice its average.

chapters.title: 三相把起伏拼成恒定总和
chapters.titleEn: Three phases form a constant sum
chapters.caption: 各相仍在起伏，粗线总功率却保持水平。
chapters.captionEn: Individual phases pulsate while their bold total remains level.

chapters.title: 储能回送，不破坏平衡总和
chapters.titleEn: Energy return can preserve the balanced sum
chapters.caption: 共同滞后45°，各相可回送能量，总有功仍恒定。
chapters.captionEn: A common 45-degree lag permits phase energy return with constant total power.

chapters.title: 只改一相，平衡就消失
chapters.titleEn: Change one phase and balance disappears
chapters.caption: A相阻抗减半，中性线电流与功率起伏一起出现。
chapters.captionEn: Halving A impedance creates both neutral current and total-power ripple.

chapters.title: 常压的沸点
chapters.caption: 常压液汽共存时，继续供热主要增加相变。
chapters.captionEn: At ambient-pressure equilibrium, further heat mainly drives phase change.

chapters.title: 阀座挡住出口
chapters.titleEn: A seated valve closes the outlet
chapters.caption: 阀口尚未打开，供热提高温度与饱和压力。
chapters.captionEn: Before the valve lifts, heat raises temperature and saturation pressure.

chapters.title: 压差抬起配重
chapters.caption: 压差乘阀座面积，与配重重力平衡。
chapters.captionEn: Pressure difference times seat area balances the weight.

chapters.title: 供热更大，排汽更多
chapters.caption: 调压状态下，供热主要改变流量，不持续抬高温度。
chapters.captionEn: During regulation, more heat mainly changes flow rather than temperature.

chapters.title: 模型配重与设定压力
chapters.caption: 同一阀座面积，更大配重需要更大压差。
chapters.captionEn: At the same seat area, a larger model weight needs more pressure difference.

chapters.title: 同样表压，不同环境
chapters.caption: 环境压力降低，同一配重的绝对设定压力也降低。
chapters.captionEn: Lower ambient pressure lowers absolute set pressure for the same weight.

chapters.title: 同穿一环，去回相抵
chapters.titleEn: One core cancels outgoing and returning currents
chapters.caption: 5.000 A 去、5.000 A 回，检测环中的剩余为零。
chapters.captionEn: 5.000 A out and 5.000 A back leave zero residual in the shared core.

chapters.title: 负载增大，差流仍可为零
chapters.titleEn: A larger balanced load can still have zero residual
chapters.caption: 平衡负载从 2 A 到 12 A，去回都增大，差流仍为零。
chapters.captionEn: A balanced load from 2 A to 12 A increases both currents and leaves zero residual.

chapters.title: 一部分电流从环外返回
chapters.titleEn: Part of the current returns outside the core
chapters.caption: L=5.040 A，N=5.000 A；40 mA 经环外路径返回。
chapters.captionEn: L = 5.040 A, N = 5.000 A; 40 mA returns outside the sensing window.

chapters.title: 先检测，再释放锁扣
chapters.titleEn: Detect first, then release the latch
chapters.caption: 示例差流持续 20 ms 后跳开两极；断开后当前电流归零。
chapters.captionEn: After 20 ms of illustrative persistence, both poles open and present current becomes zero.

chapters.title: 故障清除，不会自动合闸
chapters.titleEn: Fault removal does not automatically reclose
chapters.caption: 100 ms 清除故障后，触点仍锁定在断开状态。
chapters.captionEn: Removing the fault at 100 ms leaves the contacts latched open.

chapters.title: 内部测试制造另一种不平衡
chapters.titleEn: The internal test creates a different imbalance
chapters.caption: 测试支路从环前 L 到环后 N，无需 PE，也能形成差流。
chapters.captionEn: The test bypass joins before-core L to after-core N, creating residual without PE.

chapters.title: 清除之后再合闸
chapters.caption: 故障已清除再合闸，去回平衡恢复；故障仍在会再次跳开。
chapters.captionEn: Reclosing after removal restores balance; a continuing fault would trip again.

chapters.title: 常开，是未激励时的接触状态
chapters.titleEn: Normally open describes the unenergized contacts
chapters.caption: 线圈未激励，弹簧保持铜桥抬起，独立负载回路断开。
chapters.captionEn: With the coil unenergized, the spring lifts the copper bridge and opens the independent load loop.

chapters.title: 电流建立，磁力才推动柱塞
chapters.titleEn: Current builds before attraction moves the plunger
chapters.caption: 施加 5 V：电流与磁力先建立，柱塞克服弹簧后才接触。
chapters.captionEn: Apply 5 V: current and attraction build before the plunger overcomes the spring and closes the contacts.

chapters.title: 负载由自己的电源供能
chapters.titleEn: The load uses its own energy source
chapters.caption: 负载电源 5 V → 12 V，功率 0.25 W → 1.44 W，线圈状态不变。
chapters.captionEn: Load source 5 V → 12 V gives 0.25 W → 1.44 W while coil state stays unchanged.

chapters.title: 从静止出发，2 V 不足以吸合
chapters.titleEn: Two volts cannot pull in from rest
chapters.caption: 开气隙下施加 2 V，磁力小于预紧力，触点仍开。
chapters.captionEn: At the open gap, 2 V produces less attraction than preload, leaving the contacts open.

chapters.title: 先吸合，再降到相同电压
chapters.titleEn: Pull in first, then reduce to the same voltage
chapters.caption: 先用 5 V 吸合再降到 2 V，小气隙增强磁力，仍可保持。
chapters.captionEn: Pull in at 5 V, then reduce to 2 V: the smaller gap strengthens attraction enough to hold.

chapters.title: 断电之后，电流先续流再衰减
chapters.titleEn: After switch-off, current recirculates before decaying
chapters.caption: 本例含续流二极管：断源后线圈电流先衰减，弹簧再释放触点。
chapters.captionEn: With the illustrated flyback diode, coil current decays after source removal before the spring releases the contacts.

chapters.title: 有线圈电流，触点仍可能没动
chapters.titleEn: Coil current does not prove contact movement
chapters.caption: 柱塞被机械阻挡：线圈有电流和磁力，负载仍未接通。
chapters.captionEn: A mechanically blocked plunger retains coil current and attraction while leaving the load disconnected.

chapters.title: 穿心一匝，测量大电流
chapters.titleEn: One primary turn measures a large current
chapters.caption: 低负担下，二次电流接近一次电流除以匝数。
chapters.captionEn: With a low burden, secondary current nearly follows the turns ratio.

chapters.title: 没有完全抵消的安匝
chapters.titleEn: The ampere-turns do not cancel completely
chapters.caption: 一次安匝减去二次安匝，剩余部分建立磁场。
chapters.captionEn: Primary minus secondary ampere-turns establishes the core field.

chapters.title: 二次匝数加倍
chapters.caption: 同样一次电流，二次电流大约减半。
chapters.captionEn: The same primary current gives roughly half the secondary current.

chapters.title: 负担变大，比例开始失真
chapters.titleEn: A larger burden distorts the ratio
chapters.caption: 更多电压需要更多磁通变化，非线性误差增大。
chapters.captionEn: More required voltage drives larger flux changes and nonlinear error.

chapters.title: 开路不等于没有电压
chapters.titleEn: Open circuit does not mean zero voltage
chapters.caption: 二次电流为零，变化磁通仍产生高电压。
chapters.captionEn: Secondary current is zero, but changing flux still induces high voltage.

chapters.title: 有磁通，不一定有感应电压
chapters.titleEn: Flux alone does not guarantee induction
chapters.caption: 直流达到稳态后，磁通不变，感应输出为零。
chapters.captionEn: After DC settles, flux is constant and induced output is zero.

chapters.title: 发热与散热能达到平衡
chapters.titleEn: Heating and heat loss can balance
chapters.caption: 1 A下，热量逐渐通过端帽导出。
chapters.captionEn: At 1 A, heat increasingly escapes through the end caps.

chapters.title: 中间先达到熔点
chapters.caption: 2.2 A过载下，最热处先到达961.9°C。
chapters.captionEn: At 2.2 A, the hottest location first reaches 961.9°C.

chapters.title: 短脉冲可以留下热，却不熔化
chapters.titleEn: A brief pulse can heat without melting
chapters.caption: 相同4 A，8 ms脉冲结束后开始冷却。
chapters.captionEn: At the same 4 A, an 8 ms pulse ends before melting and then cools.

chapters.title: 环境更热，余量更小
chapters.titleEn: A warmer environment leaves less margin
chapters.caption: 相同2.2 A，80°C环境更早到达熔点。
chapters.captionEn: At the same 2.2 A, an 80°C environment reaches melting sooner.

chapters.title: 只变粗一点，升温就明显变慢
chapters.titleEn: A thicker wire heats much more slowly
chapters.caption: 直径50→70 µm，面积接近翻倍。
chapters.captionEn: Changing diameter from 50 to 70 µm nearly doubles area.

chapters.title: 电流加倍，短时升温约快四倍
chapters.titleEn: Double current, roughly quarter the short heating time
chapters.caption: 高电流短时间内，达到同一热状态的I²t近似相同。
chapters.captionEn: During brief high-current heating, equal thermal endpoints need similar I²t.
